title_en: A device and method for guiding a visually impaired person who has stepped on a braille blocks at a bus stop to move to a safe area
title_ko: 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 시각 장애인에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 시각 장애인에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 버스 정류장에서 점자 블록을 밟은 탑승 대기자에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고하는 장치는 적어도 하나의 압력 센서 및 상기 적어도 하나의 압력 센서에 의해 감지된 압력 값을 경보 장치로 전송하는 무선 송신부를 포함하며, 상기 버스 정류장과 차도 사이에 배치된 점자 블록; 및 상기 무선 송신부로부터 상기 압력 값이 수신되면, 탑승 대기자에게 안전 구획으로 이동하도록 경고등 및 경고음을 출력하는 경보 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: AI-based Customized Emergency Alert System for the Hearing Impaired
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 ai 기반 맞춤형 비상 알림 시스템
abstract_ko: 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 AI 기반 맞춤형 비상 알림 앱에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 AI 기반 맞춤형 경보, 긴급 구조 요청 자동화, 대피소 및 AED 위치 안내, 다국어 및 수어 지원의 기능을 제공한다. 특히, AI 알고리즘을 활용하여 사용자 개인의 위치, 행동 패턴, 선호도를 학습하고 이를 기반으로 불필요한 알림을 최소화하며, 중요한 경보만 선별적으로 제공한다. 긴급 상황 발생 시, 단일 버튼 조작만으로 구조대에 위치 정보와 상황이 자동으로 전달되어 신속한 구조 요청이 가능하다. 또한, 사용자에게 재난 상황에 맞는 색상, 진동, 플래시 패턴을 통해 직관적인 정보를 제공하여 재난 인지 속도를 높인다. 대피소와 AED 위치 정보는 실시간으로 업데이트되며, 다국어 번역과 수어 영상 지원으로 외국인 및 청각장애인의 접근성을 대폭 향상시킨다. 이러한 기능을 통해 재난 대응에서의 정보 접근성을 높이고, 보다 안전하고 신속한 대처를 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Detachable braking apparatus for manual wheelchair
title_ko: 수동형 휠체어를 위한 탈부착형 제동 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수동형 휠체어를 위한 탈부착형 제동 장치를 개시한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 하나 이상의 센서를 이용하여 상기 휠체어의 기울기 및 가속도가 미리 설정된 임계값을 초과하는지 비상상황인지 여부를 판단하여 모터 구동을 제어하는 회로부; 상기 휠체어의 2개의 손잡이 기둥 사이에 장착되어 상기 회로부 및 모터를 거치하는 장착부; 상기 휠체어의 두 개의 바퀴에 각각에 배치되며, 비상상황인 경우 상기 모터의 구동에 따라 상기 바퀴에 압착되는 브레이크 패드를 포함하는 제1 및 제2 림 브레이크; 및 상기 일측이 휠체어의 2개의 등받이 및 팔걸이 기둥에 장착되고 타측이 상기 림 브레이크를 고정하는 제1 및 제2 브레이크 고정부를 포함하는 수동형 휠체어를 위한 탈부착형 제동 장치가 제공된다.

title_en: Directional sound system with messaging
abstract_en: An exit path indicating device incorporates at least a first port for receiving an alarm indicating signal. In normal operation upon receipt of the alarm indicating signal, the device outputs verbal and non-verbal indicators of the presence of an alarm condition for use in evacuating the region. A second port disables the non-verbal outputs. The second port can be coupled to a local sensor which provides an indication of a hazardous or alarm condition adjacent to or on the exit or egress path. If the sensor is indicating the presence of a hazardous or alarm condition, the non-verbal outputs can be disabled, while verbal directions can continue to be emitted.
abstract_ko:
비상구지시장치가 경보지시신호를 수신하기 위한 적어도 제1 포트를 갖는다. 경보지시신호를 수신할 때 정상작동시에, 장치는 대피를 위하여 경보상황의 존재를 알리는 언어 및 비언어지시를 출력한다. 제2 포트가 비언어출력을 작동시키지 않는다. 제2 포트는 비상구 또는 이에 인접하여 위험 또는 경보상황을 나타내도록 지역감지기에 결합될 수 있다. 감지기가 위험 또는 경보상황의 존재를 나타내는 경우, 비언어출력이 작동되지 않는 반면에 방향지시 언어가 계속하여 발생될 수 있다. 
       
     경보시스템, 방향지시 언어메시지.

title_en: Luminaires for emergency exit sings control system
title_ko: 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어시스템
abstract_en: A fire emergency light control system with a guiding direction display function is provided to protect precious lives of people by effectively guiding residents of a building to an exit path of the building. A fire emergency light control system with a guiding direction display function includes a fire emergency light(30) and an automatic fire detection receiver(70). The fire emergency light includes a CPU(Central Processing Unit,80), a voice output circuit, and a direction indication lamp(40), which are embedded therein. The fire emergency light is electrically(10) coupled with the receiver by a signal(20). The automatic fire detection receiver is electrically coupled with conventional sensors(50) and signal generators(60). When fire breaks out in a building, the sensor detects fire, the receiver receives a fire signal from the sensor and locates a fire site, and then the receiver generates alarm and delivers commands to the fire emergency light.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물 화재시 비상 피난을 유도하는 시스템 으로써, 기존에 사용되고 있는 통로 유도등, 피난구 유도등 및 객석 유도등에 소방용 자동화재탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)으로부터 피난 경로 유도 신호를 전달 받아 실행할 수 있는 내부연산장치(CPU)를 형성 시킴으로써, 화재 발생시 소방용 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)에 내장되어 있는 컴퓨터 시스템의 자동 연산장치(CPU)에 의해 명령을 전달받아 건물내에 있는 다수의 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템을 제공함에 있다. 현재의 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)은 고도의 산업이 발전함과 더블어 다양한 기능 및 첨단 감시 시스템을 내장하고 있으며 대부분이 컴퓨터(CPU) 시스템에 의해 제어되고 있다. 또한 보다 세밀하고 안정적으로 건물의 화재 등을 감시하기 위하여 다양한 방법들을 사용하고 있으며 특히 실시간 감시를 위하여 디지털 방식은 물론 시분할 감시 등 아날로그 방식을 통하여 건물의 보안 감시 및 화재를 감시하고 있다. 본 시스템은 이들의 기존 시스템을 활용하여 현재 제어되고 있지않는 소방용 유도등(통로유도등, 피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 제어함으로써 위험상황 발생시 이들을 유용하게 통제하여 건물내의 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있는 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템을 제공하고자 한다. 본 시스템은 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)의 주컴퓨터(CPU)에  연결되어 있는 각 구역의 감지기들의 상황을 수시로 파악하여 화재 발생시 화재 발생 지역의 감지기 위치를 인지하여 내부연산 프로그램에 의해 최적의 피난 통로를 기존의 소방용 통로유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 통하여 유도하게 되는 특징을 갖게 된다. 현재의 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)들은 상기의 감지기 위치를 어드레스(ADDRESS) 별로 관리 및 감시를 하고 있으며 화재시 화재신호 발령 및 초기 소화 장치들을 제어하고 있다. 본 시스템은 이에 추가적 으로 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신기(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)가 소방용 통로 유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 제어할 수 있도록 통로유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등 )에 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)으로 부터의 명령 및 제어를 수행할 수 있도록 내부연산장치(CPU)를 형성 시킴으로써 전체적인 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템이 완성되게 된다. 상기의 통로 유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)의 내부연산장치(CPU)는 간단한 논리적 회로인 OR 게이트의 단순한 구현으로 그 실행이 가능하다. 즉 기존의 소방용 유도등(통로유도등, 피난구유도등, 객석유도등)은 기존의 유도등 기능을 유지 하면서 유사시에 방향 표시 기능을 추가할 수 있는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 또한 상기 소방용 유도등은 화재로 인하여 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)과의 신호선이 단선될 경우에는 자동백업(back up) 기능에 의하여 피난 유도 방향 표시를 하지 않고 기존의 소방용 유도등의 기능만을 수행하게 된다. 또한 시각 장애인을 위하여 소방용 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)으로 부터 전달된 연산 신호를 소방용 유도등에 형성되어 있는 내부 연산 장치(CPU)에 의하여 실행되는 방향 표시는 물론 해당 방향으로 유도할 수 있는 음성 신호를 출력할 수 있는 기능도 내장하게 된다. 이는 해당 방향으로의 신호 접점을 유지 시켜줌 으로써 내부 연산장치(CPU)에 내장되어 있는 해당 음성 신호를 일측에 형성된 스피커를 통하여 출력할 수 있게 된다. 
       
     통로 유도등(피난구유도등,객석유도등), 연상장치(CPU), 어드레스(ADDRESS), 자동화재 탐지설비, 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반), R형 수신반, 접점, 피난계획, 규정중심, 성능위주, 피난경로, 피난동선, 페닉(PANIC), 추종본능, 회귀본능

title_en: Evacuation assistance device for elevator
abstract_en: In a building, a service zone including a plurality of floors is set. The building is provided with an elevator that is assigned to the floors in the service zone as service floors. In an event of a fire in the building, an evacuation support apparatus for the elevator controls the operation of the elevator to convey those stranded in the building to an evacuation floor. The evacuation support apparatus has an emergency control device and an evacuation guidance device. The emergency control device has a rescue floor setting portion for setting at least a predetermined one of the service floors as a rescue floor, and an evacuation operation command portion for controlling the elevator such that evacuation operation is performed to vertically reciprocate a car between the rescue floor and the evacuation floor. The evacuation guidance device is installed in the building to impart to those stranded in the building evacuation information including information for specifying the rescue floor, based on information from the emergency control device.
abstract_ko: 건물에는 복수의 층을 포함하는 서비스 존이 설정되어 있다. 또, 건물에는 서비스 존내의 각 층을 서비스 층으로 하는 엘리베이터가 마련되어 있다. 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 건물에 화재가 발생했을 때에, 건물 내에 남겨진 재관자를 피난층에 운반하도록 엘리베이터의 운전을 관리한다. 피난 지원 장치는 피난시 관리 장치 및 피난 유도 장치를 갖고 있다. 피난시 관리 장치는 서비스 존에 대하여 소정의 서비스 층을 구출층으로서 설정하는 구출층 설정부와, 구출층과 피난층 사이에서 엘리베이터 칸을 왕복 이동시키는 피난 운전을 행하도록 엘리베이터를 제어하는 피난 운전 지령부를 갖고 있다. 피난 유도 장치는 건물내에 설치되고, 피난시 관리 장치로부터의 정보에 기초하여, 구출층을 특정하기 위한 정보를 포함하는 피난 정보를 재관자에게 알린다.

title_en: Evacuation assistance device for elevator
abstract_en: A building is provided with an elevator and evacuation stairs. Each floor is separated into an elevator region in which the elevator is provided and a stair region in which the evacuation stairs are provided. In an event of a fire in the building, an evacuation assistance device for the elevator sets a predetermined service floor as a rescue floor, and supervises an operation of the elevator so as to convey those stranded in the building from the rescue floor to an evacuation floor. A rescue floor crowdedness detecting device detects crowdedness or uncrowdedness of the elevator region at the rescue floor. An evacuation guidance device for reporting to those stranded in the building accessibility information representing the accessibility of those stranded in the building to the elevator region at the rescue floor from the stair region is installed in the building. Information from the rescue floor crowdedness detecting device is transmitted to an emergency control device. The emergency control device has an evacuation operation performability determining portion for determining whether or not those stranded in the building can be conveyed from the rescue floor to the evacuation floor, and an evacuation guidance device control portion for controlling the evacuation guidance device based on information from the evacuation operation performability determining portion and the information from the rescue floor crowdedness detecting device.
abstract_ko: 건물에는 엘리베이터와 피난 계단이 마련되어 있다. 각 층은 엘리베이터가 마련된 엘리베이터 영역과, 피난 계단이 마련된 계단 영역오로 구분되어 있다. 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 건물에 화재가 발생했을 때에, 소정의 서비스층을 구출층으로 하고, 재관자를 구출층으로부터 피난층으로 운반하도록 엘리베이터 운전을 관리한다. 구출층에서는 엘리베이터 영역의 혼잡 유무가 구출층 혼잡 검출 장치에 의해 검출된다. 건물내에는 계단 영역으로부터 구출층의 엘리베이터 영역으로 재관자의 진입 가부를 나타내는 진입 가부 정보를 재관자에게 알리는 피난 유도 장치가 마련되어 있다. 구출층 혼잡 검출 장치로부터의 정보는 피난시 관리 장치에 전송된다. 피난시 관리 장치는 구출층으로부터 피난층으로의 운반 가부를 판정하는 피난 운전 가부 판정부와, 피난 운전 가부 판정부 및 구출층 혼잡 검출 장치 각각으로부터의 정보에 기초하여, 피난 유도 장치를 제어하는 피난 유도 장치 제어부를 갖고 있다.

title_en: Vehicle adapted to evacuation life
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow an elderly or an infant who needs nursing care or a physically-disabled person or its family to lead an evacuation life feeling relieved without worrying about surroundings by connecting a vehicle for use in evacuation to a bed when a disaster strikes.  <P>SOLUTION: The vehicle adapted to an evacuation life comprises: a hatchback type vehicle 1 in which a cargo fixing frame 14 is mounted on a rooftop 11; a bed 2 connected to the backside of the vehicle; and a tent 3 for covering the bed 2 after being connected. The bed 2 is formed in a folded form so as to be loaded on the rooftop 11. The vehicle 1 and the bed 2 are connected by using a connecting frame 15 mounted on the backside of the vehicle and a locking plate 22 mounted on the front side of the bed so that a floor 13 of the vehicle 1 and a mat body 29 of the bed 2 may be flush with each other.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title_en: The raised block combined with induce lamp for evacuation
abstract_en: A light-embedded raised block for the blind is provided to help the blind to evacuate in an emergency by storing lighting and supplying lighting for a long time in case of an emergency. A light-embedded raised block for the blind comprises a raised block(10) made of a transparent panel or a semitransparent panel, where a protrusion unit(11) is formed on an upper surface and a groove(12) are formed on a lower surface, and an emergency device including a plurality of LEDs(13), a solar battery plate(14), a sensor, a circuit plate(17) on which a microchip(15) is installed and a battery(18).

title_en: Apparatus for guiding into emergency exit without man and control method therefor
abstract_en: An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit is provided to switch on and off a high-brightness lamp installed at an emergency guide lamp and concentrate the light to guide the emergency exit effectively. An unmanned guide device for an emergency exit connected to a fire alarm system(20) detecting a fire and outputting alarm sound is composed of an interface unit(30) receiving an emergency sensing signal transmitted from the fire alarm system; a memory(200) storing voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit; an auditory guiding unit(300), converting voice guidance data about the emergency state and the emergency exit stored in the memory, into a voice signal if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit and then outputting the voice signal; a visual guiding unit(400) turning on and off a lamp(410) if the emergency sensing signal is transmitted through the interface unit; a control unit(100) detecting data in the memory by receiving the emergency sensing signal transmitted through the interface unit, transmitting the data to the auditory guiding unit, transmitting a control signal for switching on and off the lamp to the visual guiding unit, and carrying out operations for driving each component; and a power supply unit(500) having an emergency power unit charged with power supplied from a power source to supply the charged power to the visual and auditory guiding units.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상구 무인유도 장치 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로서, 시각장애인이나 시력이 좋지 못한 대상에게 비상사태 및 비상구를 음성으로 안내하고, 비상구를 안내하는 유도등의 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     상기 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명은, 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 화재경보시스템으로부터 비상감지신호를 전송받아 그에 대응되는 신호를 출력하여 각 구성요소를 작동시키는 제어부와, 비상사태 및 비상구 음성안내 데이터가 사전 저장된 메모리와, 메모리에 사전 저장된 비상사태 및 비상구 안내 데이터를 음성신호로 변환출력하여 비상사태 발생시 시각장애인들의 대피를 돕는 청각유도수단과, 램프에서 발산되는 빛을 점멸 및 집광시킴으로써 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하기 위한 시각유도수단, 및 평상시에 상용전원으로부터 전원을 공급받아 비상용 전원으로 충전하였다가, 비상사태 발생시 전원을 공급하여 청각유도수단 및 시각유도수단을 포함한 각 구성요소를 정상작동시키기 위한 비상전원부를 포함하는 전원공급수단으로 이루어진다. 
       
     음성안내, 청각유도수단, 비상전원부, 무인유도

title_en: Evacuation device adapted to wheelchair
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve issues that conventional evacuation tools and devices require a plurality of pieces of care taking for evacuation and are physically hard to use for a wheelchair user in a disaster.  <P>SOLUTION: An evacuee rides in a basket while riding on a wheelchair and the basket descends in a suitable speed. Thus the evacuee can be safely evacuated.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Evacuation assistance device for elevator
abstract_en: In an emergency, an evacuation assistance device for an elevator serving multiple floors manages operation of the elevator to thereby allow people left in a building to evacuate to an evacuation floor. Also, the evacuation assistance device has an evacuation-operation execution section, an evacuation-operation-time calculation section, and an evacuation-operation determination section. The evacuation-operation execution section sets at least some of the multiple served floors as the evacuation floor and causes the elevator to perform evacuation operation for carrying the people left in the building from rescue floors to the evacuation floor. Upon receiving emergency degree information indicating the degree of emergency, the evacuation-operation-time calculation section calculates, based on the information, an estimated time period in which the evacuation operation continues. The emergency-operation determination section determines, based on the information from the evacuation-operation-time calculation section, whether the evacuation operation is to be continued. The evacuation-operation execution section controls the evacuation operation based on the information from the emergency-operation determination section.
abstract_ko: 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 복수의 층을 서비스층으로 하는 엘리베이터의 운전을 긴급시에 관리하는 것에 의해, 건물내에 남겨진 재관자를 피난층에 피난시킨다. 또, 엘리베이터의 피난 지원 장치는 피난 운전 실시부, 피난 운전 시간 산출부 및 피난 운전 판정부를 갖고 있다. 피난 운전 실시부는 각 서비스층의 적어도 어느 하나를 구출층으로 설정하고, 재관자를 구출층으로부터 피난층으로 운반하기 위한 피난 운전을 엘리베이터에 대해 실시한다. 피난 운전 시간 산출부는 긴급의 정도를 나타내는 긴급도 정보를 받는 동시에, 긴급도 정보에 기초하여 피난 운전을 계속할 예정 시간을 피난 운전 시간으로서 산출한다. 피난 운전 판정부는 피난 운전 시간 산출부로부터의 정보에 기초하여 피난 운전의 계속 여부를 판정한다. 피난 운전 실시부는 피난 운전 판정부로부터의 정보에 기초하여 피난 운전을 제어한다.

title_en: Assembly base and dropping mouth
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency public toilet which enables a disaster victim to quickly assemble it and start using it, has a function also helpful for local people in normal times, is excellently durable, and has devices that allow a large number of disaster victims including the disabled to use safely and hygienically when a serious disaster happens in an evacuation area or nearer there when the serious disaster causing great damage to supply of water and electricity and transportation happens.  <P>SOLUTION: In normal times, the toilet functions as an artful stone mosaic flower pot or a bench, whereas when a disaster happens, it can be assembled into a toilet. Since it is made of stone, it is durable for decades' use and can store all toilet assembly equipment in a lower layer inner part of the flower pot or a storage space below a top panel of the bench in an excellent state. In an emergency, an existing manhole is used as a toilet tank, the equipment taken out of the storage space is instantly assembled above it, and used as a toilet.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: The portable lighting apparatus
abstract_en: A portable lighting apparatus is provided to guide safe driving of a disabled car by being mounted on a surface of the disabled car to secure a driver's visual field. A portable lighting apparatus includes a lighting unit(100) and a support(200). The lighting unit selectively turns on an LED(Light Emitting Diode) lamp, an induction lamp, and a flashlight of a light emitting unit(130) by using power charged in a battery according to control of a switch. The support is composed of a support member(210) to receive and support the lighting unit, a charging terminal(220) protruded inside the support member to ground the battery, and a position indicating lamp(230) installed at one side of the support member.

title_en: Evacuation system which uses the strobe light and an alarm sound
abstract_en: An evacuation guiding system is provided to enable users to quickly evacuate a dangerous situation by guiding the users to escape using both visual and audio signals. An evacuation guiding system includes a driving body(15), which includes a controller and a power supply and is implemented on an implementation surface. The driving body includes a semi-transparent or transparent light emitting surface(151), on which a guiding lamp(22) is arranged. The light from the guiding lamp is emitted to outside. One side of the light emitting surface is coupled with the driving body. A visual alarm lamp(32) and an alarm speaker(42) are installed on the other side of the light emitting surface.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피난유도 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 피난을 유도하기 위한 유도램프(22)가 제어부(10)의 제어에 의하여 유도용 빛이 발광되도록 구비되어지되, 상기 제어부(10)에서 시각경보제어부(31) 및 음향경보제어부(41)가 작동하도록 구비함에, 상기 시각경보제어부(31)는 상기 제어부(10)로부터 시각경보램프(32)의 점등 제어신호를 수신받아 시각경보램프(32)를 점등되도록 하며, 상기 음향경보제어부(41)는 상기 제어부(10)로부터 음향경보 제어신호를 수신받아 음향경보용 음향신호가 경보스피커(42)에서 발신되도록 구비되어, 밝은 빛을 보고 안내음향을 들으면서 피난자들, 특히 청각장애인 및 시각장애인들이 용이하게 피난할 수 있도록 하는 시청각 복합형 피난유도 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
       
     피난유도, 램프, 스피커, 시각, 음향
assignees: CN EGS CO LTD;KOREAN FIRE PROT ASS

title_en: Caregiver personal alert device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable caregiver personal alert device to facilitate the improvement in the delivery of bedside patient care. The device assists caregivers in ensuring time-sensitive tasks are performed within a specific time frame and in a specific sequence to ensure efficiency, compliance with standard of care or regulation and patient comfort. The device of the present invention comprises a display, a microprocessor that monitors various tasks for multiple patients, and at least one user input feature and at least one alarm, capable of alerting a caregiver when it is time to perform the task. The device preferably includes various functions such as a bed assignment mode, a task mode for choosing applicable tasks associated with the needs of one or more bed numbers, and at least one clock for coordinating a plurality of alarms to one or more corresponding bed number and associated task.
assignees: LEVY GLENN;NIGHTINGALE PRODUCT LLC;Nightingale Products LLC

title_en: A push and pull door lock body
abstract_en: A bidirectional push-pull door lock body including a driving circulation unit is provided to conveniently open a door together with a locking cancel of a mortise by pushing/pulling an operation lever having a bidirectional circulation function. An operation lever(60) is combined with door lock bodies(10a,10b,10c,10d) of an indoor and outdoor side closed by a cover member(15). One side of the door lock body of an indoor and outdoor side is coupled with a hinge. A connection circulation body is circulated into up/down direction by combining in a bottom of the operation lever. A slide member(30) is installed at an inner side of the door lock body, has a to-and-fro motion corresponding to the connection circulation. A driving circulation unit operates a driving part within a mortise for a locking cancel of the mortise. The driving circulation unit is installed at the inner side of the door lock body, and is connected to the mortise for a locking unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도어의 측단면에 삽착되는 잠금장치인 모티스와 연결된 상태로 도어의 내,외측에 설치 고정되어 도어의 열림방향 및 이와 관련되어 도어 오픈을 위한 도어락 바디의 내부장치 변경이나 별도의 설정없이 푸시(Push) 및 당김(Pull)의 양방향 회동이 가능하게 설치된 도어락 바디의 작동레버를 밀거나 당겨서 모티스의 락킹 해제를 이루는 양방향 푸시풀 도어락 바디에 관한 것이다. 
     이러한 본 발명의 양방향 푸시풀 도어락 바디는, 커버부재에 의해 밀폐된 실내측 및 실외측 도어락 바디와 결합되며, 힌지 결합된 상단을 지점으로 하단의 푸시(Push)와 당김(Pull) 작용이 병용되도록 이루어진 혼용적 구조의 작동레버와; 상기 실내외측 도어락 바디의 일측에 각각 힌지 결합되며, 작동레버의 하단과 결합되어 상기 작동레버 작동 시 상,하로 회동되는 연결회동체와; 상기 연결회동체의 일측에 결합된 상태로 실내외측 도어락 바디의 내측에 설치되며, 연결회동체와 대응되어 직선왕복운동을 하는 슬라이드부재와; 상기 슬라이드부재의 일측과 연결된 상태로 실외측 도어락 바디의 내측에 설치됨과 동시에 상기 실내외측 도어락 바디 사이에 설치된 잠금장치용 모티스와 연결되며, 슬라이드부재와 대응되어 회동하면서 상기 모티스의 락킹 해제를 위해 모티스 내의 구동부를 작동시키는 구동회동체를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     따라서 본 발명에 의하면, 랫치부재의 슬라이드 작용에 한정된 모티스와 더불어 별도의 장금장치를 구비하면서 작동레버가 각기 일방향으로만 회동되는 종래 의 도어락 바디에 비해 도어의 열림방향 및 이와 관련되어 도어 오픈을 위한 도어락 바디의 내부장치 변경이나 별도의 설정없이 혼용적 구조로서 푸시(Push) 및 당김(Pull)의 양방향 회동이 가능하게 설치된 작동레버를 밀거나 당겨서 모티스의 락킹 해제와 함께 간편하게 도어를 오픈시킬 수 있으며, 특히 노약자나 몸이 불편한 장애인 또는 화재 등 긴급 비상 시 실내측 사용자의 신체 어느 부위를 이용하더라도 혼용적 구조의 작동레버를 간편하게 작동시킬 수 있기 때문에 이에 대한 락킹된 도어의 오픈시간 및 실내측 사용자의 대피시간을 크게 단축시킬 수 있는 등의 탁월한 효과가 있다. 
       
     양방향 푸시풀 도어락, 도어락 바디, 작동레버, 푸시(Push) 및 당김(Pull) 병용, 연결회동체, 슬라이드부재, 구동회동체, 연결핀, 모티스, 해정키

title_en: Channel type live-saving equipment for quickly falling from building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high building lifesaving device, in particular to a fast high building lifesaving device, i.e., a passage type high building fast-falling lifesaving device which adopts the technique scheme that a passage type high building fast-falling lifesaving device is arranged on an extended body, and structurally comprises a tube-shaped passage, wherein a passage inflatable ring is arranged at the top of the tube-shaped passage in which a buffering inflatable body is arranged. A floor buffering inflatable cushion is arranged at the bottom of the tube-shaped passage. A landing device matched with the tube-shaped passage in diameter after being unfolded is provided. The device is pre-installed at an evacuation passage of a high building and can be equipped and maintained by the fire department or professionals. In case of fire, earthquake or other emergencies in the high building, firemen or professionals arrive at the spot, and the device is opened for use. The high building lifesaving device is not restricted by the height of the high building, and people can safely fall down in the descending passage to escape. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable design and low cost, and is suitable for popularization and can be used by various people, such as the old, the young, the sick and the disabled.

title_en: Threat based adaptable network and physical security system
abstract_en: A security system (200) for a network, including a security system interface (220) configured to respond to a received threat level, and a computing module (230) configured to determine whether the received threat level exceeds a threshold value (560) assigned to the network, wherein the network is modified (570) upon a determination that the threat level exceeds the threshold value. Further including a similar threat based modification security system (200) for monitoring communication and physical facilities. Where a threat level (222) is compared (460) against assigned threshold values to determine if physical security devices should be activated or communications systems disabled (470).

title_en: Container for hospitalization or the like and correspondence system for the time of emergency using the container
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a container for hospitalization by which a blood type, a medical history or the like can be presented to a person involved in medical treatment such as a doctor, or individual information such a name can be presented to a firefighter or the like, and which is useful for the preparation of appurtenances required for hospitalization and the evacuation in the case of disaster, and to provide a correspondence system for the time of emergency.  <P>SOLUTION: The container for the hospitalization or the like comprises the container 1 for the hospitalization for sectioning and storing various kinds of equipment such as livingware needed by elderly people or people with a chronic disease when getting hospitalized or needed by people when a natural disaster occurs, and a display card provided on the container 1 for entering items required for treatment such as the medical history and the blood type or individual information such as a name, an address and a contact. By always keeping the display card 7 which is provided on the conspicuous position of the container 1 and on which the items required for treatment such as the medical history and the blood type or the individual information such as a name, an address and a contact is entered, and reporting the condition of the person always keeping the container 1 for the hospitalization or the like to a fire department or the like and executing central management, correspondence is performed for the time of emergency hospitalization and for the time of the natural disaster.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Make flicker display or multi-flicker display and a short sound of function a fire detector
title_ko: 화재감지기 작동시의 점멸등 또는 다수 점멸등 및 단음부착형 화재감지기
abstract_en: A make flicker display or a multi-flicker display and a short sound of a function in a fire detector is provided to allow a user to put out a fire in rapidly by informing a fire through a sound and a visual display. In a make flicker display or a multi-flicker display and a short sound of a function in a fire detector, a fire detector(70) senses smoke and heat when a fire out breaks. A lighting light emitting diode is displayed when a gate signal turned on. A current is flowed between the anode and the cathode of a thyristor(60) when the gate signal is turned on, and a relay(10), a sensor circuit terminal, and a relay are interlinked with each other.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재감지기 작동시의 점멸등 또는 다수 점멸등 및 단음 부착형 화재감지기에 관한 것으로서, 이를 위하여 본 발명은 화재감지부(70)와, 화재감지기 시험스위치(7)와, 사이리스터(60)의 게이트(G) 회로와, 사이리스터(60)의 애노드(A)및 캐소드(K)간의 회로와, 점등 발광다이오드(6)와, 다이오드브릿지(30)회로와, 릴레이(10)와, 감지기 회로선(3, 4)의 단자로서 이루어지는 자동화재탐지설비의 화재감지기 작동시 점등되는 점등 부착형 화재감지기에 있어서, 상기 화재감지부(70)와 화재감지기 시험스위치(7)와 사이리스터(60)와 점등 발광다이오드(6)와 다이오드브릿지(30)와 릴레이(10)의 전방과 후방에 구비되는 점멸등(300) 또는 다수 점멸등 순차점멸등(400) 및 단음외 음성소자(500) 등과; 상기 화재감지기(5)의 외부 겉면 등에 구비되는 점멸등(300) 또는 다수 점멸등 순차점멸등(400) 및 단음외 음성소자(500) 등을 포함하는 구성에 의해 각 구역의 화재감지기 가운데 작동된 화재감지기를 현장에서 조기발견해야 하고 신속하게 화재여부를 탐색해야 하는 방재요원의 업무가 향상됨은 물론 작동된 화재감지기의 현장주변에서 활동하고 있을 수 있는 일반인 또는 노약자 및 장애인도 현장에서 바로 알수 있도록 되어 화재의 조기발견이 가능하고 바로 진화 및 대피가 가능하도록 되므로서 귀중한 인명과 재산의 손실을 방지되도록 하는데 특징이 있다. 
       
     화재감지기, 발광다이오드, 점등, 점멸등, 다수 점멸등 순차점멸등, 단음외 음성소자

title_en: Light emitting block using piezoelectric ceramics
abstract_en: A radiation block using the electrostrictive ceramics is provided to quickly make people induce to a safe shelter by lighting a luminous unit in an emergency. A radiation block using the electrostrictive ceramics comprises a lower part main body(10), an electrostrictive ceramics unit(20), a rechargeable battery(30), a luminous unit(40) and a controller(50). The radiation block includes a top main body(60), a pressure projection board(70) and a tempered glass member(80). The top of the lower part main body is open. A space unit(11) is formed in the inside. A combining projection(12) is equipped on the floor side of the lower part main body. The rechargeable battery is electrically connected to the electrostrictive ceramics unit. The luminous unit is electrically connected to the rechargeable battery and installed inside the space unit. The controller is installed inside the space unit, and electrically connected to the rechargeable battery and the luminous unit. The controller controls the flash of the luminous unit. A penetration slit(61) is formed at one side of upper surface of the top main body. A display(62) is formed at the other side of upper surface of the top main body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 햇빛이 들지 않는 실내에 설치되되 다수의 압전세라믹을 구비하여 오고가는 행인이 가압함에 따라 전기에너지를 발생하여 충전시킨 후, 화재 또는 정전 등 비상 상황 시에 충전된 전기에너지를 통해 비상구의 위치를 파악할 수 있는 발광유닛을 점등시켜 안전하고 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있으며, 돌출 형성되는 가압돌기판을 통해 장애인의 안전한 보행을 유도할 수 있는 한 압전세라믹을 이용한 발광블럭에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 압전세라믹을 이용한 발광블럭은 상부가 개방되고 내부에 공간부가 형성되며 바닥면에 결합돌기가 구비되는 하부본체와, 상기 결합돌기 내에 설치되는 압전세라믹유닛과, 상기 공간부 내에 설치되고 상기 압전세라믹유닛과 전기적으로 연결되는 충전지와, 상기 충전지와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 공간부 내에 점멸가능하게 설치되는 발광유닛과, 상기 공간부 내에 설치되고 상기 충전지 및 발광유닛과 전기적으로 연결되며 상기 발광유닛의 점멸을 제어하는 제어부와, 상기 하부본체의 상측에 결합되되, 상부면의 일측에는 상기 압전세라믹유닛이 돌출 위치되도록 관통슬릿이 형성되고, 타측에는 상기 발광유닛으로부터 발산되는 빛이 외부로 노출되도록 표시창이 관통 형성되는 상부본체와, 상기 관통슬릿에 기밀적으로 결합되고, 그 하부면이 상기 압전세라믹유닛의 상부면과 면접하게 배치되는 가압돌기판과, 상기 표시창에 기밀적으로 결합되는 강화유리부재를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     압전세라믹, 발광블럭, 상부본체, 하부본체, 충전지, 발광유닛, 제어부, 가압돌기판, 강화유리부재

title_en: Character display function speaker
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 문자정보 표시기능이 내장된 음성출력스피커
abstract_en: A character display function speaker for an auditory disabled person is provided to easily inform an auditory disabled person of a current situation by using voice and character broadcasting. A voice output speaker displaying character information for an auditory disabled person comprises rack broadcasting equipment(100). The rack broadcasting equipment comprises a character information generator(55) generating a character according to a kind of broadcasting. The broadcasting information generated by the character information generator is loaded to a sound source outputted from a sound source amplifier in an FSK(Frequency Shift Keying) mode. The sound source of the sound source amplifier including broadcast information of the character information generator is outputted to a character display speaker(110). The character display speaker outputs the character information to a character display panel(113). The character display speaker outputs voice to a speaker(114). The character display panel displays a green lamp(112) during a normal broadcast and a red lamp(111) during an emergency broadcast.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 청각장애인이 거주하는 건물 내에 화재와 같은 비상 재난상황이 발생하면, 신속히 청각장애인이 인식할 수 있도록 비상등과 문자정보로 비상상황을 전달하는 스피커 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 일반방송이나 화재와 같은 비상상황이 감지되면 시설 내에 설치되어 있는 방송 스피커를 통하여 대피방송과 더불어 스피커에 내장된 문자표시창을 통하여 지금 방송이 일반방송인지, 비상방송인지를 구분하여 문자 표시와 비상등을 통하여 청각장애인이 그 상황을 파악하기 용이하게 하여, 화재시 얼마든지 발생할 수 있는 대형 참사를 사전에 예방할 수 있게 된다. 
       
     문자정보 스피커, 청각장애인용 문자정보 스피커, 비상방송 문자 서비스

title_en: Escape rope for disaster
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an escape rope for a disaster, enabling two or more evacuees including small children, elderly people and the sick to be quickly and smoothly evacuated in the case of a fire at the second or higher floor of a building.  <P>SOLUTION: Axilla belts are provided at both ends of a rope, respectively, through a speed governor, whereby when an evacuee descends using one rope, the other rope is wound up so that the ropes are alternately moved up and down to enable two or more evacuees to quickly descend and be evacuated.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: High-rise escape sliding plate
abstract_en: The effective rescue and emergent escape for high-rise fire become social problems highly concerned by people, main innovation contents of the invention are to fully concern the optimal matching problem of high-rise fire-fighting equipment and reform a high-rise rubbish pipeline into a multifunctional emergent escape and rescue passage which consists of a vertical well mouth passage and enter gateways of various floors in the whole shape; and main members of the multifunctional emergent escape and rescue passage consist of a two-layer sliding plate, a spiral sliding rail well wall and two multifunctional vertical bars. The invention has the advantages that: (1) with multiple functions, the invention is used as a common rubbish pipe at normal times and not idle to waste; (2) with the simple structure and low cost, the invention can be applied to industrial production; (3) with absolute safety, the invention is suitable for self rescue of old, weak, sick and disabled groups; (4) the invention does not need operation technology and is suitable for cowards; (5) the height of the floor is not limited; (6) the invention is free from being reduced to the bottom once from high floors and can be changed in the midway for evacuation; (7) the operation is quite simple, so the push and placement of one person can be finished in 10 seconds, and the volume is large, so more than 200 persons on one floor can be evacuated in several minutes; (8) the service life is long and the overhaul and the maintaining are not needed; and (9) the invention is easy to be harmonious with the building design, has attractive appearance and is easy to be hidden.

title_en: Evacuation assistance system
abstract_en:
Provided is an evacuation supporting system which can provide elevators in a building as evacuation means in the event of a fire and can substantially reduce the burden required by the rescue at the site of the fire by providing, before the arrival of firemen at the building, the firemen with information on the evacuation condition of the weak and the condition of evacuation of those who are present in the building carried out by use of the elevators. 
     For this purpose, in an ancillary room within the building, there is installed an evacuation detection device which is used by disaster preventing staff in a disaster prevention center within the building to check for persons who have escaped into the ancillary room. When a fire has been detected by a fire detector, the elevators in the building are provided as evacuation means for those who are present in the building, and the input status of the evacuation detection device and the evacuation operation condition of the elevator are transmitted to an external computer environment.
abstract_ko:
화재 발생시에 빌딩 내의 엘리베이터를 피난 수단으로서 제공할 수 있음과 아울러 소방원이 그 빌딩에 도착하기 전에, 약자의 피난 상황이나 엘리베이터를 이용한 재관자의 피난 상황을 소방원에게 제공하여, 화재 발생 현장에서의 구출에 요구되는 부담을 큰 폭으로 경감시킬 수 있는 피난 지원 시스템을 제공한다.  
이를 위해, 빌딩 내의 부속실에, 빌딩 내의 방재 센터에 있는 방재원이 부속실에 피난한 사람을 확인하기 위한 피난 검출 장치를 설치한다. 그리고, 화재 감지기에 의해 화재가 감지된 경우에, 빌딩 내의 엘리베이터를 재관자의 피난용으로서 제공하고, 또한, 피난 검출 장치의 입력 상황과 엘리베이터의 피난 운전 상황을 외부의 계산기 환경에 대해서 송신한다.

title_en: The raised block combined with induce lamp for evacuation
Apparatus for guiding into emergency exit without man
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 비상구 무인유도 장치에 관한 것으로서, 시각장애인이나 시력이 좋지 못한 대상에게 비상사태 및 비상구를 음성으로 안내하고, 비상구를 안내하는 유도등의 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
     상기 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 고안은, 유선 또는 무선으로 연결된 화재경보시스템으로부터 비상감지신호를 전송받아 그에 대응되는 신호를 출력하여 각 구성요소를 작동시키는 제어부와, 비상사태 및 비상구 음성안내 데이터가 사전 저장된 메모리와, 메모리에 사전 저장된 비상사태 및 비상구 안내 데이터를 음성신호로 변환출력하여 비상사태 발생시 시각장애인들의 대피를 돕는 청각유도수단과, 램프에서 발산되는 빛을 점멸 및 집광시킴으로써 램프 식별을 더욱 용이하게 하기 위한 시각유도수단, 및 평상시에 상용전원으로부터 전원을 공급받아 비상용 전원으로 충전하였다가, 비상사태 발생시 전원을 공급하여 청각유도수단 및 시각유도수단을 포함한 각 구성요소를 정상작동시키기 위한 비상전원부를 포함하는 전원공급수단으로 이루어진다. 
       
     음성안내, 청각유도수단, 비상전원부, 무인유도

title_en: A fire escape for an emergency staircase
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire escape apparatus for emergency staircase is provided to enable the elderly, pregnant, and disabled persons to move to a safe place by installing a cart in the emergency staircase and to discharge poisonous gas using an induction damper installed at each stair. CONSTITUTION: A fire escape apparatus for emergency staircase comprises: a rack gear which is included on the upper side of the banister of the staircase and interlinks up and down stairs of the emergency staircase; a pinion gear which is installed on a shield case(230) and in which a flange is formed in both sides; a driving gear which is combined to the pinion gear and is installed inside the shield case; a driven gear; a braking device which is combined with the shaft of the driven gear; a separable a seat back which is separable from a seat board(203) and a foot rest(205); a safety belt which is connected to a loop and a hook; and a cart(200) including a supporting roller which is settled on a guide rail(340).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상계단용 화재 대피장치에 관한 것으로, 각층에 구성된 비상구와 연결된 비상계단실에 있어서, 상기 비상계단실에 급배기장치를 가지고, 상기 비상계단실의 윗층 계단과 아랫층 계단을 연결하는 계단난간의 상부면에 형성된 랙기어와, 상기 랙기어와 치합되도록 보호케이스에 축으로 설치되고, 양측면에 플랜지가 형성된 피니언기어와, 상기 피니언기어와 축으로 결합되어 보호케이스 내부에 설치되는 구동기어와, 상기 구동기어와 치합되어 구동기어 직하부에 설치되는 종동기어와, 상기 종동기어의 축과 결합되어 보호케이스 내부에 설치되는 브레이크장치와, 상기 보호케이스의 일측면에 설치된 사각파이프와 경첩으로 설치되어, 대피자들이 탑승하여 좌석에 착석하도록 하는 좌판과, 상기 보호케이스의 일측면에 설치된 사각파이프와 경첩으로 설치되고, 상기 좌판의 위치보다 낮게 설치되어 좌판과 연결봉으로 연결된 발받침대와, 상기 좌판의 후방에 분리가능하도록 설치되는 등받이와, 상기 보호케이스 일측면에는 운행 중 탑승객을 보호하도록 설치되는 안전벨트와, 상기 보호케이스의 계단난간 측 측면에는, 상기 계단난간에 설치되는 가이드레일에 안착되어 구르도록 설치되는 보조롤러가 구비된 카트를 포함하여 구성된다. 
       
     화재, 비상, 카트

title_en: Elevator system
abstract_en: Provided is an elevator system which enables efficient evacuation using an elevator when a fire occurs, and enables the confirmation of the situation of remaining evacuees when the evacuation operation of the elevator is stopped.  An evacuation call response sequence setting unit (43) sets the priority sequences for responses to evacuation-only calls registered with an evacuation-only call registration unit (26) on the basis of fire occurrence information received by a fire situation reception unit (22), and selects a response floor on the basis of the priority sequences.  An evacuation operation execution unit (44) controls the operation of the elevator in such a manner that a cage (11) goes to the selected response floor.  When an evacuation operation enable/disable determination unit (42) determines that an evacuation operation is disabled, an evacuation operation end unit (45) causes an evacuation-only call remaining floor display unit (28) to display floors on which the remaining evacuation-only calls are registered.
assignees: IWATA MASAFUMI;KAWAI KIYOJI;KODERA TOSHIYUKI;KONISHI MASAHIKO;MITSUBIHI ELECTRIC CORP;MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC CORP;MIYAJIMA AKIHISA

title_en: Evacuation device for balcony
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation door by which anybody, irrespective of age and physical strength, can take a posture for safely stepping onto an evacuation ladder, risk and scary emotions are alleviated even in a tensed mental condition, hazard preventive measures are taken even at normal times, a locking function is provided, and a balcony space or an appearance of a building is not spoiled.  <P>SOLUTION: The evacuation door is structured to be horizontally pushed out forward to the outdoors, by which an evacuee can move out ahead to the outdoors in a front-facing posture without taking difficult actions like lifting the body or turning around. Thus, anybody like elderly people or children can step onto the evacuation ladder easily, irrespective of their physical strength or motion capability. The pushing-out type evacuation door is highly safe as the lock mechanism is provided, and hazard preventive measures are taken.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Tsunami shelter
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a tsunami shelter which enables evacuation in a short period of time before the arrival of the tsunami, in view of the fact that a coastal zone has the high tsunami risk due to an earthquake causing many lives to be lost largely because the arrival of the tsunami is faster than expected, and especially it is difficult for the aged and the disabled to evacuate to higher ground.  <P>SOLUTION: This tsunami shelter includes: a refuge container, which has an openable doorway and which can float to a water surface by maintaining a sealed state in closing; and a unit of a pair of supports (base) composed of a plurality of steel sheet piles for guarding the four corners of the container and guiding them in a vertically slidable manner. At the arrival of the tsunami, the person escapes from the tsunami by getting into the refuge container through the doorway. By this constitution, the tsunami shelter can easily be installed, while satisfying safety, convenience and inexpensiveness.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Evacuation support apparatus
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent occurrence of a disaster due to escape failure by promptly guiding inhabitants to a predetermined evacuation path in case a house has a fire, to support evacuation and rescue activities of inhabitants whose action abilities are restricted, such as elderly persons and physically handicapped persons, and to facilitate carrying-in and installation of such an evacuation support apparatus inside a house.SOLUTION: A storage tank 12, a pump 14 for pressure-feeding water stored in the storage tank 12 to a spraying nozzle 13 and a guide instruction apparatus for illuminating signs indicating guidance to an evacuation path and an evacuation direction are integrally installed in a housing 11 provided along an evacuation path in a building. In case that a fire occurs, the pump and the guide instruction apparatus are operated through a control apparatus 15, and water is discharged toward the evacuation path.

title_en: Shield apparatus for evacuation from a fire
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A shield apparatus for evacuation from a fire is provided, which enables people who can't walk to provisionally and safely evacuate until fire is suppressed. CONSTITUTION: A shield apparatus for evacuation from a fire comprises: a housing(10) in which a chamber is formed thereinside and an opening communicating with the chamber is formed in one side thereof; a sliding bed(20) which is equipped with a settling unit on which a man lies down and is installed in the housing in order to slide inside and outside the chamber; a door(25) which is made of incombustible insulating material, is fixed to the sliding bed, and opens or closes the opening of the housing; and a blow unit(30) capable of preventing external toxic gas from flowing in the chamber.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 산후조리원이나 산부인과, 양로원, 병원, 가정 등에서 화재 발생시 스스로 보행하여 대피할 수 없거나 대피가 어려운 영아, 노인, 장애인 등이 화재가 진압될 때까지 일시적으로 안전하게 은폐할 수 있도록 함으로써 화재에 따른 인명사고를 방지할 수 있는 화재 대피용 은폐장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 화재 대피용 은폐장치는, 내부에 챔버가 형성되며, 일측면부에 상기 챔버로 연통되는 개구부가 형성된 하우징과; 사람이 눕혀지는 안치부를 구비하며, 상기 하우징에 챔버의 내외측으로 슬라이딩 가능하도록 설치된 슬라이딩베드와; 상기 슬라이딩베드에 고정되어, 슬라이딩베드의 이동에 따라 상기 하우징의 개구부를 개방 또는 폐쇄시키는 불연성 단열재로 이루어진 도어부와; 상기 도어부가 하우징의 개구부를 폐쇄했을 때, 상기 하우징의 개구부 쪽으로 공기를 송풍하여 외부 유해가스가 챔버 내로 유입되는 것을 막는 송풍수단을 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     화재, 대피, 영아, 신생아, 슬라이딩베드, 산후조리원, 산부인과

title_en: Apparatus for breaking window glass for emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for breaking window glass for emergency evacuation, wherein the aim of the present invention is to enable vehicle window glass to be broken by being struck with a weak force to improve the safety of the apparatus for breaking window glass for emergency evacuation, and to enable the window glass to be broken in a reliable and quick manner even when a weak person such as a frail child or woman or the elderly uses the apparatus. The aim of the present invention is accomplished by the apparatus for breaking window glass for emergency evacuation, comprising: a fixed member, one end of which can be attached to window glass via an attachment member, and which has a through-hole formed in a central axis direction; a cover member, one end of which accommodates an upper portion of the attached member, and which is downwardly movable when struck by a user; and a breaking means, one end of which is inserted into and caught by the through-hole of the attached member, and the other end of which is attached to the cover member, and which is released when the cover member is struck by a weak force and moves toward the window glass to break the window glass.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상탈출용 유리창 파괴장치에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은, 약한 힘으로 타격하는 것에 의해 차량의 유리창을 파괴가능하도록 함으로써, 비상탈출용 유리창 파괴장치의 안전성을 향상시킬 수 있고 또한, 연약한 어린이 또는 여성 및 노양자가 사용하더라도 확실하고 신속하게 유리창을 파괴가능하도록 하는 것에 있으며, 이러한 목적은, 유리창에 고정용부재를 매개로 일단이 고정가능하도록 형성되되, 중심축방향으로 관통홀이 형성되어 구비되는 고정부재와, 상기 고정부재의 상부를 일단 내측으로 수용하여 사용자가 타격시 하향 이동가능하도록 구비되는 덮개부재와, 상기 고정부재에 의 관통홀 내측으로 일단이 삽입되어 걸림되고 타단은 상기 덮개부재에 고정되어 상기 덮개부재를 약한 힘으로 타격하는 것에 대응되게 걸림 해제되는 것에 의해 유리창측으로 이동하여 유리창을 파괴가능하도록 구비되는 파괴수단을 포함하여 이루어진 것에 의해 달성된다.

title_en: Fire/water rescue appliance for handicapped and elderly
abstract_en: A rescue appliance (10, 26, 50) for evacuating physically-compromised persons is disclosed. A rescue appliance includes a platform (16, 52) configured to support a prone evacuee, a set of wheels (18, 56) coupled with the platform to support the platform relative to a floor surface, and a protection assembly (22, 60) coupled with the platform. The protection assembly is configurable to surround the prone evacuee to protect the evacuee from a fire. The protection assembly can be configured to encase the prone evacuee. The rescue appliance can be configured to be sufficiently buoyant to support an evacuee on water to allow evacuation in a flooding emergency. Two or more rescue appliances can be coupled together to form a train so that multiple persons can be evacuated simultaneously.

title_en: Oblique sliding dual-purpose emergency staircase
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire protection of buildings, in particular to an oblique sliding dual-purpose emergency staircase, which comprises a horizontal base plate, an oblique surface, an oblique sliding plate, a stepped section, a plurality of rotating shafts, a plurality of motors, a plurality of shaft sleeves, a block plate and a horizontal section. One edge of the horizontal section and one edge of the stepped section close to the wall of the staircase are respectively provided with a rotating shaft, and the motor shaft of each motor are fixedly connected with the rotating shafts. The power switches of the motors are arranged in a fire control chamber of a whole building. The rectangular oblique sliding plate is laid on the upper surface of the stepped section of the staircase and is arranged parallel to the bottom surface of the stepped section of the staircase, and the horizontal base plate is laid on the upper surface of the horizontal section of the staircase. The oblique sliding dual-purpose emergency staircase adopts a sliding mode for emergency evacuation, and not only increases the evacuation speed, but also helps the old, weak, sick and disabled and other people with difficulties in walking, and greatly improves the success rate of safe evacuation.

title_en: Descending device for emergency evacuation
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a descending device allowing users, especially infants, the elderly and the disabled to easily evacuate, even in such a state that walking is difficult, at the emergency such as a fire when it takes time for the people to move by themselves though emergency stairs, or the like are used for evacuating from a height.  <P>SOLUTION: The descending device includes a circulating rotator composed of a roller chain and upper and lower sprockets 1a and having a handrail 1e. The device descends with the weight of occupants' own bodies applied to the handrail 1e as the occupants put their hands and feet on the handrail 1e. The descending device also includes a speed controller so that the device can descend at constant speed if the number of occupants in the device changes. A manual brake handle 3d is mounted in a boarding gate, so that the already moving descending device can be stopped for the occupants to safely transfer to the handrail 1e, and the descending device can be stopped for the occupants to get off the device. Especially if the occupants are weak, it is indispensable to transfer after the descending device is stopped. The whole device is enclosed with an ellipsoidal cylinder fence so that anyone can safely evacuate, and so that such disasters as falling when boarding can be prevented and the acrophobia can be resolved.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: - push-pull door lock
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 기존 기술의 개폐 방식의 비효율성을 제거 하여 개폐 방식에 대한 효율성을 높이기 위해 제안된 것으로서, 본 고안의 목적은 손을 자유 자재로 쓸 수 없을 때 단순히 당기거나 밀고자 함으로 도어 개폐를 할 수 있으며,  푸시(Push) 및 당김(Pull) 가능하게 설치된 작동레버를 밀거나 당겨서 간편하게 도어 락 킹을 제거시킬 수 있으며, 특히 몸이 불편한 장애인이나 노약자 또는 화재 등 위급한 비상 상태 시 실내 측 사용자의 신체 어느 부위를 이용하더라도  작동레버를 간편하게 작동시킬 수 있기 때문에 이에 대한 락 킹된 도어의 오픈시간 및 실내 측 사용자의 대피시간을 크게 단축시킬 수 있는 등의 탁월한 효과가 있다. 
       
     문고리 회전 푸시-풀 도어 락 개폐장치 밀기 당기기

title_en: Evacuation information creation device and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily and quickly create evacuation information which accelerates evacuation behavior of citizens at distribution destination by utilizing social psychological knowledge even if a person requiring caregivers is included in the distribution destination.SOLUTION: A distribution destination type for showing whether or not a distribution destination of evacuation information is a destination requiring support including the person requiring caregivers who needs support at the time of evacuation, which is inputted when setting the evacuation information, is acquired by an evacuation information setting part 15. When the evacuation information is created by an evacuation information creation part 16, the evacuation information is created based on full fixed sentence including a basic fixed sentence 14A and an evacuation support contents fixed sentence 14B if the distribution destination type acquired by the evacuation information setting part 15 is the destination requiring support, and the evacuation information is created based on the full fixed sentence including the basic fixed sentence 14A and not including the evacuation support contents fixed sentence 14B if the distribution destination type is not the destination requiring support.

title_en: Diffusion lens for the visual alarm
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A diffusion lens for a visual alarm apparatus is provided to use a diffusion light source which is projected through a lens, thereby effectively transferring an alarm signal to a hearing-impaired person. CONSTITUTION: A lens(100) is installed in a visual alarm apparatus(150) in order to maximize diffusion of light projected to a front side. The visual alarm apparatus visually informs a disaster such as fire and etc. to a hearing-impaired person, residents, and fire fighting participants by repeating a flickering process according to a signal of an automatic fire detection facility. The lens is detachably combined in a housing(151) of the visual alarm apparatus. The lens comprises a dome shaped first lens condensing light projected from a light source The lens comprises a dome shaped second lens which transmits the condensed light to the front side by diffusing the light through an incidence part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 렌즈에 있어서, 광원과 마주하는 일면에 마련되어 광원으로부터 조사되는 빛을 집광하는 돔 형태의 제1렌즈; 및 상기 입사부를 통해 집광된 빛을 확산하여 전방으로 투과시키는 돔 형태의 제2렌즈;를 포함하며, 상기 제2렌즈는, 어느 일면에 음각의 형태로 마련되어 광원으로부터 직접 또는 간접으로 입사된 빛을 전방위적으로 굴절 및 반사하는 반사홈부;를 개시한다. 
이러한 본 발명은 본 발명은 제1렌즈에서 광원을 집광한 후, 제2렌즈를 통해 광원이 전방으로 확산되도록 하여 광원의 손실을 최소화고, 전방위적인 빛의 조사가 가능하며, 렌즈를 통해 조사되는 광원의 굴절, 투과 및 반사율을 최대화함으로써, 화재 또는 비상 사태가 발생할 경우, 확산 광원을 통해 청각 장애인으로 하여금 대피에 대한 신호 전달을 극대화시킬 수 있으며, 확산용 렌즈는 광원의 손실을 줄이고 조사율이 극대화가 이루어지도록 하여, 전방으로 확산되는 광원의 밝기를 최대화하여 원거리에서도 식별이 용이한 효과가 있다.  그리고 직진성이 강한 LED 광원을 이용하여 빛의 투과, 굴절 및 반사율을 극대화하여 광원의 손실을 최소화고, 빛의 효율을 극대화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Smart mattress
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for a self-contained Smart Mattress which is capable of monitoring the vital statistics of a patient in real time, analyzing the data using an embedded processor, storing patient identification and information, producing an electronic medical report and communicating any data to the caregiver or computer server using wireless technology, such as Bluetooth® Technology. Due to the self-contained nature of the mattress, it is also ideal for use as an emergency evacuation mattress for bed-ridden patients.

title_en: Operation control system for elevator
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a wheelchair user to preferentially escape by using an elevator, and to enable an able-bodied person to also rapidly escape while utilizing the elevator.SOLUTION: An operation control system for the elevator includes: a special hall call button 12 for the wheelchair user; a congestion degree detection mechanism 24 for detecting an in-car congestion degree; an escape path detection mechanism 42 for detecting the presence or absence of an escape path except the elevator; and an operation control part 30 for controlling the operation of the elevator on the basis of information from the special hall call button 12, the congestion degree detection mechanism 24 and the escape path detection mechanism 42. The operation control part 30 performs the operation while checking a special call registration condition and the in-car congestion degree in a disaster evacuation mode, unloads the able-bodied persons on a midway story enabling separate escape or a standby condition, when it is determined that the wheelchair cannot be loaded into the elevator car, guides the able-bodied persons to make them escape to another escape path and bring them into the standby condition, and makes the elevator car 22 go direct to a special call registration story, after unloading the able-bodied persons until bringing the inside of the elevator car 22 into an empty condition or a congestion condition allowing the entrance of the wheelchair.

title_en: Escape door/window
abstract_en: The invention discloses an escape door/window and relates to escape shelter equipment for building fire. The escape door/window comprises a window frame, a fireproof window sash and an escape window grille; the whole structure is connected with a wall through bolts or steel structures and fixed at a pocket corridor end, an escape exit, a public passage and an indoor windowsill or balcony of a building. In emergency escape, the escape window grille, an escape cabinet and escape equipment are quickly expanded and suspended outside the window at the same time through an opening/closing device and a slide rail to form an escape ladder or escape vehicle with multiple safety guarantees; the escape door/window is applicable to floors of different heights, and can minimize the worry and fear of people in danger in a tall building at high altitude regardless of the height, weather, daytime/nighttime, power and other factors for people living in the building including the old, the weak and the disabled; and moreover, the escape door/window can be operated independently or by many people and used for rescuing people one after another, being a novel system which realizes safe escape and shelter and is comprehensive in preventing disasters, damage and thievery for tall buildings.

title_en: Heating tool preparation method for disaster shelter
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem called "disaster related death" wherein when such a large disaster as earthquake, tsunami, fire or radioactive contamination occurs in winter, and the gymnasium of school or the like is provided as a disaster shelter, it is necessary for disaster victims to keep off severe cold in a shelter wrapping themselves up in blankets as in outdoors since all lifelines are not available, and an oil stove is not available in case of the risk of any aftershock, and since there may be sick persons or elderly people who become ill and pass away.SOLUTION: Since the ceiling of a gymnasium or the like which is prepared as a disaster shelter is high, heat escapes upward, and a part above a floor level is cold. To cope with this, a transparent heat insulation sheet is so stretched as to entirely cover the interior of a room for shielding the lower part so that the lighting of a height window or a ceiling light can be prevented from being intercepted at almost the height of an entrance/exit. Then, a heating sheet of a tatami size (equivalent to the size of a 24-hour heating sustainable portable body warmer) is spread all over the floor, and blankets are spread above. Thus, disaster victims can stay in a warm shelter with safety even when any aftershock occurs.

title_en: Evacuation information guide system and method with impartation function of fire located and evacuation
title_ko: 화재발생위치 및 대피방향 알림기능을 갖는 대피정보안내시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Evacuation information guide system and method are provided to enable users to safely and rapidly evacuate. CONSTITUTION: An evacuation information guide system(200) comprises a detection sensor(210), a detected signal input module(220), a detected signal determining module(230), an output control module(240), and an evacuation data guide module(250). The detection sensor senses smoke or fire and outputs a sensing signal. The detected signal input module receives the sensing signal outputted in the detection sensor. The detected signal determining module receives the sensing signal received to the detected signal input module, analyzes the sensing signal, and determines originating site and scale of the corresponding fire. The output control module generates an inter-layer evacuation control signal. The evacuation data guide module outputs evacuation information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생위치 및 대피방향 알림기능을 갖는 대피정보안내시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 대피정보안내장치를 통해 건물의 각 층별 또는 층간별 현재 위치에 대하여 해당 화재가 발생한 위치의 상대정보를 알려주도록 함으로써, 화재가 발생한 위치로부터 안전하고 신속하게 벗어날 수 있도록 하기 위한 것이다.  또한, 본 발명은 해당 건축물의 구조적 특징에 따라 설정된 대피로에 대응하여 각 층별 또는 층간별 이동방향을 알려줌으로써, 보다 안전하고 신속한 대피가 이루어질 수 있도록 한다.  더불어, 시각장애인에게도 정확한 상대정보를 제공할 수 있음은 물론, 해당 상대정보를 단문 또는 단어 중 적어도 하나의 문자형태로 제공함으로써, 대피자들의 신속하고 정확한 판단이 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 따라서, 위급상황시 대피를 유도하는 시스템, 방법 및 장치를 제공하는 분야에서 신뢰성 및 경쟁력을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Combined rapid convergence and evacuation floor or high platform with multiple types of upstairs and downstairs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined rapid convergence and evacuation floor or high platform with multiple types of upstairs and downstairs, which belongs to a novel rapid convergence and evacuation structure specially designed for environments with the centralized stream of people going upstairs and downstairs. The combined rapid convergence and evacuation floor or high platform comprises a building/pavilions floor or a floor with a high drop platform or a high platform with centralized configuration of ordinary upward and downward stairs, an elevator/escalator, a sitting type slide chute, a safety riding slide and safety rapid steps to form multiple types of upstairs and downstairs with different shapes and characteristics. People tend to live and move together in the social life. By adopting the floor or high platform, the elderly, the weak, the young, people shopping slowly, people walking quickly, gentlemen, lively people and other customers and pedestrians in public places with the concentrated stream of people can independently select the appropriate stairways to go up and down, the space and the time can be saved, and the evacuation order and efficiency of convergence and evacuation spots can be improved greatly. The combined rapid convergence and evacuation floor or high platform is suitable for market shops, stations, terminals, halls, buildings, education buildings, dormitory buildings and other places with large stream of people, can also be used as a facility to go up and down crosses, overhead walkways, underground walkways and the like, and has a good performance, wide scope of application and high efficiency.

title_en: Elevator system for evacuation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an elevator system for evacuation allowing dwellers in the entire building including elderly people, pregnant women, children and wheelchair users to safely evacuate in a short time by using elevators without using stairs upon the occurrence of a fire.SOLUTION: In this elevator system for evacuation which is also responsible for traffic for evacuation by elevators from floors other than a reference floor to the reference floor in a fire and installed in a building, a temporary evacuation area partitioned by fire shutters descending from a ceiling when a signal of fire occurrence is received is installed in a hallway part facing the elevators on each floor other than the reference floor of the building; and a fire evacuation operation which repeats back-and-forth operation between the reference floor and prioritized floors other the reference floor in a predetermined priority order until the evacuation of evacuees of the floors is ended upon the fire occurrence and moves to the floor of the next order to repeat the back-and-forth operation until the evacuation of the evacuees of all the floors other than the reference floor is ended after the end of the evacuation of the floors is incorporated in a control device of the elevators.

title_en: System and method for facilitating home care activities
abstract_en: A computer-implemented system for managing the tracking and completion of one or more caretaking events, including a care management interface configured to receive and track one or more caretaking events and facilitate assignment of at least one caregiver record with each of the caretaking events, wherein a caretaking event is an item to be performed by the caregiver identified in the caregiver record taken for the benefit of a home health care recipient. The system further includes a professional home care management interface configured to receive an assignment of caretaking event in a calendar item or task item, generate and transmit a home care management request including the caretaking event to a home care management system, receive a confirmation from the home care management system that the task has been assigned to the home care management system, and display an indication of the assignment in the care management interface.
assignees: BRIGHTSTAR FRANCHISING LLC;PEARL JAYSON;RAMCZYK ERIN;SUN SHELLY A

title_en: Shelter road
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To save as many as possible of human lives including elderly people and children, while thinking of silent voices of numerous persons dead or missing in the great earthquake, or of the death or the missing in the future.SOLUTION: A person can reach an entrance of a shelter road by a 5 to 6 minutes walk upon being prepared for an evacuation regardless of which location in the region he/she is. From the entrance through a sloping stair, a suspension bridge or the like, he/she reaches a main road for an escape to a hill.

title_en: Tsunami evacuation device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a tsunami evacuation device which naturally can be used as a multilevel parking space in normal time, allows not only a vehicle but also a neighboring resident as well as a passing person to freely seek refuge therein from an attack of a tsunami, and facilitates evacuation in a wheelchair by using a slope and the like.SOLUTION: The present invention comprises: a plurality of columns, floors on a plurality of stories where parking is available, and slopes enabling a vehicle to drive up and down between the ground and the floors. Feet of the slopes are constructed in a manner that prevents a tsunami from surging up the slope.

title_en: Public address system and method for guiding disabled person and thereof speaker
title_ko: 장애인 안내를 위한 전관방송 시스템과 그 방법 그리고 스피커
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A public broadcasting system for providing information to disabled people, a method thereof, and a speaker are provided to control a volume level of each speaker in order to easily evacuate disable people. CONSTITUTION: A public broadcasting system comprises a central system(100), a speaker(200), and a speaker line(300). The central system creates an evacuation route by detecting an emergency situation. The central system transmits an emergency signal by designating a plurality of speakers located on the evacuation route. A two-wire speaker line transmits a power source, a data signal, and an audio signal by synthesizing into the emergency signal in the central system. The speaker provides the emergency signal according to the audio signal transmitted through the speaker line. A display module visually displays the evacuation route using the data signal and the power source.
abstract_ko:
장애인 안내를 위한 전관방송 시스템과 그 방법 그리고 스피커가 개시된다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 장애인 안내를 위한 전관방송 시스템은, 전관방송 영역 내에 비상 상황이 발생한 것을 파악하여 그 발생 위치를 회피하는 적어도 하나의 대피 유도 경로를 생성하고, 각 대피 유도 경로상에 위치한 복수의 스피커를 지정하여 대피 유도 신호를 전송하는 중앙 시스템과 상기 중앙 시스템에서 상기 대피 유도 신호로 합성된 오디오 신호, 데이터 신호 및 전원을 전달하는 2선식 스피커 선로; 및 상기 스피커 선로를 통해 전달되는 상기 오디오 신호에 따른 청각적 비상 안내 방송을 하고, 상기 데이터 신호 및 상기 전원을 이용하여 표시 모듈을 통해 시각적 대피 유도 방향을 표시하는 스피커를 포함한다.

title_en: In door broadcating speaker for a hearing impaired person
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 안내 방송용 실내 스피커
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An indoor broadcasting speaker for a hearing impaired person is provided to rapidly evacuate the hearing impaired person indoor by controlling the flickering of a light emitting diode lamp in an emergency situation. CONSTITUTION: A cover(203) includes a plurality of lamp installation holes which is made out of a transparent material. A plurality of LEDs(211) inserted in the lamp installation holes is arranged on a lower portion of the cover. A lamp substrate includes a solar cell installing between each LED. A speaker outputs an announcement into an acoustic signal. A control device is connected in parallel with a wire(221) which transmits an electric signal to the speaker. The control device controls the flickering of the LED according to an alarm sound or a siren signal entering the wire. A chargeable battery supplies charged electrical energy to the control device. A housing(201) is connected to the lower portion of the cover.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서 청각장애인을 위한 안내 방송용 실내 스피커를 개시한다. 
본 발명에 따른 스피커는, 투명재질의 테두리에 다수 개의 램프 설치구가 구비된 커버; 커버의 하부에는 상기 램프 설치구로 인입되는 다수 개의 엘이디를 구비하며, 각 엘이디 사이로 쏠라셀이 장착된 램프 기판; 안내방송을 음향신호로 출력하기 위한 스피커; 스피커로 전기적 신호를 전송하는 배선과 병렬 접속되어, 배선으로 유입되는 싸이렌 시그널에 동조하여 상기 엘이디를 점멸 제어하는 제어장치; 쏠라셀로부터 충전되는 전기에너지를 충전한 후, 충전된 전기에너지를 상기 제어장치로 공급하는 충전 배터리; 및 천정에 설치 가능한 구조로서 상기 커버의 하부에 연결되는 하우징;으로 구성된다. 
따라서 본 발명은, 안내 방송을 목적으로 설치되는 실내 스피커에 엘이디 램프를 장착하고, 비상 상황 시 엘이디 램프의 점멸을 제어함으로써, 실내 청각장애인의 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Heater for disaster shelter
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem of disaster-related death that, when a major disaster such as earthquake or seismic sea wave occurs in winter, life lines are completely destroyed, people have to evacuate to a school gymnasium or the like, however there are not only people having no disabilities but also people needing wheelchairs, demented people having evacuated from institutions and elderly people, and there are possibilities that ill people or elderly people die in a disaster shelter where it is as cold as outdoor because a heating stove is not used in consideration that there are possibilities that, if a domestic kerosene stove is placed on a floor and the aftershock occurs, elderly person who is clumsy of foot falls over the heating stove to cause a fire which may result in deaths and injuries of many people in the shelter.SOLUTION: The best way of heating in a disaster shelter is to use a solid fuel stove: being equipped with an automatic fire extinguishing device which responds to earthquake at a high position where people staying in the disaster shelter do not stub their toes against the fire extinguishing device; and burning a solid fuel whose fire does not spread even when the solid fuel stove falls down and the solid fuel drops. The solid fuel stove is configured in such a way that upward hot air flow generated by burning the solid fuel with a size approximately formed by laying six tissue boxes in a second tier is sent out from a discharge port by a blower fan to heat the inside of the shelter.

title_en: Waterproof underground shelter
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a waterproof underground shelter which is installed under the ground surface without having a structure on the ground and allows evacuees such as a large number of persons, elderly persons, children, handicapped persons, and sick persons to be rapidly entered.SOLUTION: An encapsulated waterproof shelter is installed under the ground as a measure against tsunami, flood disaster, or the like. The top face of the shelter has a planar shape. The shelter has a door for entrance and exit, a hole for checking the outside, and a lifting and lowering tool. The door for entrance and exit and the hole for checking the outside have encapsulated waterproof capability. The lifting and lowering tool is used in a slide shape during evacuation, allowing for rapid evacuation.

title_en: Guardrail of balcony for evacuating
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A balcony handrail of an apartment building is provided to allow an occupant to enter a boarding basket to escape, thereby minimizing panic and quickly and safely evacuating children, elderly, and weak persons without the danger of falling. CONSTITUTION: A balcony handrail(20) of an apartment building includes a lower support(22), an upper support(21), plural lattice members(23), and an escape apparatus(200). The lower support has both sides fixed to a wall body(11) of the apartment building and is horizontally arranged at the lower side of a balcony(13). The upper support has both sides fixed to the wall body of the apartment building and is horizontally arranged at the upper side of the lower support. The lattice member has both sides respectively coupled to the upper support and the lower support is vertically arranged between the upper support and the lower support. The escape apparatus is equipped with a hoist(210) and a boarding basket(230). One side of the hoist is rotatably coupled to the lower support, and the other side of the hoist is detachably coupled to the upper support. The boarding basket is coupled to one side of the hoist(210).
abstract_ko: 공동주택의 발코니 난간대가 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 공동주택의 발코니 난간대는 완강기에 결합된 바스켓 형상의 탑승낭에 탑승할 수 있으므로 대피 시에 공포감을 최소화 할 수 있고, 유아나 노약자도 추락할 위험 없이 안전하고 신속하게 공동주택의 외부로 대피할 수 있으며, 탑승낭의 하면 및 측면이 화염을 차단하므로 탈출하고자 하는 층보다 저층에서 화재가 발생한 경우에도 안전하게 대피할 수 있다.
assignees: CHUNG NAM CN ARCHITECTS & ENGINEERS CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation assistance apparatus
abstract_en: An evacuation assistance apparatus for indicating a route within a building or other structure is disclosed. Multiple housings contain laser light line sources for producing a beam of laser light as a linear line. Adjusters are used to alter the laser light line so that the line starts substantially vertically below said housing. The adjusters also allow the line to be directed on to a portion of the wall to highlight an exit doorway. The apparatus is provided as a modular system including multiple sensors making it suitable for installation in many buildings and providing feedback information to prevent or determine the cause of a fire.

title_en: Fire alarm system for hearing-impaired person
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired is provided to immediately find fire occurrence and location, regardless of where people with hearing impairment are present indoors. CONSTITUTION: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired includes a plurality of wireless alarm devices(100). The wireless alarm device is installed in the vicinity of a fire detector(50) installed in the ceiling of each room. The wireless alarm device includes a fire detection reception unit(110), a control unit(130), and a wireless transception unit(140). The control unit lights a light-emitting unit if a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit or the wireless transception unit. The control unit transmits the fire detection signal and a unique ID to the other wireless alarm devices when a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit. The other wireless alarm devices display a location corresponding to the unique ID based on the unique ID received from the wireless transception unit on a display unit. [Reference numerals] (50) Smoke detector;
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재감지신호를 무선으로 여러 장소로 송수신하여 청각장애인이 실내 어느 장소에 있더라도 신속하게 화재가 발생하였음을 알려줄 수 있는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위하여, 본 발명은 화재시 청각장애인에게 화재경보를 줄 수 있는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템에 있어서, 상기 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템은 복수 개의 무선경보장치를 포함하며, 상기 무선경보장치는, 화재감지기로부터 감지된 신호를 전송받는 화재감지수신부; 상기 화재감지수신부의 신호를 증폭시키는 증폭부; 상기 무선경보장치에 설치된 각종 부품을 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부에 의하여 다른 무선경보장치와 무선으로 신호를 송수신하기 위한 무선송수신부; 상기 제어부에 의하여 발광하는 발광부를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 제어부는 상기 화재감지수신부 또는 무선송수신부로부터 화재감지신호가 수신되면 상기 발광부를 발광시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템을 제공한다. 
따라서, 본 발명에 의하면 실내에 기존 설치된 화재감지기의 변경 없이 용이하게 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템을 설치할 수 있으며, 청각장애인이 실내 어디에 있든 신속하게 화재발생 여부 및 화재발생 장소를 파악할 수 있어 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 해 준다.

title_en: Floating type tsunami refuge
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a Tsunami refuge configured to maintain safety of refugees without being submerged or washed away even if hit by unexpected huge Tsunami or flood.SOLUTION: The refuge floats on the surface of water and is prevented from being submerged regardless of height of Tsunami or water depth of flood, and is prevented from being washed away by a chain connected to the ground. The refuge is supported by a pipe-shaped supporting column extending from the ground etc., and only moves vertically along the supporting column along with fluctuation of the water depth, without being washed away. When hit by large Tsunami higher than the height of the supporting column, the refuge slips out from the supporting column and drifts on the sea without submerging. The location of the refuge can be confirmed by a GPS or the like, so as to collect and rescue the refuge. Since the refuge can be installed at a place near a residential area etc. in a lowland, thereby facilitating evacuation of the elderly etc., The refuge can be utilized casually.

title_en: Solar cell module mounting transport vehicle
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a solar cell module mounting transport vehicle capable of multipurpose use in a disaster area, for example, not limiting to transfer of victims or elderly people or transportation of evacuation tools or assistance materials, and movable easily as a photovoltaic power generator.SOLUTION: A transport vehicle 1 includes a solar cell module 5 being mounted removably on the surface of a carrier 2 with a wheel 3 on which transport materials are mounted and transported by a bearer holding a handle 4, a first support frame 6 being housed in the rear surface of the carrier 2 during transport, and having legs 9a projecting downward of the carrier 2 during stoppage, and a second support frame 7 provided at the tip of the carrier 2 and having legs 9b projecting downward of the carrier 2 during stoppage. The carrier 2 is supported by the legs 9a, 9b of the first support frame 6 and second support frame 7 while forming a predetermined angle of inclination.

title_en: Caregiver processes and systems
abstract_en: Embodiments of the invention relate to methods and systems for coordinating care for a care recipient among one or more caregivers. Caregivers can organize and assign tasks related to a diagnosis, illness, condition, behavior, living condition, etc. of a care recipient. Interactive systems and methods are disclosed that allow multiple caregivers to accomplish a plurality of tasks, generate care related reports, and/or monitor medication compliance.
assignees: CARING IN PLACE INC;FOTHERINGHAM JOSHUA ROBERT;HOWELL DAVID SMITH;JARMAN JAMES HOYT

title_en: Audio guiding device for the blind
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A sound induction device for the blind is provided to wirelessly transmit a guidance requesting signal according to the standard of the sound induction device for the blind in a fire, and to guide an evacuating method in the corresponding position. CONSTITUTION: A sound induction device for the blind is comprised of the followings: an operation table(112) which contains a control code for the blind guidance, a control code for a fire evacuation guidance, a control code for advertisement, and all kinds of predetermined values for the operation under the control code; a memory(110) which stores blind guidance sound source data, fire evacuation guidance sound source data, and advertisement guidance sound source data; a sound output unit; and a control unit which confirms whether the control code in the received wireless signal is the control code for the blind guidance, the control code for the fire evacuation guidance, or the control code for the advertisement in the operation table, plays the blind guidance sound source data, the fire evacuation guidance sound source data, or the advertisement sound source data according to the confirmation result, and outputs the data to a sound output unit. [Reference numerals] (110) Operation table; (120) LED driving unit; (130) Voice processing unit; (132) Voice amplifying unit; (140) Power supplying unit; (142) External power; (144) Emergency power; (152) RF receiving unit; (160) Infrared ray receiving unit; (220,320) Command coding unit; (230,330) RF transmitting unit; (250,350,360) Battery; (410,105) Micom; (420) Key input unit; (430) Display device driving unit; (440) Display device; (450) Infrared ray transmitting unit; (AA) Fire sensing signal; (BB) Basic guide voice source data; (CC) Additional guide voice source data; (DD) Fire evacuation guide voice source data; (EE) Public relation guide voice source data
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 발생 시에 시각장애인용 음성유도기의 규격에 따라 시각장애인용 음성유도기에 안내 요청 신호를 무선으로 송출하고, 이에 응하여 시각장애인용 음성유도기가 해당 위치에서의 대피 방법 등을 음성으로 안내할 수 있도록 함으로써 시각장애인 음성유도기의 활용도를 극대화시킬 수 있도록 한 시각장애인 음성유도기용 무선 송신 장치 및 이에 사용되는 시각장애인 음성유도기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 시각장애인 음성유도기용 무선 송신 장치는 시설물에 고정 설치되어 당해 시설물에 설치된 시각장애인용 음성유도기와 통신하되, 화재감지신호가 입력된 경우에 화재알림용 제어 코드를 발생시키는 명령 코딩부 및 상기 명령 코딩부에 의해 발생된 상기 화재알림용 제어 코드를 시각장애인용 음성유도기의 캐리어 주파수에 실어서 출력하는 RF 송신부를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
전술한 구성에서, 상기 화재감지신호는 시설물에 설치된 소화전의 경종에 공급되는 직류전원이거나 시설물에 설치된 화재 감지기로부터의 화재 감지 신호인 것을 특징으로 한다. 
화재를 감지하는 연 감지기 또는 열 감지기를 더 구비하고, 상기 화재감지신호는 상기 연 감지기 또는 상기 열 감지기로부터 입력될 수도 있다.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Secure (HIPAA Compliant) Communication of Healthcare and Private Information
abstract_en: Systems and methods for allowing communications basics, such as personal email and various application accounts, as well as assisted use of the technologies and a method for safely, and with HIPAA compliance, sharing such communications. Access templates are created, assigned, and registered for each of the participants in the system acting as information sources, information receivers, or both. The systems and methods allow the elderly, disabled, or ill individuals to have access to their family and friends through phone contact, mail contact, email, video mail, and video chat, as well as other communication methods. The sharing of information through current and future communications technologies is made possible without the individual needing to possess the technology or know how to use it specifically. Families are able to share their lives and events in a much more personally connected way and the elderly, disabled, or ill patient can do the same.

title_en: Building structure
