abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a facility for aged people, people having difficulty in walking and people in wheelchairs, etc., to evacuate in emergency from a flood disaster in a short time basically by themselves from a flat road/passage of a residential location without going through a steep hill or stairs when a fire/power failure occurs following an earthquake, while the facility for emergency evacuation of the aged people, the people having difficulty in walking and the people in wheelchairs, etc., for the time of a flood disaster like tsunami is not provided in an ordinary living area near a seashore.SOLUTION: A mid-rise/high-rise building structure has a cylindrical structure in the inside and rises high upwards, a floating structure which is capable of floating on a water surface and vertically movable accompanying the vertical movement of the water surface is provided inside the cylindrical structure, and also a guide part capable of allowing the vertical movement of the floating structure but limiting the movement in front, back, left, and right transverse directions is provided inside the cylindrical structure.

title_en: Emergency exit guidance lamp
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency exit light is provided to secure visibility from the smoke in case of emergency such as fire or a power outage by being brightly radiated in the emergency more than usual and to efficiently guide evacuees to an emergency exit by broadcasting an emergency. CONSTITUTION: An emergency exit light comprises a power unit (10) supplying an electricity; a light emitting diode (LED) lighting unit (20) with one or more multicolored LED lamps capable of being flashed; a visibility detecting unit (30) detecting the visibility surrounding an installation place; a control unit (40) variably controlling the brightness of the LED lighting unit according to the visibility detected in the visibility detecting unit by controlling a flashing movement of the LED lighting unit in an emergency; and a voice output unit (50) outputting an emergency guide broadcast by being driven with a control signal of the control unit in the emergency. [Reference numerals] (10) Power unit; (20) LED lighting unit; (30) Visibility detecting unit; (31) Camera; (32) Gas sensor; (33) Illumination sensor; (40) Control unit; (50) Sound output unit; (AA) Power
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상구 유도등에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 화재나 정전 등의 비상시에 연기로부터 시인성을 확보하여 대피자를 안내하는 능력을 향상시킬 수 있으며 비상 사태임을 올바르게 인식시킬 수 있고, 내부의 램프를 다색 LED 램프로 사용하여 다양한 색상을 표현할 수 있도록 하고, 각 램프의 다양한 패턴의 점멸 조합을 통해 문자, 기호, 이미지 등의 입체적인 연출을 가능하게 하여 보다 쉽고 안전하게 비상구의 위치를 알릴 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 라디오 주파수를 이용한 비상 안내 방송의 동시 송출이 가능하여, 대피자가 비상구 유도등의 표시를 시각적으로 인지하는 것이 사실상 불가능한 상황이거나 시각 장애인인 경우에도 대피를 유도하는 것이 가능하여 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 비상구 유도등에 관한 것이다. 
상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 비상구 유도등은, 전기를 공급하는 전원부와; 점멸이 가능한 하나 이상의 다색 LED 램프를 구비하는 LED 조명부와; 설치된 장소 주변의 가시도를 검출하는 가시도 검출부와; 비상 사태 발생시에, 상기 LED 조명부의 점멸 동작을 제어하는 것으로써, 상기 가시도 검출부에서 검출된 가시도에 따라 상기 LED 조명부의 휘도를 가변적으로 제어하는 제어부; 및 비상 사태 발생시에, 상기 제어부의 제어 신호에 의해 구동되어 비상 안내 방송을 출력하는 음성 출력부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 상기 가시도 검출부는 카메라이며, 상기 제어부는 상기 카메라에 촬영되는 주변 영상과 미리 저장된 영상 패턴을 비교 분석하여 현재의 주변 가시도를 판단하고, 주변 가시도가 낮을수록 상기 LED 조명부의 휘도가 증가하도록 제어한다. 다른 측면에 따르면, 상기 가시도 검출부는 주변 연기 농도를 감지하는 가스 센서이며, 상기 제어부는 상기 주변 연기 농도에 기초하여 현재의 주변 가시도를 판단하고, 주변 가시도가 낮을수록 상기 LED 조명부의 휘도가 증가하도록 제어하게 된다. 또 다른 측면에 따르면, 상기 가시도 검출부는 주변 조도를 감지하는 조도 센서이며, 상기 제어부는 상기 주변 조도에 기초하여 현재의 주변 가시도를 판단하고, 주변 가시도가 낮을수록 상기 LED 조명부의 휘도가 증가하도록 제어하는 것이 가능하다. 뿐만 아니라 상기 가시도 검출부는 주변 영상을 촬영하는 카메라, 주변 연기 농도를 검출하는 가스 센서, 주변 빛의 밝기를 검출하는 조도 센서 중 적어도 2가지 이상을 포함할 수도 있다. 
그리고 상기 음성 출력부는 설치된 건물의 중앙 관제부에서 미사용 라디오 주파수 대역으로 송출하는 비상 안내 방송을 수신할 수 있도록, 상기 라디오 주파수로 튜너가 기 설정된 라디오 수신기; 및 상기 라디오 수신기에 수신된 비상 안내 방송을 출력하는 스피커를 포함한다. 또한 상기 제어부는 설치된 건물의 중앙 관제부로 비상 사태의 발생 유무 정보를 전송하고, 상기 중앙 관제부로부터 비상 사태의 발생이 감지된 장소에 설치된 상기 비상구 유도등의 위치 정보를 수신하여, 상기 위치 정보가 상기 LED 조명부를 통해 표시되도록 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Wheelchair movement assistance device
abstract_en: Provided is a wheelchair movement assistance device capable of assisting an emergency evacuation in a disaster or the like, assisting travel on uneven ground surfaces such as sand, snow, gravel, and mud, and assisting the travel and movement of the wheelchair on an ascending road, capable of being easily mounted to the wheelchair in a short time, and capable of being stowed without requiring an excessive space. This wheelchair movement assistance device comprises: a pair of mounting members which is mounted to the left and right front pipes or the left and right leg pipes of a wheelchair in a removable manner by being clamped or engaged therewith; and a square C-shaped pipe frame, to both ends of which the pair of mounting members is mounted. The mounting members are provided with clamping sections formed at the ends of pipe frame, and with grasping sections attached to the ends of the pipe frame at positions in front of the clamping sections. Each of the grasping sections grips a portion of each of the front pipes of the wheelchair or a portion of each of the leg pipes of the wheelchair, and each of the clamping sections is in pressure contact with a portion of each of the front pipes of the wheelchair or a portion of each of the leg pipes of the wheelchair.

title_en: Supporter of inclination for threshold
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An inclined support unit for a threshold prevents a safety accident in which the children, the elderly, and the infirm trip on the threshold and fall down when entering a door and allows a wheel chair of the infirm or a baby walker for an infant to easily enter the door. CONSTITUTION: An inclined support unit (100) for a threshold includes a main body (10), a bottom plate (20), and a handle (30). The main body is adjacent to the threshold protruding from the bottom surface. The upper surface of the main body is open, and the main body includes a guide groove (12) to mutually correspond to both sides. Mounting protrusions (22) on both sides are mounted on the guide groove so that the bottom plate is lifted to be drawn in the main body or be drawn out from the main body through the opened upper surface of the main body. The mounting protrusions of both sides are mounted on the guide groove when drawn out from the main body, and the bottom plate is rotated around the mounting protrusions which are a rotary shaft so that an inclined surface is formed on between the threshold and the bottom surface. The handle is formed on the bottom plate.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 문턱용 경사받침대에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 어린이나 노약자들이 문을 출입할 때에 문턱에 걸려 넘어져 발생할 수 있는 안전사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 유아들의 보행기나 몸이 불편한 사람들이 휠체어를 타고 문 출입을 용이하게 할 수 있도록 하는 문턱용 경사받침대에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면 문턱용 경사받침대에 있어서, 바닥으로부터 돌출된 문턱에 이웃하여 배치되고, 상면이 개방되며, 양측에 상호 대응되도록 안내홈이 형성되는 본체; 본체의 개방된 상면을 통해 본체에 인입 또는 인출되도록 양측이 안내홈에 장착되어 승강되고, 인출시 안내홈에 장착되는 양측을 회전축으로 회전 가능하여 문턱과 바닥 사이에 경사면을 형성할 수 있는 바닥판; 및 바닥판에 형성되는 손잡이; 를 포함하되, 안내홈은, 바닥판이 승강 가능하도록 직선상으로 형성되는 승강부; 및 승강부의 상측에 연결되고, 본체의 바닥측을 향해 구부러져 형성되며, 바닥판이 걸림되어 고정되는 걸림부; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 문턱용 경사받침대를 제공한다.

title_en: Escaping equipment for high-rise building
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An escaping equipment for a high-rise building is provided to enable safe and rapid escape by rescuing an elevator through an elevating structure. CONSTITUTION: An escaping equipment for a high-rise building is a high-rise building escaping equipment for escaping to downstairs in emergency by being installed in a slab of the building, wherein the equipment comprises a main body (10) that is fixedly installed on the slab and has opened upper and lower surfaces; an elevator (20) having a box shape which accommodates and closes the main body therein and provides a space for an evacuee to stand thereupon; and an elevation guide unit (30) formed of a winding reel included in the elevator, multiple guide rollers that are included in one side of the winding reel, a wire of which one end is connected to the winding reel and the other end is connected to the main body along the multiple guide rollers.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 고층건물 피난장치를 개시한다. 
본 발명의 고층건물 피난장치는 건물의 슬래브에 설치되어 위난시 아래층으로 대피하기 위한 고층건물 피난장치에 있어서, 슬래브에 고정 설치되는 것으로 상·하면이 개방된 본체와; 상기 본체의 내부에 수용되어 차폐시키는 것으로, 그 상면으로 대피자가 올라설 수 있도록 평탄면을 제공하는 상자 형상을 갖는 승강체와; 상기 승강체의 내부에 구비되는 권취릴 및 이 권취릴의 일측에 복수 구비되는 안내롤러 및 일단이 권취릴에 연결되고 타단은 복수의 안내롤러를 따라 상기 본체에 연결되는 와이어로 이루어지는 승강안내수단으로 구성된다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명은 간소한 구조이면서 직관적인 조작에 의해 승강체가 하강됨에 따라 노인, 어린아이, 임산부, 장애인 등과 같이 노약자의 경우에도 신속하고 안전한 대피가 가능한 이점이 있다. 
즉, 종래의 사다리 구조의 경우 현실적으로 노약자의 경우 이용이 불가능할 뿐만 아니라 일반인의 경우에도 평소 사다리를 이용하지 않기 때문에 사다리에 대한 불안감을 갖고 있을 뿐만 아니라 특히 수직하게 기립된 상태의 사다리를 이용하기에는 많은 두려움을 가지고 있음에 따라 신속한 대피가 곤란하고, 자칫 추락 등의 안전사고의 위험성이 큰 단점이 있다. 반면 본 발명은 대피자가 승강체에 안전하게 착석하거나 또는 별도로 제공되는 손잡이를 잡고 있는 상태에서 승강체 전체가 저속으로 하강 이동함에 따라 안전하고 신속한 대피가 가능한 효과가 있는 것이다.

title_en: Escaping equipment for high-rise building
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An escaping equipment for a high-rise building is provided to allow rapid and safe evacuation for a weaker people, such as pregnant women, children, old people, and disabled people, as a slider is forcibly withdrawn along an inclined surface to downstairs in connection with an operation of an evacuee opening a hatch. CONSTITUTION: An escaping equipment (1) for a high-rise building is a high-rise building escaping equipment for escaping to downstairs in emergency by being installed in a slab of the building, wherein the equipment comprises a main body (10) in a box shape having a hatch (13) capable of opening and closing that is hinge-included on an upper surface; a slider (20) that is accommodated in the main body and includes multiple slide boards (23) stacked in multiple steps; and an unfolding unit (30) that opens the multiple slide boards in connection with an opening operation of the hatch.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 고층건물 피난장치를 개시한다. 
본 발명의 고층건물 피난장치는 건물의 슬래브에 매립 설치되어 화재 등의 위급한 상황시 아래층으로 대피하기 위한 고층건물 피난장치에 있어서, 상면에 개폐 가능한 해치가 힌지 구비되는 상자 형상의 본체와; 상기 본체의 내부에 수용되는 것으로 복수의 슬라이드판을 다단 적층으로 구비하는 슬라이더와; 상기 해치의 개방 동작시 이에 연동하여 상기 복수의 슬라이드판을 전개시키는 전개수단을 포함하여 구성되는 것에 있다. 
상기와 같이 구성되는 본 발명은 대피자가 해치를 여는 조작에 연동하여 슬라이더가 강제 아래층으로 강제 인출되면서 경사면을 형성함에 따라 임산부, 어린아이, 노인, 장애인 등과 같은 대피 취약자의 경우에는 신속하고 안전한 대피가 가능한 이점이 있다. 즉, 종래의 수직형 사다리 구조의 경우 현실적으로 노약자의 경우 이용이 불가능할 뿐만 아니라 일반인의 경우에도 평소 사다리를 이용하지 않기 때문에 사다리 이용에 대한 불안감을 갖고 있음에 따라 신속한 대피가 곤란하고, 자칫 추락 등의 안전사고의 위험성이 큰 단점이 있는 반면 본 발명은 대피자가 미끄럼틀 형태로 전개되는 슬라이더를 이용하여 짧은 시간내에 연속적으로 많은 사람을 안전하고 신속하게 아래층으로 대피 이동시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Tsunami evacuation underground shelter
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To devise a method for significantly reducing the evacuation time, while considering that the movement distance to each of evacuation facilities is very long for elderly persons, children, handicapped persons, and the like, and thus more than twenty thousands people could not finish evacuation and passed away in the Great East Japan Earthquake.SOLUTION: An underground shelter is housed in a shelter dock (1) buried in a ground, has an escape hatch (13) in its upper part, and is provided with steel connectors (11), (12) in its lower part. An upper part of a shelter body (2) is locked by a connection wire (9).

title_en: Evacuation device for transporting handicapped person
abstract_en: An evacuation device for carrying a person with mobility disability comprises a cushion body and a fixing piece, wherein the cushion body is of a flexible structure and is provided with a first surface and a second surface which correspond to each other, and the first surface is used for the person with mobility disability to lie; the fixing piece is fixedly arranged on the first surface and used for fixing the body of the person who is inconvenient to move. Therefore, when a disaster occurs and a person with mobility difficulty needs to be evacuated, the rescue personnel can place the person with mobility difficulty on the first surface of the cushion body and fix the body of the person with mobility difficulty by the fixing piece, the rescue personnel can directly grab the cushion body to drag, and meanwhile, the cushion body is used for covering and protecting the person with mobility difficulty, so that the person with mobility difficulty can be evacuated from dangerous places quickly under the condition of considering safety.

title_en: Emergency evacuation device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency evacuation device capable of enabling the occupant of a front passenger seat or a rear passenger seat to operate a vehicle.SOLUTION: An emergency evacuation device 1 gives emergency evacuation assistance for stopping a vehicle at a safe position irrespective of a driver's running operation of the vehicle. After the start of the emergency evacuation assistance or the stop of the vehicle by the emergency evacuation assistance, operation means (e.g., levers 20e) included in the vehicle or screen input operable display means (e.g., touch monitor 20f) is operated to enable a moving operation of the vehicle (e.g., operation of start or stop of preventive safety assistance included beforehand in the vehicle, operation of start of stop of automatic running of the vehicle, operation of back-and-forth or lateral movement of the vehicle, or operation of stop).

title_en: Underground shelter for evacuation from tsunami
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a construction method that greatly shortens evacuation time and a movement distance to evacuation facilities to give consideration to aged people, children, disabled people and the like.SOLUTION: A mobile shelter, which is an underground shelter connected to a concrete shelter dock 2, can move upward and downward along a shelter rail 3. A waterproof front panel made of steel is provided in a lower position. A shelter body 1 descends to be automatically and hermetically closed.

title_en: Electric wheelchair
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an electric wheelchair which is capable of releasing electromagnetic brakes by a simple method to enable emergency evacuation by hand movement or the like, in the occurrence of abnormality such as dead batteries and failure of a control system, in an electric wheelchair having non-excitation operative electromagnetic brakes which are operated during non-energization to immobilize a driving wheel.SOLUTION: An electric wheelchair is equipped with non-excitation operative electromagnetic brakes 307, 308 which are operated during non-energization to immobilize a driving wheel. The control circuit of the electromagnetic brakes is configured to have a switching means 310 that changes over to electric power from an external batteries, and a small portable spare batteries are composed of dry batteries. Consequently, a means for releasing the electromagnetic brakes 307, 308 can be effectuated by a simple method, materializing the electric wheelchair capable of emergency evacuation by hand movement or the like in the occurrence of abnormality.

title_en: Emergency broadcasting system for hearing difficulties person
title_ko: 청각장애인을 위한 재난 및 비상상황 방송시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster and emergency broadcasting system for deaf people. The purpose of the present invention is to provide the disaster and emergency broadcasting system for deaf people capable of quickly and safely performing an evacuating process by efficiently making an announcement which the deaf people can recognize in a broadcasting device connected to a remote server through Ethernet or internet network when various disasters or emergency situations occur, and constructing a system with minimum costs and space by implementing the system with a small embedded module and digitally transmitting multifunctional signals such as an audio, data, and a contact through one LAN.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 청각장애인을 위한 재난 및 비상상황 방송시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 각종 재난 및 비상상황의 발생 시에 원격지의 서버 측과 이더넷 및 인터넷망을 통해 연결된 방송장치 측에서 청각장애인의 인지가 가능한 안내방송이 효율적으로 실시되도록 하여 신속하고 안전한 대피가 가능해지도록 하는 한편, 한 개의 LAN망을 이용하여 오디오, 데이터, 접점 등의 다기능 신호를 디지털 전송하도록 함과 아울러 시스템을 소형의 임베디드 모듈로 구현하여 최소비용 및 최소공간으로 시스템을 구축할 수 있도록 한 청각장애인을 위한 재난 및 비상상황 방송시스템을 제공하기 위한 것이다.

title_en: Bed equipped with heat storage tank enabled to be partitioned into zones
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reconsider the case that nearly twenty thousands people could not finish evacuation and passed away in the Great East Japan Earthquake, moreover, nearly 1600 elderly people or the like passed away after evacuation because the living environment in a shelter is too severe even though they got to the refuge facility, they all had to sleep together in a huddle in the shelter for a long period or the like, got ill and died as a result.SOLUTION: A bed equipped with a heat storage tank enabled to be partitioned into zones is characterized by that the sleeping bed is a heat storage tank and equipped with capsules for the bed to interrupt the field of vision around above it.

title_en: Bunk bed capable of inter-sectional partition indoors
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve problems that many elderly people died after evacuation because they became indisposed through a long lasting life such as sleeping bundled together in a room in a shelter, which was due to too severe living environment in shelters even if they somehow arrived at refuge facilities with much effort for example in a situation where more than 20,000 citizens lost their lives without completing refuge in the east Japan earthquake disaster.SOLUTION: A bank bed capable of inter-sectional partition is characterized in that a cubic framework is configured to have a plurality of bed posts (1), bed transverse beams (2) and partition posts (27) and that a lower stage bed (3) and an upper stage bed (4) mounted on the bed posts (1) are prepared inside.

title_en: Digital voice talkback smart fire-fighting emergency lamp
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital voice talkback smart fire-fighting emergency lamp which comprises an emergency lamp controller, an input module, a voice input module, a voice output module and a communication module. The digital voice talkback smart fire-fighting emergency lamp achieves digital fire-fighting talkback with the help of a network transmitting voice signal used by an intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indicating system. By means of the digital voice talkback smart fire-fighting emergency lamp, a user of the digital voice talkback smart fire-fighting emergency lamp is quickly positioned, the trapped persons can report the states of the trapped persons, the number of personnel, whether the trapped persons are injured or not, whether the elderly, infirm sick, disabled, pregnant and other special populations exist or not and environmental information, so that the fire-fighting and rescue personnel can carry the necessary rescue devices timely and precisely, and time spent on the round trips is avoided. In addition, the digital voice talkback smart fire-fighting emergency lamp will provide broadcast in a small range in sub-areas, the voice of broadcast is more targeted, much more information is provided, escape of the trapped persons is facilitated, a traditional fire-fighting broadcast system is replaced, and the fire-fighting system cost in the building is reduced.

title_en: Caregiver rounding with real time locating system tracking
abstract_en: An information technology system for a healthcare facility is provided. The system includes a first computer device to keep track of rounding intervals for caregivers and to determine whether the caregivers successfully complete their rounds in a timely manner for their assigned patients. The system also has a real time locating system (RTLS) that tracks locations of the plurality of caregivers and that is in communication with the first computer device. The system further has a number of graphical displays in communication with the first computer device. Each graphical display is operable to display a list of patients for whom rounds are due and to display reminder messages to the plurality of caregivers relating to rounding.

title_en: Rf tag to detect invasion into and withdrawal from base station vicinity, and system using the same
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide: an RF tag to detect invasion into and withdrawal from a base station vicinity, the tag being improved in energy consumption of conventional RF tags and allowing selective use of invasion and withdrawal by detection and use in, for example, an elderly care facility, an emergent arrangement of investigators from a police office, disposal of a suspicious object, and a display strategy of products; and a system usable for an evacuation behavioral analysis in a large scale evacuation training on the assumption of a disaster.SOLUTION: An RF tag according to the present invention stores the presence or absence of a communication with a base station, and uses it for a logical determination to stop a real time handshake communication to save consumption of a secondary battery. The weak radio wave of the base station includes a designation information as a modulated signal to designate either an invasion or a withdrawal to select an invasion detection mode or a withdrawal detection mode from an upper base station. A practical system using the RF tag to detect a position of a movable object is disclosed.

title_en: A kind of digital speech intercommunication intelligent fire emergency light
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of digital speech intercommunication intelligent fire emergency light, comprising: emergency light controller, load module, voice input module, voice output module, communication module; Realized the Internet Transmission voice signal utilizing by intelligent fire evacuation indication system, digital fire-fighting intercommunication.The utility model is located the intercommunication people of use fast, by two-way voice transmissions, allow trapped personnel report the state of self, personnel amount, whether injured, whether there are the pregnant special population of the old,weak,sick and disabled and environmental information, so that fire-fighting and rescue personnel can promptly and accurately carry necessary rescue aid, avoid repeatedly coming and going and losing time, in addition, the utility model will provide subregional narrowcast, the voice of playing are more targeted, abundanter information is provided, be beneficial to the escape of trapped personnel, substituted traditional fire broadcast system, reduced fire-fighting system cost in building.

title_en: Tsunami evacuation underground shelter for wheelchair user
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To devise a method for largely shortening an evacuation time, since a movement distance to an evacuation facility is very long for an aged person, a child and a visually handicapped person, particularly, including a wheelchair user, and twenty thousands or more of citizens were lost without completing evacuation in the East Japan Earthquake Disaster.SOLUTION: There is provided a structure that a wheelchair user can evacuate to the inside of a shelter body 1 by oneself without requiring assistance of a third person and that the wheelchair user is escapable to the outside of the shelter body 1 and a shelter dock 2 by oneself also when escaping.

title_en: Shelter unit of tsunami danger district
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To devise a method for largely shortening an evacuation time, since a moving distance up to an evacuation facility is very long for an aged person, a child and a disabled person therefore, since 20 thousands or more persons are lost without completing evacuation by the East Japan earthquake disaster.SOLUTION: A shelter unit (1) of underground Tsunami evacuation is installed by connecting escape tube stairs 13 and an escape entrance 3 equipped with a watertight door (32) to be connected to a central shelter (4) and a public shelter (8) buried underground from a reinforced concrete penthouse (5) projecting on the ground.

title_en: Emergency evacuation elevator for tenant of social welfare institution
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency evacuation elevator for tenant of a social welfare institution which allows all tenants who use a bed or a wheelchair to be transported to a rooftop efficiently at short time surely for evacuation, when tidal wave or flood occurs.SOLUTION: The emergency evacuation elevator is used for transporting tenants who use a bed B or a wheelchair K to a rooftop O of the building for evacuation from tidal wave. The elevator comprises at least: a pole frame body 1 whose upper part is opening and which is disposed on an emergency stairway H or a veranda V of the building in a standing state; an elevator cage 2 having a multistep-state floor 21 which is disposed so as to be lifted up and down in an inside of the pole frame body 1, and coping with each stair and an intermediate floor 22; and pulling up means 3 for pulling up the elevator cage 2.

title_en: Helix fire escape structure
abstract_en: Improvements in a fire escape having a structure of a Helix/Spiral Cylinder shape. It's a building within a building. It provides a quick and safe evacuation for all fire victims, including the A.D.A., the injured and the elderly. Its spiral design can accommodate a large number of floor levels. It eliminates the hazards acquainted with stairs and elevators. It has the capability of removing some of the smoke from the high-rise fire by way of a metal Ducting System. It draws the smoke into the center smoke shaft. The spiral is a two-way traffic pathway, which offers Fire Department personnel and their equipment a method of upward transportation to any floor-level they need for fighting this fire incident. My design can be retrofitted to any existing building.

title_en: Rail for evacuate using stairs provided with travel hanging band
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation rail with travel hanging bands which, in a disaster such as an earthquake, a fire, moves down with the gravity along the inclination of stairs in order to safely and quickly evacuate a physically disabled person such as an elderly people, a handicapped person who depends on a wheelchair or the like from a high-level floor to a low-level floor.SOLUTION: Constantly, a rail (1) is laid along the inclination of the stairs and a hanger (3) with hanging bands (10) is housed in the vicinity of a platform of the stairs. In emergency, the hanger (3) is inserted into the rail (1) and the bands (10) are fixed to a wheelchair of an evacuating person to move down. This allows safe and quick evacuation from the high-level floor to the low-level floor without motive power.

title_en: A kind of external hanging type high-rise building personnel emergency evacuation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of external hanging type high-rise building personnel emergency evacuation device, on the bottom that described steel column support is fixed on detrainment device and fire wall, described steel column support PLASTIC LAMINATED seals, described evacuation cabin is arranged in steel column support, described evacuation cabin is moved up and down by main frame traction by steel cable, the outlet of described evacuation cabin is docked with ground passage, described evacuation cabin entrance docks with passageway for fire apparatus or corridor corridor, described fire-fighting cup is positioned at evacuates porch, cabin, described fire resistant doorsets are positioned at fire-fighting cup side, described rack beam is connected with steel column support, described generating set is positioned at the outside of building.The utility model forms the high-rise building personnel emergency evacuation device of functional, safe and reliable a, highly effective, energy-conserving and environment-protective, be specially adapted to social wellfare home, home for destitute, hospital, high-rise building old man, be situated between and protect the emergency evacuation needs of the weak populations such as old man, bed patient, disabled person, children.

title_en: Roadside assistance management
abstract_en: Methods, computer-readable media, software, and apparatuses provide a system for establishing base stations and allocating service vehicles to the base stations in order to provide roadside assistance. The system may include computing devices associated with customer vehicles and service vehicles as well as network computing devices. The system may receive a service request from a customer regarding a disabled vehicle. The system may then identify an appropriate service vehicle to assist the customer and assign the service request to the identified service vehicle. The system may select the appropriate service vehicle based on a location of the disabled vehicle. In an example, the system may choose a service vehicle from a base station closest to or within the shortest driving time to the disabled vehicle. By setting-up base stations in advance of service requests, service vehicles may reach disabled vehicles within a predetermined period of time.

title_en: Guidance lighting system equipped with emergency exit direction guiding function
title_ko: 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit, which is normally used as an emotional lighting lamp and which detects emergency to provide a visual and audio guidance for the direction of emergency exit for safe evacuation in case of emergency such as a fire and a blackout, conducts tactile guidance through a heat generation of a luminescent device for visually and hearing-impaired users and performs an emotional guidance by changing the brightness and color of a luminescent device. For the above purpose, the guidance lighting system having a function of guiding the direction of an emergency exit of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit detecting an emergency and generating an emergency detection signal; a power supply unit normally supplying utility power and supplying charging power in case of emergency; a display unit normally used as a usual lighting and displaying the guidance of the predetermined direction of the closest emergency exit when the emergency detection signal is received; and a control unit controlling the luminescence, voice and alert of the display unit according to a normal state or an emergency state.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 평상시에는 감성 조명등으로 활용하며, 화재 및 정전 등의 비상 상황시 안전하게 대피하기 위하여, 비상 상황을 감지하여 비상구 방향에 대한 시청각 안내를 수행하고, 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위하여 발광 소자 열 발생에 의한 촉각 안내를 수행하며, 발광 소자 밝기 및 색깔의 변화를 통한 감성 안내를 수행하는 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.  
이러한 기술적 과제를 달성하기 위한 본 발명은 비상구 방향 안내 기능을 가지는 유도등 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 비상 상황을 감지하여, 비상 상황 감지신호를 생성하는 센서부; 평상시 상용전원을 공급하고, 비상 상황시 충전전원을 공급하는 전원 공급부; 평상시 일반 조명으로 사용되며, 비상 상황 감지신호가 전달된 경우, 기 설정된 최근접한 비상구 방향을 안내하도록 표시하는 표시부; 및 평상시 및 비상 상황에 따라 상기 표시부의 발광과, 음성 및 경보를 제어하는 제어부; 를 포함한다.

title_en: Air breathing apparatus for emergency escape
title_ko: 매연 및 가스 발생 공간에서 비상 탈출용 산소 흡입장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an oxygen inhalation apparatus for emergency evacuation in a place emitting exhaust and gas which enables the elderly and children to inhale cleaned air with a little suction power by forming an air storage space portion inside a bellows tube where a suction pipe is connected. The present invention comprises: the bellows pipe built in a vertical direction as a lower portion is open, having an upper cover with the suction pipe fixed into an upper portion, and made of a material having sealability; a pipe lower cover for covering the lower portion of the bellows tube, and having a central groove on the center; and an air filter element installed in the central groove, filtering outdoor air, and introducing the outdoor air to the inside of the bellows tube.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 흡입관이 연결된 자바라관의 내부에 공기 저장공간부를 형성함으로써 노약자나 아동 들이 적은 흡입력으로도 정화된 공기를 흡입할 수 있도록 하는 매연 및 가스 발생 공간에서 비상 탈출용 산소 흡입장치에 관한 것으로, 하부가 개방되어 수직 방향으로 신축되고, 상부에는 흡입관을 가지는 상부커버가 고정되며, 밀봉성을 가지는 재질로 구성되는 자바라관과; 상기 자바라관의 하부를 커버하고 중앙에는 중앙홀이 형성되는 관 하부커버와; 상기 중앙홀에 설치되어 외부 공기를 정화시켜 상기 자바라관의 내부로 유입시키는 공기 필터수단;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Shelter
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a shelter which is easily installable in the neighborhood of an evacuee, and capable of reducing installation costs, in which even an elderly person or a sick person or the like can quickly and safely evacuate.SOLUTION: A shelter 1 having an evacuation space with earthquake resistance and water tightness is configured of: a foundation part 10 installed underground; and a main body part 20 fixed to the foundation part 10, and the upper part of the main body part 20 is formed in an elliptical dome shape or a lemon shape in a planar view, and more than half the whole shelter 1 is embedded underground, and a hatch 30 for a doorway is mounted on a place exposed on the ground of the upper part of the main body part 20.

title_en: Ring buoy boat for tsunami evacuation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a ring buoy boat for tsunami evacuation to boarded for protecting a person's life when there is no evacuation site nearby such as an upland and a high building in a coastal area when a tsunami is generated by a giant earthquake.SOLUTION: There is provided a ring buoy boat for tsunami evacuation in which: a bottom is attached to a cylindrical side; a ring buoy is attached to an outer peripheral wall of a body provided with a freely openable/closable lid 7; and a balance weight for stabilizing the body is placed at the bottom. By the balance of the buoyant force of the ring buoy attached to the outer peripheral wall of the body and the weight of the balance weight placed at the bottom, an effect for the ring buoy boat to always keep an erect posture on the water surface is generated so that though the ring buoy boat is caused to drift by waves when attacked by a tsunami, it is unlikely to sink, thereby reducing victims such as a person who cannot swim, an elderly person who is short on physical strength, and an infant, to say nothing of ordinary people, as much as possible.

title_en: Need determination system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a need determination system including a user interface for enabling a person to input a current combination of a current subject, at least one current informal caregiver (ICG) giving care to the current subject, and at least one relationship between the current subject and the at least one current ICG. A combination similarity measure is applied to the current combination and stored combinations, in order to determine a stored combination which is similar to the current combination, where a need of the current subject and/or a need of the at least one current ICG are determined based on one or more needs assigned to a stored subject and/or stored ICGs of the determined similar stored combination. This allows for a reliable and fast determination of needs of a subject and/or an ICG with relatively low technical efforts.

title_en: Fire detection and alarm system for the blind and the deaf
title_ko: 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위한 화재 감지 및 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection and warning system for visually and hearing impaired persons. The fire detection and warning system for visually and hearing impaired persons of the present invention comprises: an audio-visual output unit for broadcasting an auditory emergency guide in accordance with a sound warning which guides an evacuation guide path from a sound input unit and for displaying a visual evacuation direction by using a data signal and power; a data signal generating unit for generating the data signal for controlling a guide direction display displayed through the audio-visual output unit; an oxygen supply equipment unit for supplying oxygen when oxygen is insufficient in a space due to smoke or gas leakage as a result of a fire occurrence; a PLC communications unit for synthesizing a sound signal, a data signal, and power to an evacuation guide signal and thereby transmitting to the audio-visual output unit and for transmitting an operation control signal to the oxygen supply equipment unit; and a control unit for monitoring a state of each component and for controlling an operation thereof. According to the present invention, when a fire occurs, a voice guide broadcast is performed to guide the visually and hearing impaired persons to an exit far away from the fire occurrence point, a letter, a sign and a specific pattern having an improved visibility are displayed through a blinking light having a variety of patterns, and oxygen is provided as needed. Therefore, it is possible to safely evacuate visually and hearing impaired persons.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위한 화재 감지 및 경보 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위한 화재 감지 및 경보 시스템은, 음향 입력부로부터의 대피 유도 경로를 안내하는 음향 신호에 따른 청각적 비상 안내 방송을 하고, 데이터 신호 및 전원을 이용하여 시각적 대피 유도 방향을 표시하는 시청각 출력부와, 시청각 출력부를 통해 표시되는 유도 방향 표시를 제어하는 상기 데이터 신호를 생성하는 데이터 신호 생성부와, 화재 발생에 따른 연기나 가스 누출로 인해 산소가 부족할 경우 해당 공간에 산소를 공급하는 산소 공급 설비부와, 음향 신호, 데이터 신호 및 전원을 대피 유도 신호로 합성하여 시청각 출력부로 전송하고, 산소 공급 설비부로 동작 제어 신호를 전송하는 PLC 통신부와, 제 구성요소의 상태 점검 및 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이와 같은 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 발생시 화재 발생지점으로부터 멀어지는 쪽의 대피 비상구나 출입구 쪽으로 유도하는 음성 안내 방송을 수행하고, 다양한 패턴의 점멸 조명을 통해 시인성을 높인 문자, 기호, 특정 이미지를 표시하며, 필요에 따라서 산소를 함께 공급함으로써, 시각 및 청각 장애인이 안전하게 대피할 수 있다.

title_en: A fire alarm function Flashing LED lights
title_ko: 화재 경보 기능을 갖는 점멸 led 등기구
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a flickering LED lamp having a fire alarm function comprises: a power unit (10) receiving an outputted fire signal to supply power to a control unit (20); a microprocessor (MPU) (21) controlling an operation of a pulse output unit (22); a control unit (20) including the pulse output unit (22), which outputs a pulse having a predetermined amplitude and period; and a power switch (30) controlling at least one LED lamp (2) to continuously flicker. Therefore, the flickering LED lamp minimizes damage of human life due to fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 경보 기능을 갖는 점멸 LED 등기구에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은 화재경보기가 구축된 건물에 설치되는 LED 등기구에 있어서, 
상기 화재경보기와 연결되어 화재 발생으로 인해 상기 화재경보기에서 화재신호가 출력되면, 그 출력된 화재신호를 전송받아 제어부로 전원을 공급하는 전원부;와, 상기 전원부와 연결되어 상기 전원부로부터 전원을 공급받아 작동하는 것으로, 펄스 출력부의 작동을 제어하는 마이크로프로세서(MPU)와, 상기 마이크로프로세서의 제어를 통해 작동하는 것으로, 상기 전원부의 전원을 이용하여 일정한 진폭과 주기를 가진 펄스를 출력시키는 펄스 출력부로 구성되는 제어부;와, 상기 LED 등기구로 전원을 공급하는 메인 전선 상에 형성되어 상기 펄스 출력부에서 출력하는 펄스 신호를 전송받고, 그 펄스 신호를 기반으로 상기 메인 전선으로 도통되는 전원의 흐름을 제어하여 하나 이상의 상기 LED 등기구가 연속적으로 점멸(點滅)되도록 제어하는 전원스위치(SMPS:Switch Mode Power Supply);를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것으로서,  
건물에 구축되는 화재경보기와 연결되어 화재경보기에서 화재가 감지되면, 그 화재 감지신호를 전송받는 제어부에서 건물에 설치되는 수많은 LED 등기구가 연속적으로 점멸되도록 제어하여 LED 등기구가 화재 발생을 신속하게 전파하는 경보등의 기능을 수행하도록 함으로, 건물 내부에 있는 사람들이 LED 등기구의 연속적인 점멸을 통해 화재발생 상황을 명확하고 신속하게 인지하고 대피할 수 있도록 유도하여 화재로 인한 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
더욱이, 큰 소음이 발생하는 공장건물에 작업하는 작업자나 청각 장애인들은 건물 내부에 필수적으로 설치되는 수많은 LED 등기구의 점멸을 통해서 시각적으로 화재발생 상황을 용이하게 인지하고 대피할 수 있어 종래에 작업자나 청각 장애인들이 화재발생 상황을 신속하게 인지하지 못하여 발생하는 인명피해를 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 별도의 교체 없이 통상 건물에 설치되는 화재경보기와 LED 등기구에 전원부와 제어부 및 전원스위치를 간편히 적용 실시할 수 있어 제품의 사용범용성을 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Wheelchair front suspension device
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an assistance device for moving a wheelchair upon a stairway, which is capable of reducing the burden upon a caregiver or a worker at a facility when such as a patient in a hospital or a care facility makes an emergency evacuation via the stairway in the wheelchair. Provided is a wheelchair assistance device having a structure which is adapted to a structure which is common to typical wheelchairs, allowing ease of movement of the wheelchair upon a stairway by the attachment of the assistance device to the wheelchair. Specifically: a rigid rectangular frame is used; L-shaped hooks and plates forming support parts are disposed thereupon, having rigidity which withstands use; the frontal frame of the rectangular frame is positioned ahead of footrests of a wheelchair when the rectangular frame is detachably suspended by the L-shaped hooks upon the frame of the wheelchair; and the plates hold the footrests of the wheelchair from below. Thus, the wheelchair can be supported from the footrest side thereof.

title_en: escaping braille device from a fire for blinfperson
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Braille device for a fire evacuation of a blind person. In the Braille device for a fire evacuation of a blind person according to the present invention, a central assembly unit is attached on an inner wall of a corridor at a predetermined height. The central assembly unit comprises: a base plate to which a central control unit and a power supply unit connected by a wire are attached; a speaker unit which is attached to a front surface of the base plate and is connected to the central control unit and the power supply unit by the wire; a toxic gas measuring device which is attached to the front surface of the base plate and is connected to the central control unit and the power supply unit by the wire; a central driving assembly which is attached to the front surface of the base plate, accommodates a driving unit connected to the central control unit and the power supply unit by the wire, and is configured such that a first push bar or a second push bar is alternatively projected and inserted by the driving unit; a first Braille plate and a second Braille plate which have a plurality of Braille protrusions indicating a specific direction or characters ; and a cover box which has a toxic gas inlet port at a bottom, accommodates the central driving assembly and the Braille plate, and is detachably connected to the base plate. Therefore, a person who cannot see the front such as the blind person as well as an ordinary person can easily evacuate in case of fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 시각장애인용 화재대피 점자장치는 일정높이를 가지도록 복도 내벽에 수평방향으로 중앙 조립부가 부착되며, 상기 중앙 조립부는, 전선으로 연결된 중앙 제어부 및 전원부가 부착된 베이스 플레이트; 상기 베이스 플레이트의 전면에 부착되며, 상기 중앙 제어부 및 상기 전원부와 전선으로 연결된 스피커부; 상기 베이스 플레이트의 전면에 부착되며, 상기 중앙 제어부 및 상기 전원부와 전선으로 연결된 유독가스 측정기; 상기 베이스 플레이트의 전면에 부착되며, 상기 중앙 제어부 및 상기 전원부와 전선으로 연결된 구동부를 수용하며, 상기 구동부에 의해 제 1 푸쉬바 또는 제 2 푸쉬바가 번갈아 돌출 및 삽입되는 중앙 구동조립체; 특정 방향 또는 문자를 나타내는 다수의 점자 돌기가 형성된 제 1 점자 플레이트 및 제 2 점자 플레이트; 및 하단에 유독가스 흡입구가 마련되며 상기 중앙 구동조립체 및 상기 점자 플레이트를 수용하며 상기 베이스 플레이트와 분리 가능하게 결합되는 커버 박스;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
따라서, 일반인뿐만 아니라 시각장애인과 같이 앞을 볼 수 없는 사람도 화재 발생시 그 대피를 용이하게 할 수 있다.

title_en: System for guiding evacuation exit path and led braille block
title_ko: 비상 대피로 안내 시스템 및 엘이디 점자 블록
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for guiding an emergency exit route and an LED Braille block capable of effectively guiding a user exit route on the basis of a detection result of an emergency situation such as a fire. The system for guiding an emergency exit route according to an embodiment of the present invention can include: an LED Braille block which has an LED inserted therein and is installed on a bottom surface of a prescribed structure to be able to guide moving lines to blind people, wherein the LED is turned on, light from the LED is displayed on the surface of the LED Braille block; a detecting unit including a detecting sensor capable of detecting an emergency situation; a memory for storing the detected result or information on a plurality of light emitting patterns; a power supplying unit for supplying power to the LED Braille block for lighting the LED; and a control unit for controlling the LED Braille block to be lighted according to a first light emitting pattern, when the emergency situation is not detected, extracting a second light emitting pattern from among the plurality of light emitting patterns in consideration of an emergency-detected position, when the emergency situation is detected, controlling the LED Braille block to be lighted according to the extracted second light emitting pattern, and controlling the detecting unit, the memory, and the power supplying unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 등의 비상 상황 감지 결과에 근거하여 사용자의 대피 경로를 효과적으로 안내할 수 있는 비상 대피로 안내 시스템 및 엘이디 점자 블록에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일실시예에 의한 비상 대피로 안내 시스템은 내부에 삽입된 엘이디를 구비하고, 소정 구조물의 바닥면에 설치되어 시각 장애인들의 동선을 안내할 수 있는 엘이디 점자 블록-상기 엘이디 발광 시, 상기 엘이디 점자 블록 표면으로 엘이디 발광이 표시됨-; 비상 상황을 감지할 수 있는 감지 센서를 포함하는 감지부; 상기 감지 결과 또는 복수 개의 발광 패턴에 대한 정보를 저장하는 메모리; 상기 엘이디 발광을 위해 상기 엘이디 점자 블록에 전원을 공급하는 전원부; 상기 비상 상황이 감지되지 않은 경우는 제1발광 패턴에 따라 상기 엘이디 점자 블록이 발광되도록 제어하고, 상기 비상 상황이 감지된 경우는 복수 개의 발광 패턴 중 상기 비상 감지 위치를 고려하여 제2발광 패턴을 추출하고, 상기 추출된 제2발광 패턴에 따라 상기 엘이디 점자 블록이 발광되도록 제어하며, 상기 감지부, 상기 메모리, 상기 전원부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Wheelchair movement support tool incorporated in wheelchair
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wheelchair movement support tool which supports emergency evacuation in a disaster time, etc. and travel movement on an irregular ground such as a sand, snowy road, gravel road, and muddy slough, and an upward slope, is incorporated in a wheelchair, and includes a drawer structure of a handrail.SOLUTION: The wheelchair movement support tool incorporated in wheelchair includes: two pipe frame storage parts fixed on and adjacently to an upper side, outer side, or lower side of right/left arm pipes of a wheelchair or fixed on and separated from the lower side of the arm pipe; and plural pipe frame members stored in the pipe frame storage part and having different diameters. The storage part serves as the pipe frame in the first stage, the pipe frames in respective stages are fitted and inserted to each other so as to slide in a nest shape, thereby allowing the pipe frame members in many stages expand/contract in a linear way. An end of the pipe frame having the smallest diameter in the final stage is curved or bent to form a grip part. By gripping the right/left grip part or gripping a connection member connected with the right/left grip part, the wheelchair can be moved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of evacuation robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of evacuation robots, including wheelchair, middle control chipset, micro database, communication module, mobile control module, voice output, video input, voice input, navigation module.The present invention can be evacuated automatically by navigation system by medical staff's navigation, patient's manual operation or according to the evacuation procedures originally set, so as to assist realizing the disaster emergency evacuation of the handicapped crowds such as patient, old man well, it avoids the disasters such as fire, toxic gas leakage from being rescued under people's difficulty and dangerous situation when occurring and rescues professional firefighters' injures and deaths brought by people, the evacuation especially suitable for disasters such as ward fire, poison gas leakages；The present invention can complete simple acute care well again simultaneously and assist personnel completes pre- diagnosis, and the medical care that medical aid station may cause after avoiding medical staff that from must first diagnosing face-to-face is not in time.

title_en: Evacuation Routes notification system for visually impaired
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route notification system for a visually impaired person and, more specifically, to an evacuation route notification system which provides an evacuation direction for a visually impaired person by a plurality of vibrator units installed in a handrail or a guide foothold which guides the movement direction of the visually impaired person by being installed along the wall surface of a building. The vibrator units are driven by a phase difference vibrator circuit comprising: a control box which provides a direction signal by a fire signal received from a fire sensor; a forward/reverse shift register which generates a time difference vibration signal by the direction signal received from the control box; and a plurality of vibrators which vibrates by receiving the time difference vibration signal received from the forward/reverse shift register.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시각 장애인을 위한 대피경로 알림시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 바람직하게는 건물의 벽면을 따라 설치되어 시각장애인의 이동방향을 안내하는 핸드레일의 내부 또는 안내발판에 설치되는 다수개의 진동자유닛에 의해 시각 장애인에게 대피방향을 제공하는 것으로써 상기 진동자유닛은 화재감지기로부터 수신한 화재신호에 의해 방향신호를 제공하는 컨트롤박스와 상기 컨트롤박스에서 수신한  방향신호에 의해 시간차 진동신호를 발생하는 정/역 시프트레지스터와 상기 정/역 시프트레지스터로부터 수신한 시간차 진동신호를 수신 받아 진동하는 다수개의 진동자로 구성된 위상차 진동자 회로에 의해 구동되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Openable fence
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an openable fence capable of safely evacuating injured people or old and weak people and preventing the fence from becoming an obstacle by being opened to a passage in case of emergency. The present invention comprises: posts stood in both sides at a distance from the ground; multiple cross beams placed between the posts at regular intervals; a hanging beam keeping the cross beams at regular intervals by being inserted into the posts to be hung on both end parts of the cross beams; a rotating beam hinged with the bottom of the posts to form a tread as the cross beams are arranged and laid; and a manipulating tool moving the cross beams downward to gather and arrange the beams on the rotating beam by releasing the hung hanging beam. Therefore, the present invention is capable of safely evacuating injured people or old and weak people and preventing the fence from becoming an obstacle to a rescue in an accident by being opened to a passage, enabling moving units such as a wheelchair or trolley to easily move by placing the cross beams of the fence over a boundary stone between a sidewalk and a vehicle road, and preventing a secondary accident through a lighting lamp installed on the fence.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 필요 상황 발생시에 통로로 열 수 있게 하여 부상자나 노약자를 안전하게 대피시키고 펜스가 사고 수습의 장애가 되지 않게 하는 개폐가능 펜스에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 개폐가능 펜스는 지면에 간격을 두고 양측에 세워지는 포스트와, 포스트 사이에 일정 간격으로 배치된 복수의 가로대와, 포스트 내에 삽입되어 가로대의 양단부를 걸리게 함에 따라 가로대를 일정간격으로 유지시키는 걸림대와, 포스트의 하부에 힌지결합되어 세워져 포스트를 따라 이동한 가로대가 배열되어 눕혀지게 됨에 따라 트레드를 이루는 회동대와, 걸림대의 걸림을 해제하여 가로대를 하측으로 이동시킴에 따라 회동대에 모여 배열되게 하는 조작기구를 포함한다. 
이러한 구성에 의하면, 필요 상황 발생시에 통로로 열 수 있게 하여 부상자나 노약자를 안전하게 대피시키고 펜스가 사고 수습 및 활동에 장애가 되지 않게 하며, 펜스의 가로대가 인도와 차도의 경계턱에 걸쳐져서 휠체어나 운반 수레 등의 이동기구들이 쉽게 통과할 수 있게 하며, 펜스에 설치되는 조명램프를 통해 사고 시에 2차 사고를 방지하게 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System for preventing missing dotard using wireless broadcasting system for village
title_ko: 무선 마을방송 시스템을 이용한 치매노인 실종 방지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing a missing demented elderly using a wireless village broadcasting system. The present invention relates to a system for preventing a missing demented elderly using a wireless village broadcasting system which induces a protector to move a demented elderly to a safe place right away by notifying through a village broadcasting system when an activity pattern of the demented elderly is escaped from a reference region, additionally puts an accessory for communication on the demented elderly, and induces the demented elderly not to escape from the activity pattern by transferring an electric impulse when the demented elderly escapes from the activity pattern by assigning, to the accessory for communication, an apparatus for giving a warning impulse.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 마을방송 시스템을 이용한 치매노인 실종 방지 시스템에 있어서, 치매노인의 활동 패턴이 기준 지역을 벗어나면 마을방송 시스템을 통해 통보하여 보호자가 곧바로 치매노인을 안전장소로 이동시킬 수 있도록 유도하며, 아울러 치매 노인에게 통신용 악세서리를 착용시키고, 상기 통신용 악세서리에는 경고성 자극을 주는 장치를 부가하여 활동반경을 벗어나면 전기적 자극을 전달함으로서 치매 노인이 활동반경을 이탈하지 않토록 유도하는 것을 특징으로 하는 무선 마을방송 시스템을 이용한 치매노인 실종 방지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 
치매환자가 소지하는 것으로, 지피에스 방식으로 위치정보를 송출하고, 전기적 자극을 가할 수 있는 장치를 부가 설치하여 이루어지며, 환자 단말기가 지정된 구역을 벗어나면 치매 환자에게 전기 충격부를 구동하여 전기적 자극을 가함으로서 정해진 경로를 이탈하지 않토록 유도하는 환자단말기(110)와;  상기 환자단말기(110)로부터 상기 위치정보를 수신하는 것으로, 상기 치매환자를 보호하는 보호자의 입력을 통해 전송받은 보호자의 개인정보, 치매환자의 개인정보, 치매환자의 개인일정, 및 치매환자의 개인일정에 따르는 안전반경이 저장되고, 상기 위치정보로부터 상기 치매환자의 위치정보를 획득하고, 상기 치매환자의 위치정보를 통해 상기 안전반경을 기준으로 하여 행동이력을 저장하되, 상기 행동이력을 상기 치매환자의 위치정보가 상기 안전반경 내에서 정상적으로 이동하는 정상행동, 상기 안전반경 외로 이탈하는 이탈행동, 및 상기 안전반경 내에서 배회하는 배회행동으로 구분 저장하여 패턴화하면서, 상기 치매환자의 위치정보가 상기 이탈행동 혹은 상기 배회행동으로 감지되면, 위험알림서비스를 발생시켜 상기 이탈행동 혹은 배회행동에 따르는 상기 치매환자의 위치정보와 이동경로를 전송하는 관리서버(120)와;  상기 보호자가 소지하는 것으로, 상기 보호자의 입력을 통해 상기 보호자의 개인정보, 상기 치매환자의 개인정보, 상기 치매환자의 개인일정, 상기 안전반경을 상기 관리서버(120)에 전송하여 저장하되, 상기 관리서버(120)에서 발생하는 상기 위험알림서비스를 제공받아 상기 이탈행동 혹은 상기 배회행동에 따르는 상기 치매환자의 위치정보와 이동경로를 상기 관리서버(120)로부터 전송받아 표시하고, 상기 보호자의 입력에 따라 상기 이탈행동 혹은 배회행동에 대한 후속조치를 처리하는 보호자단말기(130)와;  상기 관리서버(120)에 연동되어 작동되며, 관리서버(120)에서 치매환자에 안내방송을 실시요청할때 공개적 방송을 통해 치매환자의 발견을 이웃들에게 알리고 집으로 되도록가도록 유도하는 마을방송 출력부(140)를 포함하여 이루어짐이 특징이다.
