title_en: Transfer pocket with bedridden patient escaping means and emergency escaping apparatus with thereof
title_ko: 와상 환자 이송낭 피난수단 및 이를 가지는 비상탈출장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a device to evacuate a casualty bag for a bedridden patient, comprising: a housing fixated on an upper side of an evacuation and escape door constructed in an emergency escape space of a corresponding facility; a rotating shaft arranged in a longitudinal direction within the housing; a pair of rotating pulleys fixatedly installed on edges of both sides of the rotating shaft, opening an evacuation and escape door by a weight of the casualty bag as the casualty bag is fastened to a first fastening unit formed on one end of a rope in a state which a portion of the rope is guided, guiding and moving a remaining portion thrown out of the emergency escape space to move up a second fastening unit formed on the other end of the rope, and continuously fastening and dropping another casualty bag and simultaneously rotating the rotating shaft; a rotating gear formed on one side of the rotating pulleys to rotate together with the rotating pulleys; and a speed controller reducing a rotational speed of the rotating shaft to lower the casualty bag at a regular speed in a state of being engaged with the rotating gear in a case where the rotating gear rotates at a set speed or more. The present invention is installed in an emergency escape space of a welfare facility for the elderly to enable the casualty bag, in which the bedridden patient lies, to be lowered to an escape floor at a regular speed when an emergency state occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의하면, 해당 시설의 비상탈출공간에 구성되는 피난탈출구도어의 상측부에 고정되는 하우징; 하우징의 내부에 길이 방향으로 배열되며 공회전 가능한 상태로 구성되는 회전축; 회전축의 양측 가장자리부위에 각각 고정 설치되고 로프의 일부분이 가이드된 상태를 가지며 로프의 일단부에 구성된 제1결속수단에 이송낭이 결속됨에 따라 이송낭의 무게에 의해 피난탈출구도어가 개방된 후 비상탈출공간 외부로 던져진 로프의 나머지 부분이 가이드 이동되도록 하여 로프의 타단부에 구성된 제2결속수단이 상향 이동되도록 하여 연속적으로 다른 이송낭이 결속 및 하강되도록 함과 동시에 회전축이 회전되도록 하는 한 쌍의 회전풀리; 회전풀리의 일측에 구성되어 회전풀리와 함께 회전되는 회전기어; 및 회전기어에 맞물림 구성된 상태에서 회전기어가 일정 속도 이상으로 회전되는 경우 회전축의 회전이 감속되도록 하여 이송낭이 일정한 속도로 하강되도록 하는 속도조절기를 포함하는 와상 환자 이송낭 피난수단이 제공된다.

title_en: Tsunami evacuation facility
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To inexpensively provide a simply-configured tsunami evacuation facility for a tsunami evacuation difficulty area, which enables evacuation of persons including a physically disabled person, an aged person and an infant.SOLUTION: In a tsunami evacuation facility, a steel pipe with a steel pipe diameter of 0.3-1.0 m is used as a foundation pile by being driven radially from the center of a circular shape by half a length of 10-30 m into ground; half of an above-ground part is used as an above-ground part steel pipe support; a circular crown steel beam and a circular crown steel beam provided on a steel pipe head at the center of a circle are connected to its head; a circular evacuation floor slab is provided; and the whole floor slab is covered with a dome type roof or a deck roof. Furthermore, the tsunami evacuation facility comprises a circular raised-floor tsunami evacuation structure with no roof.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Auxiliary tool for knapsack
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce a burden on the shoulder with weight of a knapsack by devising a shape of a tool to be held between the shoulder and the back of the lower end of the knapsack, as pain on the shoulder may be felt when a heavy object is shouldered for a long time and also the shoulder is sometimes pulled back when the knapsack gets warped, with the upper part of the knapsack separated from the body and bent backward.SOLUTION: The auxiliary tool for a knapsack is placed between the back and the back of the lower end of the knapsack, with the knapsack shouldered, so that the weight of the knapsack is dispersed to the shoulder and the back. The tool has a curved face along the back and a surface along the knapsack, the upper part of the auxiliary tool for the knapsack is narrower than the lower part, and the auxiliary tool has a shape making the knapsack inclined to the body side. Also, as there is a space formed above the auxiliary tool of the knapsack, it is adaptable to the anti-sweating measures of the back, making the shouldering comfortable. Men and women of all ages frequently have an opportunity of shouldering in various scenes. As it enables the elderly to comfortably shoulder a knapsack as well as being generally used in attending school and mountain-climbing, the auxiliary tool for a knapsack is also useful for emergency evacuation in a disaster for example.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Safety confirmation system for elderly people
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide precise safety confirmation means that does not make elderly people conscious of being watched and does not force a watcher to bear personnel and cost burden.SOLUTION: In the home of an elderly people, a tablet terminal 1 operated daily as a living tool, a server 2 that collects, transmits, and accumulates its operation state, and a personal computer 3 that provides a watcher side with safety information are provided. The server 2 notifies the tablet terminal 1 in the home of an elderly people of a message, and disaster prevention and disaster-proof information. In a peacetime disaster prevention training, training is performed meticulously to read disaster prevention and disaster-proof information without delay and to stay indoors or move to an evacuation place according to the information. Through perfect training and by reading state confirmation means provided with a watcher side, elderly people who have read the information can be presumed to have avoided disaster.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Emergency escape door of fireproof shutter
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency escape door of a fireproof shutter. The emergency escape door (100) is separated into a lower emergency escape door (110) and an upper emergency escape door (120), and only the lower emergency escape door (120) is opened when the lower emergency escape door (110) is opened. Moreover, both the upper and lower emergency escape doors (110, 120) are simultaneously opened when the upper emergency escape door (120) is opened, and hinges (111, 121) of the lower emergency escape door (110) and the upper emergency escape door (120) can maintain a closed state in a case of a free condition by using a spring hinge. Moreover, elasticity of a spring enables the lower emergency escape door (110) to be weaker than the upper emergency escape door (120) to enable the lower emergency escape door to be linked to be opened and closed with the upper emergency escape door, simultaneously, when the upper emergency escape door is used. In addition, only the lower emergency escape door can be opened and closed when the lower emergency escape door is used to allow ordinary persons, the elderly, and the infirm to easily move to a safety zone to escape through the lower emergency escape door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방화셔터의 비상탈출문에 관한 것으로, 비상탈출문(100)은 하부비상탈출문(110)과 상부비상탈출문(120)으로 분리하여 형성하되, 하부비상탈출문(110)을 열때에는 하부비상탈출문(110)만 열리도록 하고, 상부비상탈출문(120)을 열때에는 상하부비상탈출문(110,120) 모두가 동시에 열릴 수 있도록 함과 동시 하부비상탈출문(110)과 상부비상탈출문(120)의 경첩(111, 121)은 스프링 경첩을 이용하여 자유상태에서 닫힌 상태를 유지할 수 있도록 하되 스프링의 탄성이 상부비상탈출문(120)보다 하부비상탈출문(110)를 약하게 형성하여 상부측 비상탈출문을 사용할 때에는 하부측 비상탈출문이 연동하여 동시에 개폐하도록 하고 하부측 비상탈출문을 사용할 때에는 하부측 비상탈출문만 단독으로 개폐할 수 있도록 하여 일반인은 물론 노약자가 하부측 비상탈출문을 통해 손쉽게 안전지대로 이동하여 대피할 수 있도록 하는 것이다.

title_en: Safty guardrail having refuge ability for building
title_ko: 피난 기능을 구비한 건축용 안전 난간
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a safety guardrail having refuge ability for a building comprises a fixing type guardrail unit, a moving type guardrail unit, a refuge guide unit, a closing maintaining unit, a drawing out unit, and a cutting unit. The present invention provides the safety guardrail having refuge ability for a building, which enables the old and the infirm, children, and the disabled in addition to a normal adult to easily and quickly take refuge.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 피난 기능을 구비한 건축용 안전 난간은, 내부에 빈 공간이 형성된 직사각형 틀 형상으로 형성되고, 건축물에 시공된 창문과 일정간격 이격되는 수직프레임과, 상기 수직프레임의 상,하측 양단에서 건축물의 외벽을 향해 수평방향으로 절곡되고 그 끝단이 건축물의 외벽에 고정되는 고정바와, 상기 수직프레임의 내부공간을 따라 서로 간격을 두고 형성되는 수직보강바 및 수직프레임의 하측 양단에 형성된 고정바의 사이에 서로 간격을 두고 형성되는 수평보강바로 구성되는 고정형난간부, 
일측은 건축물의 상층부와 하층부 사이 경계지점에 위치되는 슬래브의 내부에 마련된 수용공간에 수용되고, 타측은 상기 수용공간의 외부로 돌출되어 상기 수직프레임의 하측에 형성된 고정바 및 수평보강바의 저면과 일정간격 이격되되, 상기 수용공간의 외부로 돌출된 부분에는 상,하 방향으로 관통되는 피난구가 구비된 확장부와, 상기 확장부의 끝단에서 상측을 향해 절곡되고 상기 수직프레임과 일정간격 이격되는 추락방지용가드부로 구성되는 이동형난간부, 
상기 피난구에 경첩을 통해 설치되고, 하 방향으로 회동시 상기 피난구를 개방시키면서 하층부로의 대피를 안내하는 경사진 형태의 대피로를 형성하는 대피가이드부, 
상측은 상기 수평보강바에 고정되고, 하측은 상기 대피가이드부의 상면에 고정되어, 상기 대피가이드부가 상기 피난구를 폐쇄시킨 상태를 유지하도록 하는 폐쇄유지부, 
길이방향이 수평을 향하도록 상기 슬래브의 수용공간에 설치되고, 상기 이동형난간부를 건축물의 외벽과 멀어지는 방향으로 이동시켜 상기 수직프레임의 일측으로 상기 대피가이드부가 노출되도록 하는 인출부, 
상기 확장부의 상면에 설치되며, 상기 폐쇄유지부와 접촉된 상태를 유지하고 있다가 상기 이동형난간부가 전진될 경우 함께 전진되면서 상기 폐쇄유지부를 커팅하여 상기 대피가이드부가 자중에 의해 하 방향으로 회동되도록 하는 커팅부를 포함한다.

title_en: Wheelchair having detachable stretcher
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 침대형 휠체어용 탈부착 들것에 관한 것으로서, 제1 프레임, 제2 프레임 및 제3 프레임이 연속해서 결합되고, 제2 프레임의 양측종단에서 제1 프레임 및 제3 프레임이 회동하도록 결합되는 중공형상의 한 쌍의 프레임; 제3 프레임의 종단을 연결하여 한 쌍의 프레임을 이격 배치시키는 간격유지 프레임; 및 한 쌍의 제1 프레임을 서로 연결하는 제1 천막, 제2 프레임을 서로 연결하는 제2 천막 및 제3 프레임을 서로 연결하는 등받이 천막을 포함하며, 제1 프레임은 다리 프레임에 이웃하여 배치되고, 제2 프레임은 좌석 프레임에 이웃하여 배치되며, 제3 프레임은 등받이 프레임에 이웃하여 배치된다. 
본 발명에 의하면, 평상시에는 침대형 휠체어로 사용하다가 필요에 따라 침대형 휠체어에서 들것을 분리시켜 사용할 수 있다. 특히, 화재와 같은 긴급 상황 시 침대형 휠체어에서 들것을 분리시켜 사용함으로써 시간을 단축하여 환자를 신속하게 이동시킬 수 있으며, 탄소강 재질의 경량으로 형성되어 힘이 약한 보호자라도 몸에 무리를 덜 받으면서 환자를 이동할 수 있다.

title_en: Three-wheel bicycle for flood evacuation
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a quick evacuation of a person without a driver's license, an elderly person, a disabled person, or the like to a designated evacuation place or to an upland without a risk of being submerged at a time of generation of a large-scale flood such as a big Tsunami or flood (flood of river), and to enable a floating of a vehicle on the water surface if the vehicle has danger of submergence during the evacuation.SOLUTION: A three-wheel bicycle for flood evacuation is provided with a platform 2 specified for a wheelchair having a seat, a handrail, a foot rest, a seat belt and the like attached to the platform positions of the rear part of the vehicle 1 of an existing electric motor-driven three-wheel bicycle or engine-driven three-wheel bicycle. Further, the three-wheeled bicycle has airbags 3 which are installed in an airless state and which can enclose air in such an amount as to float the vehicle 1 on the water surface, and an air filling device 4 capable of filling air into the air bags 3 at an appropriate position of the vehicle 1. As the result, the three-wheeled bicycle is configured to float the vehicle 1 on the water surface by inflating the airbag 3 at an occurrence of a large-scale flood where the vehicle 1 may be submerged.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Wheelchair front suspension device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wheelchair front suspension device in which, preferably, a wheelchair suspension device compatible with a wheelchair having a detachable footrest in an emergency evacuation by a wheelchair may be provided, and the wheelchair may not be limited, and also an auxiliary device for stair evacuation of a lightweight and convenient configuration meeting a structure such as a simple type bed is required.SOLUTION: A wheelchair front suspension device is structured as follows: a pair of left and right protrusions is provided in both ends and a central part of a rectangular main frame configured in aluminum pipes, respectively; protrusions of an end and a central part are suspended in a pair of left and right lower frames of wheelchairs; and the wheelchairs are suspended by using the end of a front side as a supporting unit. In the wheelchair front suspension device, a slidable connection frame is provided in which an interval width can be adjusted and suspended so as to be compatible with the interval width different in length such as the wheelchair to be suspended.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Fire alarm and emergency escaping system for the deaf and the senior
title_ko: 노약자 및 청각장애인들을 위한 화재 경보 및 대피 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention informs the senior or the deaf with a weak sensing ability who sleeps of a fire and escapes the senior or the deaf when the fire breaks out in a building. The losses of properties and casualties are prevented by the reduction of the escape time of rescuers and the quick fire response of firefighters, by vibrating a pillow, opening an entrance door by automatically unlocking a door lock, and reporting the occurrence of the fire to surrounding fire stations and police stations through a transmitter by comprising the vibration type pillow, the automatic open and close door lock, and the transmitter to wirelessly transmit and receive a signal to and from a fire reception board if the fire breaks out.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 내 화재 발생 시 수면중인 감지 능력이 부족한 노약자나 청각장애인들에게 화재가 발생하였음을 알리고 대피시키기 위한 것으로서, 화재 수신반과 무선으로 신호를 주고받는 “진동형 베개”, “자동개방 도어락”, “발신기”를 구성하여 화재가 발생하면 베개를 진동시키고, 도어락을 자동으로 해제하여 출입문을 개방하고, 발신기를 통하여 주변의 소방서 및 경찰서에 화재 발생 사실을 통보함으로써 요구조자들의 대피시간 단축 및 소방관들의 신속한 화재대응으로 인명피해 예방과 재산상의 손실을 방지하는 것이다.

title_en: Elevator control device, elevator remote monitoring server, evacuation assistance system, and evacuation assistance method using elevators
abstract_en: This elevator control device which implements a self-diagnosis function comprises a first evacuation guidance control unit that executes the self-diagnosis function by transferring a command received from an elevator remote monitoring server to a control device. When a diagnosis execution command for executing the self-diagnosis function is sent as a command from the elevator remote monitoring server, the first evacuation guidance control unit executes the self-diagnosis function by transferring the diagnosis execution command to the control device and sends the executes results of the self-diagnosis function received from the control device to the elevator remote monitoring server as elevator state information.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional Non-falling walking stick
abstract_en: A kind of multi-functional Non-falling walking stick.There is provided a kind of multi-functional Non-falling walking stick, for solving the problem of existing crutch easily skews, and it is multi-functional to assign crutch.Including handle and cane body, the cane body is hollow structure, umbrella is provided with above, the pack includes the equal some short umbrella frames and some long umbrella ribs of umbrella cover, the lasso being enclosed on cane body, the stator for being located at cane body upper end, quantity, one end of the short umbrella frame is hingedly fixed in the lower end of cane body, and the other end is hingedly fixed in the middle part of correspondence long umbrella rib；Some long umbrella ribs are used to support whole umbrella cover, and one end is hinged on lasso.The present invention sets umbrella on common crutch, opens, keeps out wind and rain when rainy, is packed up when not raining, and umbrella frame forms around cane body a circle support, crutch is not skewed, it is to avoid the elderly bends over the potential safety hazard of pickup crutch.

title_en: A kind of mass-rent towards disabled person community marks Task Assigned Policy
abstract_en: The invention belongs to mass-rent label technology field, specially a kind of mass-rent towards disabled person community marks Task Assigned Policy；The strategy is to be combined and mix the mode actively claimed to complete the distribution to marking task with manual allocation by automatic distribution.The allocation strategy proposed marks task to mass-rent and work for the disabled person is modeled, and builds the mass-rent towards disabled person community and marks task pool.The beneficial effects of the present invention are：The problem of same task duplication is distributed is effectively prevent, reduces and wastes disabled person labour；Certain element task amount is distributed for the disabled person that participates in mass-rent mark worker, while disclosure satisfy that a certain degree of more pay for more work again.

title_en: Fire-warning band for hearing-impaired
abstract_en: Fire, one of the most common emergencies in a typical building, often makes a fire alarm bell ring to evacuate people in the entire building if it is not in a fire zone. In the case of a building that employs a hearing-impaired person, it is inevitable that the evacuation will be delayed because the hearing-impaired person cannot hear the sound of the fire alarm bell. When a fire signal is detected or a central control room activates a fire alarm, the signal is sent to a wirelessly connected band with the fire alarm to vibrate a band. Therefore, the present invention provides technology to announce an emergency situation through vibration of a band. A fire-warning band includes a wireless communication module, a smoke detection sensor, a vibration module, a flashing lamp and a band part.
abstract_ko: 일반적인 건물에서 가장 많이 발생하는 긴급상황 중에 하나인 화재는 화재가 발생한 구역에 있지 않는 경우 건물 전체에 대피 명령을 하기 위해 화재경보벨을 울리는 일이 많은데, 청각장애인을 고용하고 있는 건물의 경우, 청각장애인은 화재경보벨의 소리를 들을 수 없기 때문에 필연적으로 화재에 대한 대피가 늦어질 수 밖에 없다. 화재 신호를 감지하거나 중앙통제실에 의해 화재경보기가 울리게 되면, 화재경보기와 무선으로 연결되어 있는 밴드에 해당 신호를 송부하여, 밴드가 진동하는 것으로 긴급상황임을 전달할 수 있는 기술을 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of disabled person's vocational training effect evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disabled person's vocational training effect evaluation method, including three layers of indicator evaluation system, three layers of indicator evaluation system is made up of learning layer index, application layer index and effect layer index three parts；Three layers of indicator evaluation system include 14 sub- indexs, wherein learning layer index includes four training contents, training method, training facilities and classroom atmosphere indexs, application layer index includes five professional skill, mode of handling affairs, method of work, operating efficiency and work quality sub- indexs, and effect layer index includes five salary and conditions, post stability, space of promoting, working effect and job satisfaction sub- indexs；During evaluation effect, assignment first is carried out to 14 sub- indexs, calculates each layer effect score value, further determine general effect evaluation.The comprehensive quantitative appraisal disabled person's skills training effect of energy of the invention, the result of training of the energy said institution or organization, can help related training organization to adjust training, enhancement training effect in time.

title_en: Disaster prevention cooperation system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To support fire fighting and evacuation activities by facility staff in a fire, and enable safe evaluation and suppression of the fire by the cooperation between an equipment management system provided with a desktop interface device that manages a work robot and a fire notification system.SOLUTION: Upon receipt of a fire information signal from a receiver 14, a desktop interface device 15 causes a map of a facility in which a place of fire is indicated to be displayed on a table screen, transmits a conveyance instruction signal to a conveyance robot 34, conveys fire fighting apparatuses such as a fire extinguisher from a conveyance source such as an apparatus storage space to a conveyance destination corresponding to the place of fire, and supports fire fighting by facility staff. Also, the desktop interface device 15 transmits an evacuation instruction signal to a stretcher robot 36 and a wheelchair robot 38 to cause them to move to an evacuation source such as a hospital room, and supports evacuation work in which the facility staff load persons having difficulty in evacuating on the robots and carry them to a safe evacuation destination.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sexual offenses prevention system utilizing big data
abstract_en: A sexual offense prevention system using big data is disclosed. The sexual offense prevention system comprises: a management server (20) in which big data (10) of a database of a sex offender (60) identified by a governmental organization is stored; an electronic anklet (30) to which an ID (70) is assigned for identifying an individual wearer when worn by the sex offender (60), and in which the ID (70) is stored; a transceiver (31) which is attached to the electronic anklet (30) to transmit/receive a location and a movement line of the sex offender (60), to which the ID (70) has been assigned, to/from the management server (20) in conjunction with a GPS (40); and a smartphone (50) configured to alert vulnerable people such as children and women if the sex offender (60) approaches as the management server (10) identifies the position and movement line of the sex offender (60) transmitted/received by the transceiver (31) of the electronic anklet (30). Therefore, when a sex offender wearing an electronic anklet equipped with a transceiver which is capable of tracking a location of the sex offender is within a certain distance (within a safe behavior radius range) from vulnerable classes such as children or women in a local area or a remote area, it is possible to provide a danger warning, a picture, and personal information to help the vulnerable classes such as women, teenagers, and children evade in advance and take personal safety measures.
abstract_ko: 빅데이터를 활용한 성범죄 예방 시스템이 개시된다. 정부기관에서 성범죄자(60)의 신상을 파악하여 데이터베이스 한 빅데이터(10)를 저장한 관리서버(20); 성범죄자(60)에게 착용하여 개개인을 식별할 수 있도록 ID(70)를 부여하여 ID(70)가 저장된 전자발찌(30); ID(70)가 부여된 성범죄자(60)의 위치동선을 GPS(40)와 연계하여 관리서버(20)와 송수신할 수 있게 전자발찌(30)에 장착된 송수신부(31); 및 전자발찌(30)의 송수신부(31)에서 송수신된 성범죄자(60)의 위치동선을 관리서버(10)에서 파악하여 어린이, 여성의 취약계층 사람들에게 접근하게 되면, 위험경보를 알려주기 위한 스마트폰(50)을 구성한다. 따라서 성범죄자의 위치를 추적할 수 있는 송수신부가 장착된 전자 발찌를 착용한 성범죄자가 근거리지역이나 원거리지역의 어린이, 여성 등 취약계층의 사람들에게 일정거리(안전 행동 반경 범위 내)에 들어올 경우 스마트폰을 통해 위험경보와 사진 및 신상정보를 제공하여 여성이나 청소년, 아동과 같은 취약 계층 사람들이 미리 대피하여 신변 안전을 도모할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Structure of slide for refuge
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fixing structure of a slide for evacuation which is configured to, in the event of an emergency such as a fire or an earthquake, enable a slide for evacuation installed in facilities for elderly people, such as a day care center, a kindergarten, a facility for the disabled, and a nursing home so as to be reliably installed in a building. To this end, the present invention includes: a first plate fixedly installed on a concrete body of a building; a second plate provided at an upper end of a slide; and a connecting anchor bolt for integrating the first plate and the second plate, wherein the connecting anchor bolt is formed of a body portion and a thread portion on a longitudinal plane, wherein a trench groove is formed in the body portion in a longitudinal direction, wherein a tensile member is inserted into and installed in the trench groove such that compressive stress is generated in the connecting anchor bolt by the tensile member.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재나 지진 등 비상사태의 발생시 어린이집이나 유치원, 장애인 시설, 요양병원 등 노약자를 위한 시설에 설치되는 피난용 미끄럼대가 건축물에 안정적으로 설치될 수 있도록 하는 피난용 미끄럼대의 고정구조에 관한 것으로서, 건축물의 콘크리트체에 고정설치되는 제1플레이트와, 미끄럼대에 상부 선단에 구비되는 제2플레이트와, 상기 제1플레이트와 제2플레이트를 일체화시키는 연결앵커볼트로 이루어지되, 상기 연결앵커볼트는 종단면상으로 몸체부와 나사산부로 이루어지되 상기 몸체부에는 트랜치홈이 길이방향으로 형성되고, 상기 트랜치홈에는 인장재가 삽입 설치되어 상기 인장재에 의해 연결앵커볼트에 압축응력이 발생되도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Balcony structure of apartment building with escaping function for fire-fighting
title_ko: 비상대피 가능한 공동주택 건축물의 발코니 구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a balcony structure of an apartment building with an emergency exit, comprising: a main body; a storage case; a wire; a handle portion; a support; a driving portion; a sudden drop prevention portion; and a discharge portion, wherein the sudden drop prevention portion comprises: a tube member; a storage space portion; a water supply pipe; an attachment and detachment portion; a reverse flow prevention portion; and a control portion. The control portion supplies firefighting water to the tube member by opening a valve installed in the water supply pipe when the driving portion is operated, and receives an operation signal in the discharge portion when a weight of the tube member rises above a set value, the operation signal is transmitted to the discharge portion so that the tube member is fallen to an external side of the storage space portion. By using the present invention, the elderly and infirm or a child is able to perform lowering operation by sitting thereon, and is able to adjust a lowering speed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 베란다 또는 발코니 내벽에 설치되고 드럼이 회전 가능하게 설치되는 본체; 상기 본체 일측에 설치되고 수납공간을 제공하는 수납케이스; 상기 드럼에 권취되고 상기 본체 외측으로 연장 가능하게 설치되는 와이어; 상기 와이어의 단부에 설치되는 손잡이부; 상기 손잡이부에 착탈 가능하게 연결되는 거치패드; 사용자가 착석할 수 있도록 상기 거치패드와 연결되고 상기 수납케이스에 보관되는 안착패널; 건물의 외벽을 따라 지면까지 연장되도록 설치되는 가이드레일; 상기 와이어에 설치되는 본체블록; 상기 본체블록에 설치되고 상기 가이드레일 측으로 연장되는 지지대; 상기 지지대에 설치되고 상기 가이드레일에 슬라이딩 가능하게 삽입되며 상기 가이드레일과 상기 지지대 사이의 마찰력을 제공하는 마찰부; 상기 본체블록에 설치되고 상기 마찰부와 상기 가이드레일를 접촉 또는 분리 시키는 스위치부; 베란다 또는 발코니 바닥면에 건물 외측 방향으로 슬라이딩 가능하게 설치되고 이동난간이 구비되는 돌출패널; 상기 이동난간이 착탈 가능하게 연결되는 고정난간에 회전 가능하게 설치되고 상기 본체블록이 안착되는 회전구동축; 상기 회전구동축을 회전시켜 상기 가이드레일에 상기 마찰부를 슬라이딩 가능하게 연결시키는 구동부; 상기 거치패드를 상기 손잡이부에 연결 또는 분리시키는 연결착탈부; 상기 손잡이부 및 상기 안착패널이 하강할 때에 상기 와이어에 장력을 제공하여 상기 손잡이부 및 상기 안착패널이 일정 속도 이상으로 낙하되는 것을 방지하는 급강방지부; 및 상기 급강방지부가 오작동되어 상기 와이어에 장력이 제공되지 않을 것을 방지하는 배출부를 포함하고, 상기 급강방지부는, 상기 와이어의 타측 단부에 설치되고, 소방수가 담수되는 튜브부재; 상기 튜브부재가 수납되도록 주택의 외벽에 형성되는 수납공간부; 상기 튜브부재의 유입구와 소화전 사이에 설치되는 급수관; 상기 급수관과 상기 유입구를 연결 또는 분리시키는 착탈부; 상기 유입구에 설치되고, 상기 튜브부재에 담수되는 소방수가 상기 튜브부재 외측으로 배출되는 것을 방지하는 역류방지부; 및 상기 구동부가 작동되면 상기 급수관에 설치되는 밸브를 개방하여 상기 튜브부재에 소방수를 공급하고, 상기 튜브부재의 무게가 설정치 이상으로 상승되면 상기 배출부에 작동신호를 송신하여 상기 튜브부재를 상기 수납공간부 외측으로 낙하시키는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Evacuation forecasting system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation forecasting system capable of forecasting a minimum evacuation time required.SOLUTION: An evacuation forecasting system includes a step (step S805 and step S808) of calculating, by using a genetic algorithm, a minimum value of a cumulative time for evacuating a disaster care-needed person with a support by a caregiver. The calculation is performed on the basis of: evacuation space information relating to a set evacuation space; initial location information in the evacuation space information of the disaster care-needed person to be evacuated by the support of the caregiver, a required care level of the disaster care-needed person, and the caregiver that cares the disaster care-needed person; and walking speed information of the disaster care-needed person according to the required care level.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 17

title_en: Corridor safety railing for building evacuation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a corridor type safety handrail for evacuation in a building. An existing evacuation device installed in a veranda for stairs to downwardly be unfolded in an emergency has problems difficult to be evacuated due to acrophobia when a person wanting to be evacuated is move and is incapable of moving a patient who cannot move, and a wheelchair which is a carrying means for the patient. According to the present invention, when it is difficult to be evacuated from a household of a high rise building through a front door during an emergency situation such as intrusion of an outsider or a fire, a safety handrail is deployed forward from a handrail of the veranda to ensure a corridor (passage) in order to quickly realize evacuation to a safe neighboring household with a wall interposed therebetween; thereby allowing people of all ages and both sexes and a wheelchair carrying a patient who cannot move to quickly and easily be evacuated. The present invention comprises: a veranda handrail; an evacuation safety handrail; side surface supporting means; a footplate folding means; a fixing means; and an emergency alarm means.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 대피용 복도식 안전난간에 관한 것으로서, 기존 베란다에 설치되어 비상시 하향식으로 계단이 펼쳐지도록 하는 대피장치는 대피자가 이동할 때 고소공포증에 의해 탈출이 용이하지 않고, 또한 거동이 불편한 환자 및 그 운반수단인 휠체어의 이동이 불가능한 문제점이 있었던 바, 본 발명은 고층건물의 입주세대로 외부인의 침입 또는 화재와 같은 긴급상황 발생 시 현관을 이용하여 대피가 곤란할 경우 벽체를 사이에 둔 안전한 옆세대로 신속하게 대피하도록 베란다 난간에서 전방으로 전개시켜 복도(통로)를 확보하는 안전난간을 설치하여 남녀노소 및 거동이 불편한 환자를 운반하는 휠체어가 신속하고 용이하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 건물 대피용 복도식 안전난간을 제공할 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: It is a kind of to be opened flat sliding door using door leaf side as axle
abstract_en: The application, which is related to, meets fire-fighting evacuation and a kind of daily accessible sliding door that is opened flat using door leaf side as axle using difunctional requirement, and technical scheme is：One upper corner of door leaf is provided with slidably rotatable first upper bracket with hanging the junction of slide rail；One lower corner of door leaf and the junction of glidepath are provided with slidably rotatable undersetting；First upper bracket and undersetting are located on same longitudinal axis, door leaf can be that door-hinge rotates to parados direction along axis, another upper corner of door leaf is provided with slidable second upper bracket with hanging slide rail junction, the electromagnetic lock or latch of door leaf are arranged on the junction of the second upper bracket and door leaf, and connecting rod connects the first upper bracket and the second upper bracket.It mainly solves the accessible middle place for wheelchair using design and design for fire protection contradiction.
assignees: SHANGHAI INSTITUTE OF ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Active type facilities for the elders building structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of active type facilities for the elders building structure, including the 1st public elevator and the 1st elevator hall, the 2nd public elevator and the 2nd elevator hall, the 3rd public elevator and the 3rd elevator hall, public evacuation verandah, the 1st public escape stair, the 2nd public escape stair, the 1st set of type, the 2nd set of type, the 3rd set of type, the 4th set of type, the 5th set of type, the 6th set of type and the 7th set of type；Public evacuation verandah is outdoor vestibule space, is connected between the 1st public escape stair and the 2nd public escape stair；3rd set of type, the 4th set of type, the 5th set of type and the 6th set of type respectively have two family doors, and a family door is daily life family door, and another family door is emergency evacuation family door, and emergency evacuation family door connects with public evacuation verandah.With advantages below：The utility model provides a kind of active type facilities for the elders building structure, can effectively improve the elderly's living quality and quality of the life, has that privacy is good, safety and calamity reducing is strong and the advantages such as construction cost is low.

title_en: Evacuation guiding apparatus for visually handicapped person
abstract_en: An evacuation guiding apparatus for a visually handicapped person according to a first aspect of the present invention comprises: a fire sensing unit arranged in a facility to sense an occurrence of a fire; a plurality of smoke sensing units arranged in the facility to sense an amount of smoke generated by the fire after the occurrence of the fire is sensed by the fire sensing unit; a plurality of units for sensing the number of persons arranged in corridors connected to a fire exit of the facility to sense the number of persons passing the corridors; a transmission unit wirelessly outputting signals corresponding to sensing results by the fire sensing unit, the smoke sensing unit and the person sensing units; a main body worn on a wrist of the visually handicapped person by a band; a receiving unit arranged in the main body to receive signals from the transmission unit; a warning unit, if the receiving unit receives a fire situation, informing the visually handicapped person of the fire situation; and a path guiding unit arranged in the main body to inform the visually handicapped person of an evacuation path. The present invention is able to sense the occurrence of the fire and inform the handicapped person of the evacuation path where the amount of smoke is small and the number of moving persons is small, is configured in a smart watch, which is a type to be worn on the wrist of the visually handicapped person to inform the visually handicapped person of fire through sound signals, band pressure, and vibration when the fire occurs, and is able to inform the visually handicapped person of a safe evacuation path through the sound signals and tactile signals on the evacuation path when the fire occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 제1 측면에 의하면, 본 발명은, 시설물에 배치되어 화재 발생을 감지하는 화재 감지부; 상기 시설물에 복수로 배치되어 상기 화재 감지부에 의해 화재 발생이 감지된 후, 화재에 의해 발생된 연기의 양을 감지하는 연기 감지부; 상기 시설물의 비상구로 연결되는 복도에 복수로 배치되어 상기 복도를 지나는 인원의 수를 감지하는 인원 감지부; 상기 화재 감지부, 상기 연기 감지부 및 상기 인원 감지부에서 감지 결과에해당하는 신호를 무선으로 출력하는 송신부; 시각장애인의 손목에 밴드에 의해 착용되는 본체; 상시 본체에 배치되어 상기 송신부가 송신하는 신호를 수신하는 수신부; 상기 수신부에 의해 화재 상황이 수신되면, 이를 시각장애인에게 알려주는 경보부; 및 상기 본체에 배치되어 상기 시각장애인의 피난 경로를 알려주는 경로 안내부를 포함하는 시각장애인을 위한 피난 유도 장치를 제공한다.  
본 발명은, 화재 발생 시 이를 감지하여 연기 발생량이 적고 이동 인원수가 적은 대피 경로를 장애인에게 알려줄 수 있고, 시각장애인의 손목에 채워지는 스마트 워치 형태로 이루어져 화재 발생 시 음향 신호, 밴드 압박, 진동을 통해 시각장애인에게 화재를 알려주고 안전한 대피 경로를 알려줄 수 있으며, 화재 발생 시 대피 경로상에서 음향 신호 및 촉각 신호를 통해 시각 장애인에게 안전한 대피 경로를 알려줄 수 있다.

title_en: Method for setting stockpile bedding and stockpile bedding set
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for setting stockpile bedding and a stockpile bedding set that can be shipped and stored in a compact state, is suitable for stockpile by local governments in preparation for a relatively long-term life as an evacuee is forced in disaster, particularly in an earthquake disaster, facilitates preparation when in use, and can provide slightly preferable feeling in bed to people who are not suitable for laying at a blanket and a cardboard in a floor such as a gymnasium as for an elderly person or a pregnant woman, etc.SOLUTION: A method for setting stockpile bedding comprises: a step of arranging multiple spring mattress dividing units in a state of keeping a predetermined interval and hanging a quilt thereon; a step of putting the above in a film bag body while hanging the quilt; a step of compressing the entire surface while being put in the film bag body and sucking air in the film bag body to seal the air suction side of the film bag body; and a step of folding the bedding being in a compressed state and fixing it while overlapping the spring mattress dividing units.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title_en: Fire escape balustrade
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire escape balustrade which secures a passage between balconies of neighboring houses when a fire occurs and enables a wheelchair or a bed in which a patient with a severe disease sits or lies to be pushed and escape to a neighboring house through the passage. The fire escape balustrade comprises: a fixed frame (2) which is installed at an end of a balcony (A) of a building to form a balustrade (1) of the balcony (A); a movable frame (3) which has a side able to spread and be restored, and which is assembled to the fixed frame (2) to be used as the balustrade (1) usually and to secure a passage as the side spreads in case of a fire, thereby providing an escape route, wherein the passage is rotated to reach a balcony (A-1) of a neighboring house and be positioned over both houses so that a person who needs to escape can escape to the balcony (A-1) of the neighboring house using the passage; a door (4) which is rotatably installed in the fixed frame (2) to form the balustrade (1) of the balcony (A) together with the fixed frame (2) and movable frame (3) usually, and which is rotated by a person who is to escape to provide an entrance to the passage from the balcony (A); a first locking means (5) for locking the movable frame (3); and a second locking means (6) for locking the door (4). When the fire occurs, the fire escape balustrade of the present invention can be used to secure the passage by spreading the side of the movable frame (3), to secure the entrance connected to the balcony (A) by rotating the door (4) after rotating the movable frame (3) wherein the passage is secured, and then to escape to the balcony (A-1) of the neighboring house.

title_en: Real-time school bus and student tracking
abstract_en: School District Administrators have the real-time monitoring of students and school buses during daily school transportation. The IRITRANS® system will provide school districts with real-time bus locations and more importantly the “specific identity of all students on-board”. The system prevents students from becoming lost by boarding or exiting at the wrong assigned bus stop. The iris scanning process is completely mobile from all points of the bus for loading and unloading students with special needs requirements. If a student has a medical emergency the medical history is available to responders for correct treatment. In a hijacking event authorities have access to the real-time GPS location of the bus and the specific identity of students onboard. In the event of a school evacuation, administrators know where the students have been taken and the identity of the students on a specific bus to provide parents. On field trips students are accounted for and not left behind on the return trip. Students will not be abandoned or left sleeping on the school bus.

title_en: It is a kind of to be opened flat sliding door using door leaf side as axis
abstract_en: This application involves meeting fire-fighting evacuation and a kind of daily accessible sliding door that is opened flat using door leaf side as axis using difunctional requirement, technical solution is：One upper corner of door leaf is equipped with slidably rotatable first upper bracket with hanging the junction of slide；One lower corner of door leaf and the junction of glidepath are equipped with slidably rotatable undersetting；First upper bracket and undersetting are located on same longitudinal axis, door leaf can be rotated along axis for door-hinge to parados direction, another upper corner of door leaf is equipped with slidable second upper bracket with hanging slide junction, the electromagnetic lock or latch of door leaf are arranged on the junction of the second upper bracket and door leaf, and connecting rod connects the first upper bracket and the second upper bracket.It mainly solves the accessible middle place for wheelchair using design and design for fire protection contradiction.

title_en: Integrated emergency broadcasting system and method
title_ko: 통합 비상 방송 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated emergency broadcasting system and method, and more particularly, to an integrated emergency broadcasting system and method, in which, when an emergency such as a disaster occurs, an emergency broadcast is transmitted through internal broadcasting and public address broadcasting, the emergency broadcast is provided through a DMB for users in a shadow area where the emergency broadcast cannot be viewed in a building, and the emergency broadcast and evacuation information are provided through a user terminal to allow a user to effectively cope with the emergency situation. The present invention provides an emergency broadcast to a user terminal, which is carried by an individual person and capable of displaying DMB, through DMB broadcasting, so that an emergency broadcast can be delivered to target persons who are in a position where it is difficult to watch the emergency broadcast through public address broadcasting and internal broadcasting. The location of relief targets is identified through a beacon device installed in each place, and the guidance for evacuation route is provided to the relief targets. In the case of the emergency relief target such as a handicapped person or an elderly person, a separate mark is assigned such that the rapid relief can be realized. Thus, the effective relief can be achieved upon emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합 비상 방송 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 재난과 같은 비상 상황 발생시 구내 방송과 전관 방송을 통해 비상 방송을 송출 가능하도록 지원하고, 건물 내 비상 방송을 시청할 수 없는 음영 지역의 사용자에 대한 비상 방송이 DMB를 통해 제공되도록 지원하는 동시에 사용자 단말을 통해 비상 방송 및 대피 정보를 제공하여 비상 상황에 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 지원하는 통합 비상 방송 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 개별 인원이 소지하는 DMB 시청이 가능한 사용자 단말로 DMB 방송을 통해 비상 방송을 제공함으로써, 전관 및 구내 방송 시스템을 통한 비상 방송의 시청이 어려운 위치에 있거나 이동 중인 구호 대상자에게도 비상 방송이 전달될 수 있도록 지원하는 동시에 각지에 설치된 비콘 장치를 통해 구호 대상자의 위치를 파악하여 구호 대상자에게 대피 경로를 안내하거나 장애인이나 노약자와 같은 긴급구호 대상자의 경우 별도의 표식을 설정하여 신속한 구호 조치가 이루어지도록 지원함으로써 비상 상황 발생시 효율적인 구호가 이루어지도록 지원하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Multi-directional vibration system that can safely evacuate from disaster area in the situation of communication failure
title_ko: 통신장애 상황에서 재난지역으로부터 안전한 대피가 가능한 다 방향 진동시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multidirectional vibration system capable of safely evacuating from a disaster area in a communication trouble situation, which provides a user′s smart device with a safe moving path based on real-time disaster information by using a detection device installed in an area to detect danger, and analyzing data stored in a database when a disaster occurs in the area, where global positioning system (GPS) transmission/reception is disabled. According to the present invention, the system comprises: the detection device (100) installed in the area, where the GPS transmission/reception is disabled, detecting a disaster occurring in the corresponding installation area, and converting detected information into data to transmit the data to the database; the database (200) receiving the data generated from the detection device (100), and comparing and analyzing the received data and previously stored data to transmit safe moving path data based on real-time disaster information to the user′s smart device; and the smart device (300) displaying an evacuation path and disaster information based on the data compared and analyzed in the database (200).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GPS 송수신이 불통되는 에어리어에서의 재난발생시 상기 에어리어에 기 설치되어 위험성을 감지하는 감지장치 및 데이터베이스에 저장되어진 데이터의  분석을 통해 사용자 스마트장치에 실시간 재난정보에 기초한 안전한 이동경로를 알려주는 통신장애 상황에서 재난지역으로부터 안전한 대피가 가능한 다 방향 진동시스템에 있어서, 상기 시스템은상기 GPS 송수신이 불통되는 에이리어에 설치되어지고, 설치된 해당 에어리어 구간에서 발생된 재난을 감지하며, 상기 감지된 정보를 데이터화하여 데이터베이스에 전송하는 감지장치(100)와, 상기 감지장치(100)에서 발생된 데이터를 수신하며, 상기 수신된 데이터를 기존에 저장되어진 데이터와 비교 및 분석하여 실시간 재난정보에 기초한 안전한 이동경로 데이터를 사용자 스마트장치에 전송하는 데이터베이스(200)와, 상기 데이터베이스(200)에서 비교 및 분석되어진 데이터를 통해서 피난경로 및 재난정보를 표출하는 스마트장치(300)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire exit guides
abstract_en: Disclosed is a fire exit guiding device activated in the event of a fire. The fire exit guiding device of the present invention comprises: a body unit installed on a bottom surface; a braille unit protruding upward from the body unit; a temperature sensitive sheet formed on an upper surface of the braille unit; and a melting unit filled between the braille units and liquefied in the event of a fire. According to the present invention, if a fire occurs and the ambient temperature rises, the fire exit guiding device capable of evacuating a blind person as well as a non-disabled person can be provided that thermopaint of the same color as the bottom surface turns into a conspicuous color to guide the exit and the blind person can read braille with a cane since the melting unit is liquefied.
abstract_ko: 화재시 발현되는 비상구 안내 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 화재시 발현되는 비상구 안내 장치는, 바닥면에 설치되는 몸체부; 몸체부로부터 상측으로 돌출된 점자부; 점자부 상면에 형성된 온도감응시트; 및 점자부 사이에 채워지고, 화재시 액화되는 멜팅부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 화재가 발생하여 주위의 온도가 올라가면, 바닥면과 같은 색인 시온도료가 눈에 잘 띄는 색으로 변하여 비상구를 안내하고, 멜팅부가 액화되어 시각장애인이 케인으로 점자를 읽을 수 있게 되는, 비장애인뿐만 아니라 시각장애인의 대피를 돕는 비상구 안내 장치를 제공할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Apparatus for determining the emergency situation of the old and the infirm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm which senses a bio-signal of the elderly and infirm and whether the elderly and infirm enters a specific space through a contactless method by being arranged in a living space of the elderly and infirm, determines whether an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs by sensing the bio-signal of the elderly and infirm, determines whether the emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs as the elderly and infirm pushes a button, and determines whether the emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs through a movement of a body of the apparatus. To this end, the apparatus comprises: a bio-radar; a warning sound occurring button; a gyro sensor; and a control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 노약자의 응급 상황을 판별하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 노약자의 주거 공간 내에 배치되어 노약자의 특정 공간 진입 여부와 노약자의 생체신호를 비접촉 방식으로 감지하고, 노약자의 생체신호 감지를 통해 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하고, 노약자의 버튼 누름을 통해서도 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하며, 장치 몸체의 움직임을 통해서도 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Apparatus for determining the emergency situation of the old and the infirm
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm. The apparatus according to the present invention is installed in a residential space of the elderly and infirm and detects whether the elderly and infirm enter a specific space and a biological signal of the elderly and infirm in a contactless manner so as to determine whether the elderly and inform has an emergency situation through the biological signal detection. The apparatus comprises a bio radar; a wireless communication part; and a control part.

title_en: Posture change mat and movement tool for evacuation
abstract_en: To provide a posture change mat enabling a caregiver to transfer a care-receiver from a supine posture to a seated posture (or from the seated posture to the supine posture) without burden, and a movement tool for evacuation enabling caregivers to move a care-receiver with less burden at the time of disaster.SOLUTION: A mat body 1 is formed of a rectangle soft resin foam, longitudinal side edge parts L, L of the mat body are formed with first slit parts 11, 11, the first slit parts and second slit parts 12, 12 are provided, the mat body is formed with a back pad part B, a seat part H and a footrest part F, the back pad part of the mat body is attached with a first belt member 2 and the footrest part F of the mat body is attached with a second belt member 3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Manufacturing method for floating type home nursing disaster prevention shelter
abstract_en: To provide a floating type home care disaster prevention shelter for protecting life and property by being lived in as a final abode and floating accommodating family and nearby residents in timeS of disaster such as a tsunami or a flood.SOLUTION: Leaving jobs to nurse family which presently occurs for approximately 100,000 persons is capable of being prevented since the elderly can be nursed at home without anxiety by: covering a strong frame body connecting a barge type platform and a deck framework by a corner strut and a strut by an insulation plate with an inner packing of cypress plate and inner packing; improving shock resistance property and environmental resistance property by bilayer polyurea resin and protective coating; preventing a turn-over due to a tsunami or traverse waves by installing a drinking water tank also used as ballast on a bottom; installing sanitary facilities and a nursing assistance device for nursing, an AI speaker, and a camera in a room with an atmosphere of forest bathing drifting with aroma of cypress; having a wearable terminal capable of grasping the health situation worn on an elderly person's arm and connected to IoT; having family observe by a smart phone while working in a work place; and responding with close cooperation with a home care medical support hospital and a nursing service support dealer when something occurs.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: A kind of old man based on Internet of Things goes on a journey safely bracelet control system
abstract_en: It goes on a journey safely bracelet control system the invention discloses a kind of old man based on Internet of Things, belongs to internet of things field.It is main including circuit board, microphone, miniature shock motor, flash appeal button and flexible material bracelet band.Circuit board is equipped with central processing unit, memory, position sensor, Internet of Things and network connection device, Audio Controller and control chip.The central processing unit handles the signal received and assigns instruction.The Internet of Things and network connection device are used for connection network, receive traffic light signal judging result, and the location information and help signal of old man are sent to the mobile phone of guardian.The Audio Controller connection microphone gives a warning to old man with miniature shock motor together in abnormal cases for acquiring sound.Old man can determine real time position, safety road using the bracelet, avoid dangerous obstacles, can also in case of emergency seek help, provide safety guarantee for the trip of the elderly.

title_en: Roadside device, communication system and pedestrian assistance method
abstract_en: In the present invention, a pedestrian terminal (1) transmits, from an ITS communication unit (12) to a roadside device, a message which includes pedestrian information. When the roadside device (5) receives, with an ITS communication unit (31), the message transmitted from the pedestrian terminal (1), the roadside device (5) stores the pedestrian information included in the message in a storage unit (34), as passage history information. A control unit (33) generates, on the basis of the passage history information in the storage unit (34), route guidance information (pedestrian assistance information) relating to an evacuation route for when a disaster occurs, and in particular: detects people requiring aid, such as elderly people, and people engaged in a lot of dangerous behavior; generates route guidance information aimed at such people; and transmits, to pedestrian terminals (1) in the surrounding area, a message which includes the route guidance information.

title_en: Safety protection system for passengers and drivers of online ride-hailing and taxi services
abstract_en: Disclosed is a safety protection system for passengers and drivers, the system including passenger and driver seat belt fastening state detection apparatuses, passenger and driver emergency alarm apparatuses, a car roof sounding alarm, passenger and driver fastening apparatuses, and passenger and driver isolation and protection apparatuses, wherein if a passenger is a single female, a pregnant woman, an elderly man or woman, a child, an infant, a person with difficulty in moving and an intoxicated person, an order will only be assigned to a vehicle provided with the above-mentioned apparatuses; when the passenger or a driver presses an emergency alarm button, the car roof sounding alarm gives an alarm; and when the passenger is still in an automobile and the driver attempts to unfasten a seat belt, the safety protection system gives an alarm immediately, the passenger can open a door using an automobile door remote control key on the passenger emergency alarm apparatus and escape, the car roof sounding alarm gives an alarm, and a mobile phone camera of the driver is turned on to monitor the driver, or the driver is fastened to the driver's seat.

title_en: Earthquake-resistant shelter for indoor installation
abstract_en: To provide an earthquake-resistant shelter for indoor installation capable of allowing even a person with a physical disability to easily enter/get out of the same.SOLUTION: The earthquake-resistant shelter for indoor installation includes at least a plurality of supporting columns each erected vertically along the vertical direction at four corners of an installation area formed in a square on the floor surface and a plurality of beam members extending along four sides of the square installation area, each connecting the upper ends of the neighboring supporting column. The earthquake-resistant shelter for indoor installation also includes a rail that extends between an upper portion of one surface of the aseismic shelter for indoor installation and an upper portion of the other surface extending in parallel to the one surface, the rail extending vertically from one side of the installation area, and a carrier device having a lift for lifting an object to be carried along the vertical direction, which is attached so as to move along the rail.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Construction Method of Screw Type Sliding Equipment for Emergency escape
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for constructing a spiral sliding frame for emergency escape, wherein the spiral sliding frame is constructed at one side surface of a building such that children and the elderly can rapidly and safely escape from a building in case of emergency situations such as a fire or disaster, comprising the steps of: (A) selecting an installation position of the sliding frame; (B) installing a fireproof door on a wall of the building at the installation position; (C) performing excavation for a set area on the ground at the installation position, distributing reinforcement steel and assembling an anchor, and then placing concrete; (D) assembling a main column, having a set length, by fastening a bolt to the anchor assembled by a foundation construction to vertically install the main column on the installation position; (E) coupling and assembling a column fixation band considering an interlayer height and a tilt angle for installing a slide at the main column; (F) coupling and assembling a slide support bracket on each column fixation band wherein the bracket has a seating support groove for supporting and seating the sliding frame; (G) seating and arranging the pipe shaped slide at each seating support groove of the slide support bracket and then performing a welding operation; (H) fixating a floor fixation support with a circular shape on the ground where the slide lands; (I) arranging a side column support pipe, positioned at an outer side of the slide and bent along the slide, at an outer side end of the slide support bracket and performing a welding operation; (J) arranging side columns in a radial structure to be spaced apart along the circular periphery of the floor fixation support; (K) bending and arranging a fall prevention handrail along the slide to be positioned at an upper side in the outer side direction of the slide; and (L) horizontally arranging a start floor plate at an outer side of the fireproof door and fixatedly coupling the start floor plate to the slide.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물에 화재나 재난 등의 비상사태 발생시 노인이나 어린이들이 건축물 밖으로 신속하고 안전하게 탈출할 수 있도록 건축물의 일측면에 시공하는 비상탈출용 나선형 미끄럼틀 시공방법에 관한 것으로서, (A) 화재나 재난시 사람들이 건축물로부터 용이하게 탈출할 수 있는 동선을 파악 및 미끄럼대의 착지부 측 구급차량의 통행까지 고려하여 미끄럼틀의 설치위치를 선정하는 단계; (B) 미끄럼틀의 설치위치가 선정되면, 설치위치의 건축물 벽체 상에 방화문을 설치하는 단계; (C) 설치위치의 지면에 일정 면적으로 터파기를 하고 철근 배근과 앵커를 조립한 후 콘크리트를 타설하는 기초 공사단계; (D) 기초 공사에 의해 조립된 앵커에 볼트 체결을 통해 조립하여 일정 길이를 갖는 메인기둥을 설치위치 상에 수직 설치하는 단계; (E) 메인기둥에 미끄럼대를 설치하기 위한 층간 높이와 경사각도를 고려하여 기둥고정밴드를 체결 조립하되, 수직 설치되는 메인기둥의 길이방향으로 간격 배치하는 단계; (F) 미끄럼대의 안착 지지를 위한 안착지지홈을 갖는 미끄럼대 지지브래킷을 각 기둥고정밴드 상에 체결 조립하는 단계; (G) 미끄럼대 지지브래킷의 각 안착지지홈마다 관체의 미끄럼대를 안착 배치한 후 용접하여 고정 결합하되, 미끄럼대를 밴딩하여 상측에서 하측 방향으로 미끄러져 내려가도록 나선형 구조로 미끄럼대를 설치 및 설치위치의 지면에 미끄럼대의 착지부가 접촉되게 하는 단계; (H) 원형 구조로 구비되는 바닥고정대를 미끄럼대가 착지되는 지면 상에 고정 배치하는 단계; (I) 미끄럼대의 외측에 위치 및 미끄럼대를 따라 밴딩되는 사이드기둥 지지파이프를 미끄럼대 지지브래킷의 외측단부에 안착 지지된 상태가 되게 배치하고 용접하여 고정 결합하는 단계; (J) 바닥고정대의 원둘레를 따라 방사상 구조로 간격 배치하되, 바닥고정대와 사이드기둥 지지파이프 측에 일정 길이를 갖는 사이드기둥을 수직 설치한 후 용접하여 고정 결합하는 단계; (K) 미끄럼대를 따라 밴딩하여 미끄럼대의 외측방향 위쪽에 위치되게 추락방지난간을 배열하되 수직 설치되는 사이드기둥의 내면 지지상태에서 용접하여 고정 결합하는 단계; (L) 방화문 측 외부에 출발참바닥판을 수평 배치 및 미끄럼대에 연결되게 고정 결합하되, 기둥고정밴드에 체결 조립 및 메인기둥 상에 간격 배치된 어느 하나의 미끄럼대 지지브래킷을 이용하여 지지를 받도록 설치하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Vehicle accident prevention device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a secondary accident prevention device for a vehicle and, more specifically, to a secondary accident prevention device installed in a vehicle and enabling a driver of the following vehicle to recognize an emergency situation such as an accident or a failure occurs. The secondary accident prevention device for a vehicle comprises: a fixing unit installed in the accident vehicle or in the disabled vehicle to be detached; an unfolding light emitting unit enabling the driver of the following vehicle to recognize the emergency situation since the upper end of the unfolding light emitting unit is fixed to the fixing unit; and a weight bar is fixed to a lower end of the unfolding light emitting unit. The fixing unit comprises: a housing main body having an operation space inside and a slit on one side; a winding roller installed in the housing main body, wherein an upper end of the winding roller is fixed to the unfolding light emitting unit; and a driving motor rotating the winding roller. The unfolding light emitting unit comprises: a connection unit comprising connection wires connecting the fixing unit and weight bar; and lamps emitting the light by being formed in the connection wire. The fixing unit is connected to a ring formed in the vehicle to be detached, by having a hook. The weight bar is formed of a synthetic resin material having elasticity. When a failure or accident occurs in a vehicle, the secondary accident prevention device for a vehicle prevents a collision by informing other drivers of the emergency situation by being installed in the vehicle. Also, the secondary accident prevention device for a vehicle enables following drivers to rapidly reduce speed after checking the emergency situation as the unfolding light emitting unit is installed to correspond to following drivers′ eye level. So, the secondary accident prevention device can prevent secondary accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량용 2차사고 방지장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 차량에 설치되어 사고 또는 고장과 같은 위급상황 발생시 뒤따르는 차량의 운전자에게 위급상황을 인지시키토록 된 2차사고 방지장치로서, 사고 또는 고장 차량에 탈착가능하게 설치되는 고정유닛과, 상기 고정유닛에 상단부가 고정되어 뒤따라 주행하는 차량의 운전자에게 위급상황을 인지시키도록 된 전개발광부와, 상기 전개발광부의 하단부에 고정되는 무게바로 이루어지며, 상기 고정유닛은 내부에 작동공간이 마련되고 일면에 슬릿홀이 형성된 하우징본체와, 상기 하우징본체의 내부에 마련되고 상기 전개발광부에 상단부가 고정되는 권취롤러와, 상기 권취롤러를 회전시키는 구동모터로 이루어지고, 상기 전개발광부는 상기 고정유닛과 상기 무게바를 연결하는 연결전선들로 이루어진 연결부와, 상기 연결전선에 형성되어 발광하는 램프들로 이루어지며, 상기 고정유닛은 후크가 마련되어 차량에 형성되는 고리에 탈착가능하게 연결되고, 상기 무게바는 탄성을 갖는 합성수지재로 이루어져, 주행중이던 차량에 고장 및 사고가 발생시 2차사고 방지장치를 차량에 설치하여 뒤따르는 차량의 운전자에게 위급상황을 알려 추돌사고를 방지하게 되고, 운전자의 눈높이에 맞게 전개발광부가 배치되어 뒤따르는 운전자가 신속하게 위급상황을 확인한 후 빠르게 속도를 줄일 수 있어 2차 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있게 되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Air pocket for bed
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air pocket for a bed, for disabled patients currently living in bed only in hospitals, nursing homes, homes and the like. In the event of a fire, an evacuation method of the patients is elevators, descenders, emergency exits and the like, but the method is not practical. Therefore, it is possible to form a double tent in an instant by using an elastic steel wire and a flame retardant, waterproof, and smoke prevention functional fabric on the bed in use without evacuation, thereby preventing toxic gases and protecting the same from flames.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 현재 병원, 요양원, 가정 등에서 오로지 침대에서 생활하고 있는 거동 불능 환자들을 위한 것이다. 화재 발생 시 상기의 환자들의 대피 방법이 엘리베이터, 완강기, 비상구 탈출 등이나 현실적으로는 불가능할 수 있다. 따라서 대피를 하지 않고 사용 중인 침대에 탄성체 강선 및 방염, 방수, 방연의 기능성 직물을 이용하여 순식간에 이중 텐트를 형성하여 유독 가스 차단은 물론 화염으로부터도 보호할 수 있다.

title_en: Sliding Equipment for Emergency escape
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slide for emergency evacuation, which is installed at one side surface of a building to allow the elderly or children to speedily and safely evacuate from the building when an emergency occurs in the building such as a fire or a disaster. To this end, the present invention comprises: a main pillar assembled to a base anchor to be vertically installed; a pillar fixating band arranged after being spaced in a longitudinal direction of the main pillar before being fastened and assembled; a slide support bracket fastened and assembled to the pillar fixating band to be used for installing and supporting a slide, and having a mounting supporting groove for mounting and supporting the slide; the slide of a tubular body which is fixated and coupled after being mounted on the mounting supporting groove of the slide support bracket, and installed to allow a user to slide from an upper side to a lower side; a fall prevention banister which is the same tubular body as the slide, and is arranged along the slide at an outer upper side of the slide, while being fixated and coupled to be supported with an inner surface of a side pillar; a bottom fixating rack provided in a circular structure, which is arranged on the ground surface on which the slide is landed; a side pillar support pipe located at an outer lower end portion of the slide, provided along the slide, and fixedly coupled to the slide support bracket; and the side pillar welded to the bottom fixating rack and the side pillar support pipe to be vertically installed, and arranged after being spaced apart along a circular periphery.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물에 화재나 재난 등의 비상사태 발생시 노인이나 어린이들이 건축물 밖으로 신속하고 안전하게 탈출할 수 있도록 건축물의 일측면에 설치되는 비상탈출용 미끄럼틀에 관한 것으로서, 기초 앵커에 조립되어 수직 설치되는 메인기둥; 상기 메인기둥의 길이방향으로 간격 배치되어 체결 조립되는 기둥고정밴드; 상기 기둥고정밴드에 체결 조립되어 미끄럼대의 설치 및 지지를 위해 사용되고, 미끄럼대의 안착 지지를 위한 안착지지홈을 갖는 미끄럼대 지지브래킷; 상기 미끄럼대 지지브래킷의 안착지지홈에 안착 배치되어 고정 결합되고, 상측에서 하측 방향으로 미끄러져 내려가도록 설치되는 관체의 미끄럼대; 상기 미끄럼대와 동일한 관체를 미끄럼대의 외측방향 위쪽에 미끄럼대를 따라 배치 및 사이드기둥의 내면에 지지되게 고정 결합되는 추락방지난간; 상기 미끄럼대가 착지되는 지면 상에 배치 및 원형 구조로 구비되는 바닥고정대; 상기 미끄럼대의 하단부 외측에 위치되고, 미끄럼대를 따라 구비 및 상기 미끄럼대 지지브래킷 측에 고정 결합되는 사이드기둥 지지파이프; 상기 바닥고정대와 사이드기둥 지지파이프 측에 용접 결합되어 수직 설치되고, 원둘레를 따라 간격 배치되는 사이드기둥;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Single elderly person solitary death prevention system using communication terminal
title_ko: LoRa 통신  단말기를  이용한  독거노인  고독사  예방 시스템
abstract_en: The system for preventing lonely death of a senior citizen who lives alone using a LoRa communication terminal comprises: a LoRa communication terminal for finding an active state of a senior citizen who lives alone; a management server for assigning an ID of the LoRa communication terminal and managing a use place and an emergency contact; and a control server for storing and analyzing active state information received from the LoRa communication terminal to provide the active state information to a web service. The LoRa communication terminal transmits a state of movement of a door of home of the senior citizen who lives alone to the control server using LoRa communication and the control server stores and analyzes the active state and determines a sign of lonely death to generate an alert to a computer or smartphone so that the management server is operated to automatically call a registered emergency contact.
abstract_ko: LoRa 단말기를 이용한 독거 노인 고독사 사전예방 시스템은, 독거노인의  활동상태를  파악하기  위한  LoRa   통신  단말기와, LoRa  통신  단말기의 ID를 부여하고 사용처 및 비상 연락처를 관리하기 위한 관리서버와, LoRa 통신 단말기로부터 수신된 활동상태 정보를 저장 및 분석하여 웹서비스를 제공하는 관제서버를 포함하며, LoRa  통신  단말기가 독거노인 가정의 문 움직임 상태를 LoRa 통신을 이용하여 관제서버에 전달하고, 관제서버에서 활동상태를 저장 및 분석하여 고독사 정후를 판단하여 컴퓨터 또는 스마트폰으로 경고를 발생하여 관리서버에 의해 등록된 비상연락처로 자동으로 연락하도록 동작하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Auxiliary apparatus for pushing a button of automatic door for the safety evacuation for children
title_ko: 어린이 안전대피를 위한 자동문 버튼 누름 보조 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic door button pressing assistance device for safe child evacuation. The automatic door button pressing assistance device includes: a housing having a storage space therein; a fixing member fixing one side of the housing to a position adjacent to an automatic door button installed on the outer wall of an entrance of a building; a first disc installed in the storage space to be able to be rotated normally or reversely; a second disc fixed to one side of the upper surface of the first disc; a pressing piece fixed to the center axis of the second disc to be rotated along with the second disc in accordance with the rotation of the first disc; and a manipulation part controlling the pressing piece to make the piece press one side of the upper surface of the automatic door button by rotating the first disc in one direction through the manipulation of a user. Therefore, the automatic door button pressing assistance device is capable of enabling a child or a wheelchair, who cannot reach an automatic door button, to easily press the automatic door button.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 어린이 안전대피를 위한 자동문 버튼 누름 보조 장치에 관한 것으로서, 내부에 수용 공간이 마련된 하우징과, 상기 하우징의 일측을 건물의 출입구 외벽에 설치된 자동문 버튼과 인접한 위치에 고정시키는 고정 부재와, 상기 수용 공간에 정역회전 가능하도록 설치되는 제1 원판과, 상기 제1 원판의 상면 일측에 고정 설치되는 제2 원판과, 상기 제2 원판의 중심축에 고정되어 상기 제1 원판의 회전에 따라 상기 제2 원판과 함께 회전되는 소정 길이의 가압편과, 사용자의 조작에 의해 상기 제1 원판을 일방향으로 회전시켜 상기 가압편이 상기 자동문 버튼의 상면 일측을 가압하도록 제어하는 조작부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라, 자동문 버튼에 손이 닿지 않는 키가 작은 어린이나 휠체어 이용자의 경우에도 쉽게 자동문 버튼을 누를 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: It is a kind of can side door evacuation rail traffic vehicles and its side door evacuate structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of rail traffic vehicles side doors to evacuate structure, the components such as module, skirtboard turnover panel can be stirred including the fixation pedal at vehicle side door, guest room floor by being arranged, connect guest room floor and low evacuation platform, evacuating system is formed with car door united opening, to realize that passenger carries out emergency evacuation by side door in disabled vehicle, and when being not turned on emergency evacuation structure, the car door again can normal on-board and off-board purpose.

title_en: Can side door evacuation rail traffic vehicles and flexible side door may be reversed evacuate structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flexible side doors that may be reversed of rail traffic vehicles to evacuate structure, the components such as module, telescopic pedal, skirtboard turnover panel can be stirred including the fixation pedal at vehicle side door, guest room floor by being arranged, connect guest room floor and low evacuation platform, means of escape is formed with car door united opening, to realize that passenger carries out emergency evacuation by side door in disabled vehicle, and when being not turned on emergency evacuation structure, the car door again can normal on-board and off-board purpose.

title_en: Apparatus for Informing Door Opening and Indicating Position of Panic Bar
title_ko: 도어 개방 알림 및 패닉바 위치표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for informing door opening and indicating location of a panic bar. Specifically, the apparatus for informing door opening and indicating position of the panic bar notifies the disabled that a door is opened, so that it is possible to effectively prevent the collision with an opening door, and since location of the panic bar is easily acknowledged, the disabled can quickly open the door and evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도어 개방 알림 및 패닉바 위치표시장치에 관한 것으로, 도어의 반대편에 있는 사람 특히 장애인에게 도어가 개방됨을 알려줌으로써 개방되는 도어와의 충돌을 효과적으로 방지하고 화재발생시 패닉바의 위치가 용이하게 시인될 수 있어 도어를 신속하게 열고 대피할 수 있도록 한 도어 개방 알림 및 패닉바 위치표시장치이다.

title_en: Door opening notification and door handle/panic bar position indication device
title_ko: 도어 개방 알림 및 도어손잡이/패닉바 위치표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a door opening notification and door handle/panic bar position indication device, which notifies a person on the other side of the door, particularly the disabled, that the door is being opened, thereby effectively preventing a collision with the door being opened, and allows a user to easily locate the position of the door handle/panic bar in the event of fire, thereby allowing the user to open the door and escape quickly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도어 개방 알림 및 도어손잡이/패닉바 위치표시장치에 관한 것으로, 도어의 반대편에 있는 사람 특히 장애인에게 도어가 개방됨을 알려줌으로써 개방되는 도어와의 충돌을 효과적으로 방지하고 화재발생시 도어손잡이/패닉바의 위치가 용이하게 시인될 수 있어 도어를 신속하게 열고 대피할 수 있도록 한 도어 개방 알림 및 도어손잡이/패닉바 위치표시장치이다.

title_en: Fire escape apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire evacuator which is installed on the veranda of an apartment or high-rise building to safely evacuate occupants in an emergency such as a fire, descends to the weight of refugees when the refugees boards thereto, and automatically moves up and down between upper and lower floors of the veranda where the fire evacuator is installed by a folding method through a drive part, a first connection part, a second connection part, a folding part, and a balancing part, when the evacuator is lifted by the restoring force of a rising power part formed by a gas cylinder after the refugees gets off therefrom, thereby allowing all refugees to evacuate quickly as the elderly and children are readily available.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재와 같은 비상시에 거주자를 안전하게 피난시키기 위해 아파트 또는 고층 건물의 베란다에 설치되어 피난자가 탑승하면 피난자의 자중에 하강하고, 파난자가 하차한 후에 가스실린더로 형성되는 상승동력부의 복원력에 의해 승강할 때에 구동부, 제1 연결부, 제2 연결부, 접철부, 및 균형유지부를 통한 접철방식에 의해 화재 피난기가 설치된 베란다의 윗층과 아래층 사이에서 자동으로 신속하고 안전하게 승하강동작을 구현하여 노약자나 어린아이까지도 용이하게 이용할 수 있게 됨에 따라 모든 피난자를 신속하게 대피시킬 수 있는 화재 피난기를 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Pull type multi purpose door lock
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pull-type multipurpose door lock comprising: a housing including first and second covers; a rotation plate; a latch bolt; a dead bolt; and a driving unit. According to the present invention, a latch bolt and a dead bolt are integrally installed inside a housing, and a rotation plate in a handle shape is integrally shaft-coupled to one side of an outer surface of the housing, thereby providing a convenient installation effect.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 풀 타입 다목적 도어락에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 도어의 일측면에 설치되되, 내측에 설치공간이 형성되도록 양측으로 결합되는 제1, 제2커버를 포함하는 하우징과, 상기 제1커버의 일면에 일단부가 회동가능하게 축결합되고, 상기 제1커버의 일면과 일정간격 이격되어 타측으로 연장되는 파지부가 형성되며, 상기 하우징의 내측으로 걸림쇠가 돌출형성되는 회동플레이트와, 일단부가 상기 도어의 모서리 부분으로 돌출되도록 상기 하우징 내측에 설치되며, 타측면에는 상기 걸림쇠가 걸리도록 내측으로 함몰된 걸림홈이 형성되는 래치볼트와, 길이방향을 따라 일단부가 상기 도어의 모서리 부분으로 돌출되도록 상기 하우징 내측에 설치되어, 상기 도어의 락기능을 수행하는 데드볼트와, 상기 제1커버의 일면에 열쇠구멍이 관통형성되고, 일단부가 상기 열쇠구멍 내측으로 삽입되는 열쇠에 고정되기 위한 열쇠홈이 형성되며, 타단부가 상기 데드볼트의 일측에 연결되어 상기 열쇠와 일체로 회동되면서 상기 데드볼트를 길이방향으로 구동시키는 구동부를 포함하여, 상기 회동플레이트의 파지부를 파지한 상태에서 상기 회동플레이트를 외측으로 당겨 상기 걸림쇠가 상기 걸림홈에 걸리면서 상기 래치볼트의 일단부가 상기 하우징 내측으로 인입되도록 한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 하우징 내측에 래치볼트와 데드볼트가 일체로 설치되고, 하우징의 외면 일측에 손잡이 형태의 회동플레이트가 일체로 축결합되어 도어 내측에 하우징을 삽입시키고 도어의 외측으로 노출되는 하우징의 일면에 회동플레이트를 결합시켜 설치가 매우 편리한 효과가 있다. 
또한, 도어에 설치된 상태에서 회동플레이트를 옆으로 미는 동작만으로도 도어가 개방되어 회동플레이트가 패닉바의 기능으로 사용 가능하여 일반 주택, 비상대피공간, 장애인 시설, 캠핑카, 공장 등 다양한 공간 내에서 적용될 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Device for emergency escape
abstract_en: Provided in the present invention is an emergency evacuation device which provides a high space utilization of a building and is easy to use even for children or the elderly. To this end, the emergency evacuation device which is installed at an outer wall of a building is characterized by comprising: an outer wall frame unit which is installed to be foldable so as to switch between a folded state of being close to the outer wall and an unfolded state of protruding from the outer wall to the outside to form a vertical moving space at a gap from the outer wall; a rotating frame unit which is rotatably fixated at a floor of the building and is operated between a standby state of being vertically arranged on the floor and a rotating state of being horizontally laid on an axial line of the vertical moving space; a control unit which operates the outer wall frame unit and the rotating frame unit; and an elevating unit including an elevating plate which is installed at the rotating frame unit to be elevatable along the vertical moving space, and a descending life line which elevates the elevating plate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물의 공간활용성이 높고, 어린이나 노약자도 쉽게 이용할 수 있는 비상탈출장치를 제공하기 위한 것으로, 건물의 외벽에 설치되는 비상탈출장치에 있어서, 상기 외벽에 근접하는 접힘상태와, 상기 외벽으로부터 외부로 돌출되어 상기 외벽과의 사이에 수직이동공간을 형성하는 펼침상태 간을 절첩가능하게 설치되는 외벽프레임부와, 상기 건물의 바닥에 회동 가능하게 고정되어, 바닥에 수직하게 배치된 대기상태와 상기 수직이동공간의 축선에 가로방향으로 ?혀진 회동상태 간을 동작하는 회동프레임부와, 상기 외벽프레임부와 상기 회동프레임부를 작동하는 조작유니트와, 상기 회동프레임부에 설치되어 상기 수직이동공간을 따라 승강 가능한 승강판과, 상기 승강판을 승강구동하는 완강기를 포함하는 승강유니트를 가지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Smart evacuation map for the deaf and blind.
title_ko: 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위한 스마트 피난 안내도
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart evacuation guide map for the visually and hearing impaired, which comprises: an LCD display for showing; a guide map outputted on the LCD display; a current location displaying a point in which the current guide map is located; an emergency exit representing the spot for evacuation based on the current location; an evacuation route representing a route to move in accordance with the emergency exit display; a current situation output unit displaying the current situation and a response method; and a speaker helping the visually impaired to act on the current situation and evacuation tips.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시각 및 청각 장애인을 위한 스마트 피난 안내도에 관한 것으로 우리 눈에 보여주기 위한 LCD 디스플레이, LCD디스플레이에 출력되는 안내도, 현재 안내도가 위치해 있는 지점을 표시하는 현재위치, 현재위치를 기준으로 대피할 수 있는 곳을 나타내는 비상구, 비상구 표시를 따라 이동해야 하는 경로를 나타내는 피난경로, 현재상황과 대처방법을 보여주는 현재상황 출력부, 시각 장애인들이 현재상황과 대피요령을 행동할 수 있게 도와주는 스피커를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A vehicle with at least one emergency exit system
title_ko: 적어도 하나의 비상구 시스템을 갖는 운송 수단
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vehicle with at least one emergency exit system 5c, the at least one emergency exit system 5c comprising a jettisonable component 2i that is accommodated and locked in an associated frame structure 2l of the vehicle in normal operation mode and releasable from the associated frame structure 2l for being jettisoned from the vehicle in an emergency mode; and further comprising an emergency evacuation assistance device 9 that is adapted to assist in an emergency evacuation of the vehicle via the associated frame structure 2l in the emergency mode; wherein the emergency evacuation assistance device 9 is attached to the jettisonable component 2i such that the emergency evacuation assistance device 9 is deployed by means of the jettisonable component 2i when the jettisonable component 2i is jettisoned from the vehicle in the emergency mode.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 적어도 하나의 비상구 시스템(5c)을 갖는 운송 수단에 관한 것이고, 적어도 하나의 비상구 시스템(5c)은 정상 작동 모드에서 상기 운송 수단의 연관된 프레임 구조(2l)에 수용 및 잠겨지고 비상 모드에서 운송 모드로부터 사출되도록 연관된 프레임 구조(2l)로부터 해제가능한 사출가능 컴포넌트(2i)를 포함하고; 비상 모드에서 연관된 프레임 구조(2l)를 통해 운송 수단의 비상 대피를 지원하도록 적응된 비상 대피 지원 디바이스(9)를 더 포함하고; 비상 대피 지원 디바이스(9)는, 사출가능 컴포넌트(2i)가 비상 모드에서 운송 수단으로부터 사출될 때 비상 대피 지원 디바이스(9)가 사출가능 컴포넌트(2i)에 의해 전개되도록 사출가능 컴포넌트(2i)에 부착된다.

title_en: Walking assistance device for the blind and walking system having it
title_ko: 시각장애인 보행 보조기구 및 이를 구비한 보행시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a walking aid device for a blind person, which comprises: a glass body including a frame formed to cover a face to be worn on the face of a blind person in a glass shape, a lens installed at the frame to protect an eye, and a leg installed to be folded on both sides of the frame to be hung on both ears of the blind person so as to support the frame; an obstacle detection amplifying unit installed in front of the frame to recognize a position of an obstacle disposed in front of the blind person and a distance from the obstacle; a GPS receiving unit installed at one side of the glass body to receive position information on the blind person; an output unit for outputting voice and vibration when the obstacle is detected; and a voice recognition unit for recognizing voice of the blind person to receive information on a destination. Therefore, safe walking can be performed by receiving a voice message to the destination while receiving a current position from the GPS receiving unit. Also, an emergency button is set for an emergency situation to issue a notification to a remote management server so as to allow a guardian and a consignment organization to take an emergency measure. In addition, a disabled person can live and show ability like normal people, thereby minimizing loss of a social opportunity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 시각장애인 보행 보조기구는 시각 장애인의 안면에 안경 형태로 착용할 수 있도록 상기 안면을 감싸는 형태로 형성된 프레임과, 상기 프레임에 설치되는 눈을 보호하는 렌즈와, 상기 프레임의 양측에 절첩 가능하게 설치되어 시각 장애인의 양측 귀에 걸림되도록 하여 상기 프레임을 지지하는 다리로 이루어지는 안경 몸체와; 상기 프레임 전방에 설치되어 시각 장애인의 전방에 배치된 장애물의 위치와 장애물까지의 거리를 인식할 수 있도록 하는 장애물 검지 증폭부와; 상기 시각 장애인의 위치 정보를 수신하도록 상기 몸체의 일측에 설치된 GPS 수신부와; 상기 장애물이 검지될 경우에 음성 및 진동을 출력하는 출력부와; 상기 시각 장애인의 음성을 인식하여 목적지에 대한 정보를 수신하는 음성인식부를; 포함함으로써, GPS 수신부로부터 현재 위치를 수신 받으면서 목적지까지 음성 메세지를 전달받아 안전하게 보행을 할 수 있도록 하고, 비상시 응급버튼을 설정함으로써 원격지의 관리 서버로 통보하여, 보호자, 위탁기관으로 응급조치를 취할 수 있고 장애자가 정상인과 같은 생활과 능력을 발휘할 수 있도록 함으로써 사회적 기회 손실을 최소화 할 수 있도록 하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
